desc_en: This delicious rice dish is packed with protein, veggies, and whole grain goodness.

ingredients.en: Chicken breast, turkey ham or beef, cooked

steps: Heat pan. Add 1 teaspoon of oil. Add eggs and scramble.
Remove cooked eggs and set aside.
Add the rest of oil (2 teaspoons) to pan. Stir fry rice, breaking up lumps by pressing rice against pan.
Add cooked meat and/or vegetables. Stir fry until heated.
Add green onions, reserved eggs and sauce to taste. Serve hot.
Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
سخني مقلة وزيدي معلقة صغيرة زيت. زيدي 2 بيضات وخلطيهم حتى يطيبو. خرجيهم.
زيدي 2 معالق صغار زيت. زيدي 650 غ روز كامل مطيب وقلبيه، وفتتي الكويرات بالمعلقة.
زيدي 140 غ دجاج ولا لحم مطيب مقطع و150 غ خضرة مطيبة (جلبانة، خيزو، درة). قلبي حتى يسخن كلشي.
زيدي 2 بصلات خضر مقطعين، البيض وشوية صوجا. قدميه سخون.
tips: الروز البارد ديال البارح هو الأحسن للروز المقلي.
النار خاصها تكون قوية باش يتحمر الروز شوية.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Fried Rice, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis. Eating Smart Being Active Recipes.)
name_en: Fried Rice with Chicken and Vegetables
name_fr: Riz sauté au poulet et légumes
name_latin: Roz meqli bel djaj o khodra
desc_en: Low-sodium soy sauce and garlic powder create a delicious flavor for this brown rice, vegetable, and chicken dish.

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add rice and stir for 5 minutes.
Stir in carrot, bell pepper, onion, broccoli, soy sauce, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove mixture from pan.
Pour eggs into pan and scramble.
Put vegetable mix and rice back in the pan and mix with scrambled eggs.
Add chicken and cook until hot.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Fried Rice, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis. Eating Smart Being Active Recipes.)
name_en: Fried Rice with Chicken and Vegetables
name_fr: Riz sauté au poulet et légumes
name_latin: Roz meqli bel djaj o khodra
desc_en: Low-sodium soy sauce and garlic powder create a delicious flavor for this brown rice, vegetable, and chicken dish.

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add rice and stir for 5 minutes.
Stir in carrot, bell pepper, onion, broccoli, soy sauce, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove mixture from pan.
Pour eggs into pan and scramble.
Put vegetable mix and rice back in the pan and mix with scrambled eggs.
Add chicken and cook until hot.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Healthier You: Based on the Dietary Guidelines for Americans US Department of Health and Human Services Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion)
desc_en: Vanilla and orange peel are the secret to making this delicious cake with chocolate frosting. Serve at your next special occasion for a tasty treat.

steps: Preheat the oven to 325 °F.
Grease with small amount of cooking oil or use non-stick cooking oil spray on a 10-inch round pan (at least 2 1/2 inches high). Powder pan with flour. Tap out excess flour.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, beat together margarine and sugar until soft and creamy.
Beat in eggs, vanilla, and orange peel.
Gradually add the flour mixture alternating with milk, beginning and ending with flour.
Pour the mixture into the pan. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until done. Let cake cool for 5-10 minutes before removing from the pan. Let cool completely before icing.
tips: Cake: Icing: - Cream together cream cheese and milk until smooth. Add cocoa. Blend well. - Slowly add sugar until icing is smooth. Mix in vanilla. - Smooth icing over top and sides of cooled cake.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Engage your kids in a fun activity by having them slice and dip ripe bananas in orange or lemon juice and place the bananas in the freezer for several hours to create this tasty snack or dessert.

steps: Peel each banana and cut in half (width-wise).
Insert craft stick into bottom of each banana half. Dip each banana half into juice.
Wrap in foil and freeze for two or more hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Use your own combination of fresh, frozen or canned fruits to create this yummy dessert or snack. It's perfect for a summer day.

steps: Line 18 muffin-tin cups with paper baking cups.
Dice or mash bananas and place in a large mixing bowl.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon into muffin-tin cups and freeze at least 3 hours or until firm. Remove frozen cups and store in a plastic bag in freezer.
Before serving, remove paper cups and let stand 10 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Power of Choice USDA Food and Nutrition Service and US Department of Health and Human Services Food and Drug Administration (FDA))
desc_en: These frozen fruit pops contain fruit, juice, and low-fat yogurt to create a refreshing treat on a summer day.

ingredients.en: Us fluid ounces orange juice, frozen concentrate

steps: Mix the ingredients in a medium-size bowl. Divide into 4 paper cups.
Freeze until slushy - about 60 minutes. Insert a wooden stick half way through the center of each fruit pop.
Freeze until hard or at least 4 hours. Peel away the paper cup before you eat the fruit pop.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: These frozen pear pops are a refreshing treat! Sweet pears mixed with orange juice and yogurt is a snack that is sure to please!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
name_fr: Fruits et dip au beurre de cacahuète
desc_en: Use yogurt, peanut butter, and vanilla to create a dip for your favorite fruits.

steps: Prepare fruit by washing and slicing if necessary.
Arrange fruit on a plate around a small bowl.
To make dip, combine yogurt, vanilla, and peanut butter in a small bowl.
Mix well.
Chill dip in refrigerator until ready to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipes to Grow On University of Illinois Extension Service)
name_latin: Shake ftour bel fwakeh o danone
desc_en: Shake up your day with this quick and easy breakfast. Make this recipe with any of your favorite fruits, especially when they are in season!

steps: Blend banana with pineapple juice, yogurt, and strawberries in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Divide shake between 2 glasses and serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Making It Fit: Piecing Together Your Food Needs University of Vermont Extension)
desc_en: Honey and vinegar give a sweet and sour twist to this fruit and cabbage cole slaw.

steps: Shred cabbage.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: This compote has a thick and sweet sauce that is mixed with fruit for a delicious dessert.

steps: Drain the juice from the canned pineapple into a small saucepan.
Stir in orange juice and cornstarch. Blend until smooth.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Let the juice mix cool to room temperature.
While the juice mix is cooling, peel and slice the banana. Wash the pear and peaches and cut them into cubes.
Pour the cooled juice mix into a large bowl. Add the pieces of pineapple, banana, pear, and peaches. Stir together.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
desc_en: Slightly sweetened apples topped with a mixture of flour, oats and brown sugar crumble baked until tender and golden brown. Substitute berries, peaches, or a mix of favorites.

steps: Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Lightly grease a baking dish with butter or oil.
To make the topping: Place the flour, oats, sugars and salt in the mixing bowl and toss together. Add the oil (or butter) and toss again.
For the filling, fill the baking pan with the fruit and the remaining 1 tablespoon flour and 3 tablespoons sugar. Mix well and then cover with the topping.
Transfer to the oven and bake until the fruit is tender and the topping is golden, about 45 minutes. Serve right away or cover and refrigerate up to 2 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Discover the Secret to Healthy Living California Department of Health Services California Children’s 5-A-Day Power Play Campaign)
desc_en: Lime juice and orange concentrate gives this yogurt dip a tangy and sweet flavor. Serve it with your favorite fruits.

ingredients.en: Us fluid ounce orange juice, 100% juice, frozen concentrate

steps: In a small bowl, combine yogurt, orange juice concentrate, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Mix well.
Place bowl containing dip on a large plate and surround with fruit.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Power of Choice USDA Food and Nutrition Service and US Department of Health and Human Services Food and Drug Administration (FDA))
desc_en: With just three ingredients and three steps, this snack recipe is perfect for kids or beginner cooks of all ages.

steps: Combine yogurt and peanuts. Mix with a spoon.
Place a toothpick in the center of each fruit.
Dip fruit into the yogurt peanut mixture.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_fr: Salade de fruits à la feta
desc_en: Enjoy this super-quick and refreshing salad featuring melon and feta cheese. You can substitute any of your favorite fresh-cut fruit items, such as grapes, mangoes, etc.

steps: Whisk together vinaigrette ingredients.
Toss with remaining ingredients and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Lifeskills in Food Education, Food Skills Cookbook University of Hawaii at Manoa Cooperative Extension Food Stamps Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Blending your favorite fruit juice concentrate with ice and water will give you a quick and refreshing drink on a warm day.

ingredients.en: Us fluid ounces 100% fruit juice concentrate

steps: In a blender, place juice concentrate, water, and half of ice.
To prevent spillage, do not pass the top line of the blender.
Blend while gradually adding remaining ice. Serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Try this creative and easy way to enjoy your favorite fruit. Make and serve these fun fruit skewers as a dessert or snack.

steps: Thread the fruit onto the skewers, alternating and arranging the pieces however you like.
Serve right away.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
name_fr: Brochettes de fruits, dip au yaourt
desc_en: Fruit kabobs make a colorful and fun snack that kids can help prepare.

ingredients.en: Kiwifruits, peeled and cut into quarters

steps: Place fruit chunks on bamboo skewers. Place fruit kabobs on platter.
Place light strawberry yogurt in bowl. Serve kabobs with yogurt on the side.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking with What You Have Cornell Cooperative Extension of Onondaga County)
desc_en: This fruit shake is a great way to kick off your day. One minute in the blender and you'll be on your way.

steps: Place everything together into a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds to 1 minute.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Toasted whole wheat English muffins topped with fat-free cream cheese and fruit make this a quick and easy breakfast or snack.

steps: Toast the English muffin until golden brown. Spread cream cheese on toasted muffin.
Arrange sliced strawberries, grapes, and orange slices on top of the cream cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: The crust for this dessert cooks in the oven and is covered with a cream cheese mix and topped with strawberries. For variety, try using any combination of colorful fruits.

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F.
For crust, cream margarine, sugar, vanilla, and egg until light and fluffy. Add flour and baking powder, mixing well.
Spread mixture about 1/8 inch thick on a pizza pan, baking sheet, or 9x13 inch pan.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.
For spread, mix together cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla. Spread on cooled cookie crust.
Arrange fruit on top of pizza. Refrigerate until serving time.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pictorial Recipes Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service Oregon Family Nutrition Program Recipe submitted by Lynn Myers Steele, 2000)
desc_en: Mango and papaya add a tropical flavor to this fruit salad while chili powder gives it a kick. The jicama provides a refreshing crunch and the result is a fruit salad that's sure to please.

ingredients.fr: Jus de citron vert ou d'orange

steps: Wash, peel, and cut the jicama into thin slices.
Wash, peel, and cut the rest of the fruit (including the lime) into slices or small pieces.
On a large plate, arrange the fruit. Sprinkle the lime or orange juice over the fruit.
In a small bowl, mix the salt and chili powder. Sprinkle over the fruit and serve.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This colorful salad combines sliced strawberries, pineapple chunks, and blueberries coated in pineapple juice. Serve topped with low-fat yogurt and slivered almonds for a treat that looks as good as it tastes.

steps: Place fruit in a large bowl and mix with pineapple juice. Let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Place 1 cup of fruit salad in a small bowl and top with 1/2 cup of yogurt.
Sprinkle almonds on top of each fruit salad. Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Easy and Nutritious Family Recipes, Adapted from Easy Fruit Salad University of California Cooperative Extension Fresno County)
desc_en: This semi-homemade recipe mixes canned fruit cocktail with fresh fruit and yogurt for a quick and tasty fruit salad.

ingredients.en: Container of yogurt, low-fat piña colada

steps: Mix fruit in a large bowl.
Add yogurt and mix well.
Chill in refrigerator before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: A salsa that is different from what you may usually have, this fruit recipe can be a great way to help older kids and teens learn safe knife skills in the kitchen.

steps: Combine fruits in a medium mixing bowl and add lemon juice.
Stir in sugar, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Mix well.
Refrigerate until serving time.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Serve this fruit slush as a drink or a dessert, and keep leftovers in the fridge for later. Pour it over fresh ice when you are ready to eat.

ingredients.en: Cantaloupe or watermelon, coarsely chopped, seeded, peeled

steps: In a blender, puree fruit and lime juice until smooth. Add sugar if desired.
Combine fruit mixture and water in a large pitcher.
To eliminate the pulp pour through a strainer (optional).
Cover and refrigerate for up to a week.
To serve, stir well and pour into tall glasses over ice.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: This quick and easy smoothie uses any of your favorite frozen fruits. It makes enough for 4 servings.

steps: Defrost the frozen fruit just enough so that it will blend easily.
Pour the milk into the blender.
Add the pieces of frozen fruit to the milk in the blender.
Add the banana and yogurt.
Blend until smooth, about 30 to 45 seconds.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Have fun experimenting with different fruit and juices in this scrumptious smoothie.

steps: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses. Serve right away.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Make the youngest members of your family happy with this adorable snack. It's perfect for a mid-morning or afterschool snack.

steps: Peel banana and use butter knife to cut banana in half lengthwise.
Place 2 banana halves on small plate end to end, in an "s" shape.
Add raisins to the top of banana as eyes.
Enjoy your Fruit Snake.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University)
desc_en: Try this refreshing flavor combination or create your own!

steps: Collect all ingredients and freeze cans before starting to prepare the recipe.
Place cans of fruit in freezer for at least 3 hours. Take out when fully frozen.*
Run frozen cans briefly under hot water, or let them sit on counter for 30 minutes to loosen contents. Remove fruit from the cans, and use a sharp knife to cut it into small pieces.
If using a banana, peel, and cut into slices. Banana does not need to be frozen.
Place frozen, chopped fruit (and banana, if using) in the blender, and blend until creamy.
Serve immediately.
Freeze any leftovers in a freezer-safe container or sealable plastic freezer bags.
tips: *It is ok to freeze these cans overnight. They will not explode.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Layer grapes, yogurt, bananas, and cereal for a sweet and crunchy snack.

steps: Peel and slice the banana.
Spoon the grapes into a tall plastic cup.
Put 3 spoonsful of yogurt on top of the grapes.
Spoon sliced bananas on top of the yogurt.
Add the rest of the yogurt.
Sprinkle the cereal on top.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Easy and Nutritious Family Recipes University of California Cooperative Extension Fresno County)
desc_en: These pops are a fun warm-weather treat that needs only two ingredients. With no cooking, cutting, or special equipment required, kids can learn to make these by themselves.

steps: Combine ingredients. Pour into 3 ounce paper cups.
Freeze about 30 minutes; then stick a wooden popsicle/ craft stick in the center of each cup.
Freeze overnight until firm. To eat pops, peel off paper cups.
For variety, try other fruit flavored yogurts and frozen fruit or fruit juice concentrates.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Start your day off right with a warm bowl of apple cinnamon oatmeal, a dish that is perfect for a chilly morning at home.

steps: Use a vegetable peeler to remove the skin from the apple.
Cut the core out of the apple. Chop the apple into small pieces.
Put the water in the saucepan.
Bring the water to a boil on medium heat.
Stir in oatmeal, raisins, chopped apple, and cinnamon.
Turn heat to low.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring often.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_latin: Pita m3emmra bel djaj o fwakeh
desc_en: Bored with the same old sandwich at lunch? Liven up packed lunches with this Thai-influenced pita pocket: a surprising blend of fruits, spinach, and peanut sauce tucked in a very portable pita pocket.

ingredients.fr: Salade de fruits tropicaux en conserve

ingredients.en: Reserved juice from tropical fruit salad
ingredients.fr: Jus de la conserve de fruits

ingredients.en: Natural peanut butter, crunchy or chunky

steps: In a colander over a bowl, drain fruit salad well; reserve 3 tablespoons juice.
In a small bowl, whisk together reserved juice, peanut butter, cream cheese, and soy sauce.
Place drained fruit, spinach, and cilantro (if desired) in a bowl; mix gently.
Add sauce and toss.
Slice a small portion off each pita. Tuck the slice inside the bottom of the pita.
Fill each pita pocket with the fruit-spinach mixture.
Wrap individually in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Will keep well overnight.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Recipes CalFresh Healthy Living)
desc_en: Fruit, nuts, and chocolate. Do we need to say more?

steps: Place chocolate chips in a small microwave safe bowl. Heat on high for 10 seconds and stir. Repeat until chocolate is melted, about 30 seconds.
Place fruit on a small tray covered with a piece of waxed paper. Use a spoon to drizzle the melted chocolate on top of the fruit.
Sprinkle the fruit with chopped nuts.
Cover the fruit and place in the refrigerator for 10 minutes or until the chocolate hardens. Serve chilled.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service Family Living Program)
name_latin: Tajine loubya o kefta fel ferran
desc_en: Beans are unique foods that can be counted as either a vegetable or protein. Remember to sort and soak dry beans before cooking or use canned beans.

steps: Cook ground beef and onions. Drain fat.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Place in casserole dish.
Bake in the oven at 350 °F for 1 hour.
طيبي 450 غ كفتة ديال البݣري مع بصلة مقطعة وصفي الشحمة.
زيدي 55 غ سكر أحمر، 120 غ كتشب، 2 معالق خل، نص معلقة إبزار، 340 غ لوبيا حمرا، 450 غ لوبيا بالصلصة ديال البواطة و340 غ لوبيا بيضا. خلطي.
حطي الخليط فطبق الفرن.
دخليه للفرن على 180 درجة ساعة.
tips: هادي وصفة حلوة ومالحة على الطريقة الأمريكية، الدراري كيبغيوها.
صفي اللوبيا ديال البواطة قبل ما تزيديها.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Wellness Ways Resource Book University of Illinois Extension Service)
desc_en: Break out the barley to make a comforting vegetable soup on a cold or rainy day.

ingredients.en: Us fluid ounces tomato juice, low-sodium

steps: In a Dutch oven or stock pot, combine tomato juice, beef broth, barley, sugar, and seasonings. Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 1 hour.
Add vegetables. Return to boil; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables and barley are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_fr: Salade de haricots blancs du jardin
desc_en: Chopped tomatoes, bell peppers, and cucumbers combine with cannellini (white) beans, almonds, and a simple vinaigrette for a delicious and satisfying salad.

ingredients.en: Tomato basil garlic seasoning blend, no-salt
Cans cannellini beans, no-salt-added, drained, and rinsed

steps: Whisk together dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
In a small sauté pan, toast almond slivers until golden.
Remove from pan and let cool.
In a medium bowl, toss dressing with all ingredients except lettuce.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
To serve, place lettuce leaves on individual plates; top with salad.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Fix it Fresh! Recipe Series Kansas State University Research and Extension)
desc_en: This quick and easy one pan dish is full of veggies, spices, and flavor. Get your kids involved by letting them wash the vegetables.

steps: Place ground beef in a skillet sprayed with non-stick cooking spray. Brown meat over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally to break it into pieces. Drain fat and blot meat with paper towels. Transfer beef into a colander and rinse with very hot water to further remove fat.
Add green pepper, onion, and celery. Cook until softened.
Add beans, corn, tomato sauce, chopped tomatoes, pepper, garlic powder and chili powder.
Cook mixture over low heat for 20 minutes.
Serve hot in bowls. Or serve as a dip with baked tortilla chips or on a bun.
Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
حمري 340 غ كفتة ديال البݣري فمقلة مدهونة بشوية زيت على نار متوسطة قوية، وفتتيها بالمعلقة. صفي الشحمة.
زيدي 75 غ فلفلة خضرا، نص بصلة و75 غ كرافس مقطعين. طيبيهم حتى يطراو.
زيدي 110 غ لوبيا حمرا، 75 غ درة، 220 مل صلصة الماطيشة، 150 غ ماطيشة مقطعة، رشة إبزار، نص معلقة تومة مطحونة و2 معالق صغار شيلي مطحون.
خليها تطيب على نار هادية 20 دقيقة.
قدميها سخونة فطبسيلات، ولا مع شيبس الطورطيا، ولا فالخبز.
tips: الشيلي كيولي أبنن فاليوم الثاني.
زيدي رشة كامون للطعم المغربي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: This frittata with its blend of colorful vegetables and fresh eggs makes a deliciously nutritious single-dish meal for breakfast, brunch, or supper.

ingredients.fr: Pommes de terre rouges non pelées

ingredients.en: Italian kale, or other kale variety

steps: Beat eggs, pepper, and salt in large bowl; set aside.
Microwave potatoes until slightly soft, but not completely cooked; then cube. (Alternate method without microwave: Cube potatoes and boil 5 minutes until slightly soft; then drain.)
Chop remaining vegetables while potatoes cool. Mix vegetables together.
Heat oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet. Sauté vegetables for 5 to 8 minutes; add to eggs and mix well.
Pour egg-vegetable mixture into the same skillet. Cook over low to medium heat until eggs are almost set, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Cover and let sit until eggs are completely set, about 5 minutes. Egg dishes should be cooked to 160 ºF.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Fix it Fresh! Recipe Series Kansas State University Research and Extension)
desc_en: Fresh veggies, peanuts, and apples give this crunchy salad a refreshing flavor, and it is coated with non-fat vanilla yogurt for creaminess.

steps: Mix all ingredients together in a serving bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or longer to allow flavors to blend. Serve cold.
Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations Adapted from a recipe submitted by Alicson Scott, Chickasaw Nation, Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
name_fr: Pain à la poêle aux légumes
desc_en: The bananas make this bread moist and add extra flavor. Serve with a salad or main dish, or eat anytime.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a medium-sized bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a small bowl, combine bananas, water, and egg mix. Stir until mixed well.
Stir banana mixture into cornmeal mixture. Mix until dry ingredients are moistened. Gently stir in raisins and walnuts.
Lightly spray medium-sized skillet or baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Spoon batter into skillet or baking pan.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until bead is golden brown and pulls away from the edges. A wooden toothpick or clean fork inserted into the center of the bread should come out clean.
Cut into four equal slices and serve hot or cold.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Pasta salad is a cool and delightful addition to lunch or dinner. It goes with soup or a sandwich.

steps: In a medium-sized bowl, combine macaroni, onions, cucumbers, and green peppers. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, mix vinegar, vegetable oil, salt, and pepper. If using parsley, add that too.
Pour the prepared dressing over the pasta. Mix well.
Cover bowl and refrigerate for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve cold.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: Italian seasoning and garlic powder bring a punch of flavor to this delicious and easy vegetable soup. Serve it with a whole wheat roll for a satisfying lunch or quick dinner.

steps: In a large saucepan sprayed with non-stick cooking spray, sauté the carrots, onion, and garlic over low heat about 5 minutes.
Add broth, cabbage, green beans, tomatoes, and Italian seasoning; bring to a boil.
Cover, lower heat. Simmer about 15 minutes or until carrots are tender.
Stir in zucchini and heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve hot.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: This quick and simple bok choy recipe uses just garlic, salt, and vegetable oil to give bok choy a delicious flavor.

steps: Cut bok choy crosswise into easy-to-eat pieces.
In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, sauté garlic in oil until fragrant. If using garlic powder, add with salt in the next step.
Add bok choy and stir quickly. Add salt. Stir until greens are wilted and stem pieces are tender-crisp. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
name_latin: Ramen bel lham o touma o skenjbir
desc_en: Adding garlic and ginger to ramen is a game changer! This recipe has vegetables, lean protein, and lots of flavor!

steps: In a large skillet over medium-high heat (350 °F in an electric skillet), brown the ground beef. Drain fat from the skillet. Drain fat from the skillet. (See Notes.)
Add water and ONE seasoning packet to cooked beef and mix well.
Add vegetables, green onion, ginger, and garlic. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Add ramen noodles, reduce heat to low, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Seat Pleasant/ University of Maryland Health Partnership)
desc_en: Jazz up your chicken dinner with garlic, lemon zest, and fresh parsley. Serve this dish with brown rice and a side salad for a complete meal.

steps: In a small saucepan, bring water to a boil. Add garlic; cook for 10 minutes. Drain garlic, peel and cut into thin slices. In a small bowl, combine garlic, 1/2 cup of chopped parsley, lemon zest, and seasoning. Mix well.
Loosen skin from each chicken breast to form a pocket. Place about 1 teaspoon of garlic mixture under skin of each breast. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken skin-side down; cook until golden, about 4 minutes. Turn chicken; reduce heat to medium.
Cover and cook until no longer pink in center, about 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate. Wipe any fat away from the skillet.
Add remaining chopped parsley, broth, and lemon juice to pan. Bring to a boil; cook for 1 minute. Spoon mixture over chicken.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: This yummy chilled tomato soup makes a great addition to lunch or dinner.

steps: Chop the tomato, cucumber, and peppers into very small pieces.
Put all the ingredients in a large glass or plastic bowl.
Stir well with a wooden or plastic spoon.
Chill in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Best of La Cocina GOYA: Healthy, Tasty, Affordable Latin Cooking/ Lo Mejor de la Cocina GOYA: Cocina Latina Saludable, Rica y Económica GOYA Foods)
desc_en: Take a trip to Spain in your very own kitchen! Gazpacho, a Spanish favorite, is a cooling puréed vegetable soup topped with extra virgin olive oil for a smooth finish.

steps: Tear bread into small pieces; transfer to medium bowl and cover with 1 cup water.
Soak until bread is saturated, about 15 minutes.
Squeeze water from bread, discarding soaking water.
In bowl of blender or food processor, add bread, tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, and 1/4 cup of water.
Blend until well combined, about 1 minute.
With motor running, add oil in steady stream until well blended.
Stir in vinegar, season with low-sodium adobo.
Strain puréed soup through small-hole strainer, into soup terrine, pressing firmly to pass all liquid through strainer, discard any solids.
Cover terrine; transfer to refrigerator.
Chill at least 1 hour, or up to 48 hours.
To serve, divide soup evenly among serving bowls.
Garnish with tomatoes, onions, peppers, and eggs.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pictorial Recipes Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service Oregon Family Nutrition Program Recipe submitted by Lynn Myers Steele, 2000)
desc_en: Make this mix ahead of time and use it as a base for the Ginger Orange Muffins recipe.

steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well.
Store mix in a covered jar until ready to use.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Use our Ginger Bread Mix and make these muffins ahead of time for a quick and healthy breakfast on the go.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Combine the Ginger Bread Mix and bran cereal in a bowl.
Beat the egg slightly in another bowl.
Add the egg and other ingredients to the gingerbread and cereal mixture.
Stir only until combined. Let stand for 15 minutes.
Fill 12 muffin cups (well-greased pans or paper liners) 2/3 full.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until done in the center.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Bronson Wellness Center Bronson Healthcare - Michigan)
name_fr: Quinoa au gingembre et haricots verts
name_latin: Quinoa bel skenjbir o loubya khadra
desc_en: Fresh green beans work well when they’re in season. If they’re not, try frozen in this recipe that combines a whole grains and veggies into one satisfying and eye-catching dish.

steps: Toast to quinoa in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly for about 3 minutes.
Put quinoa in a medium pot and add water or broth.
Bring to a boil, then let simmer until all of the water is absorbed and quinoa is tender (10 to 20 minutes).
Set aside and leave uncovered to cool.
While quinoa is cooling, microwave the green beans until just tender.
Rinse in cold water to stop the cooking process.
In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, olive oil or cooking oil, sesame oil, green beans, lemon juice, soy sauce, and fresh or ground ginger. Stir well.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve at room temperature.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Take care not to burn the carrots at the end of this recipe. They should be browned (but not blackened) for a tasty side dish.

steps: Peel the carrots. Cut in half lengthwise, then cut into 1 inch pieces.
Melt the margarine in a heavy saucepan on low heat.
Add the carrots. Stir to coat them with the margarine.
Add the water, salt, and pepper.
Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes until tender.
Drain the water.
Add the sugar.
Cover the pan.
Shake the pan back and forth on the burner for 1 minute.
Cook for 1 more minute, until the carrots are glazed but not brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
desc_en: This family favorite is flavored with garlic, thyme, tomato paste, and mustard then coated with a tangy glaze and a sprinkle of oats.

ingredients.ar: كفتة ديال البݣري ولا الديك الرومي

steps: Preheat the oven to 325 °F. Lightly grease a baking sheet
Put a skillet over medium heat and when it is hot, add the oil. Add the onion, bell pepper, garlic, and thyme and cook about 10 minutes until golden.
Lower the heat and add the water and tomato paste. Cook about 10 minutes until the onion is soft and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Set aside to cool. Add the mustard, salt and pepper.
While the onion mixture is cool, put the ground beef, 4 tablespoons rolled oats and the egg in the bowl and gently mix, by hand.
Add the cooled onion mixture and gently mix again until everything is thoroughly incorporated. Do not over mix.
Form the mixture into a loaf about 8x4 inches and put on the prepared baking sheet.
To make the glaze: Put the tomato paste and mustard in a small bowl and mix well. Rub on top of the meatloaf and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons rolled oats.
Put in the oven to cook about 1 hour until deep brown and cooked throughout. Serve right away or cover and refrigerate up to 2 days.
سخني الفرن على 160 درجة ودهني صينية الفرن.
سخني معلقة صغيرة زيت فمقلة على نار متوسطة، زيدي بصلة مقطعة، نص فلفلة خضرا مقطعة، 2 حبات تومة مدقوقة ومعلقة صغيرة زعيترة، طيبيهم 10 دقايق حتى يصفارو.
نقصي النار، زيدي 120 مل ما و2 معالق طوماطيش مركز، وخليها 10 دقايق حتى تطراو البصلة ويشرب الما. خليها تبرد. زيدي معلقة موطارد، نص معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
فطبسيل خلطي بيديك 450 غ كفتة (بݣري ولا ديك رومي)، 4 معالق شوفان وبيضة.
زيدي خليط البصلة البارد وخلطي بشوية بلا ما تعصري بزاف.
صاوبي الخليط خبزة ديال 20 على 10 سم وحطيها فالصينية.
للطلاء: خلطي معلقة صغيرة طوماطيش مع معلقة صغيرة موطارد ودهني بيها الكفتة، ورشي 2 معالق شوفان.
دخليها للفرن ساعة حتى تحمر وتطيب من الداخل.
tips: ما تعصريش الكفتة بزاف باش تبقى طرية.
خليها ترتاح 10 دقايق قبل ما تقطعيها.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
desc_en: This soup is great for lunch or dinner. Serve it with a salad and a whole wheat roll for a delicious meal.

steps: Place the vegetable oil in a large soup pot or Dutch-oven style pan. Heat over medium-high.
Add the onion and sauté until golden, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat to a simmer. Cook uncovered until the peas are tender, about 45 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service Family Living Program)
desc_en: This stuffing has lots of crunch and flavor from the apples, celery, and onions. Whole wheat bread gives this recipe a boost of whole grains.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Put cubes in a large bowl. Set aside.
Put water in medium saucepan. Add onion, celery, parsley, salt, and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes. Do not drain. Pour over bread cubes.
Stir in milk and egg. Gently stir in apples, and raisins, if desired.
Spoon into a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Make your own granola bars at home. This recipe combines raisins, carrots, oats, and honey for a healthy snack or breakfast on-the-go.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Peel and grate the carrots.
Put the honey and peanut butter in a large saucepan. Cook on low heat until they melt.
Remove the pan from the heat. Turn off the burner.
Add oatmeal, raisins, carrots, and coconut to the saucepan. Stir well, and let it cool until you can safely touch it with your hands.
Put the mix into a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Press the mix firmly into the bottom of the pan.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Cut into 24 bars.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Texas A&M Agrilife Extension Service Expanded Nutrition Program - Hidalgo County)
name_en: Granola with Oatmeal, Coconut, and Pecans
name_latin: Granola bel choufan o coco o pecan
desc_en: Learn to make your own granola in an oven, skillet, or even the microwave. It's easy and you can be creative with what you put in it.

steps: Heat oven to 350 ºF. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, except raisins, mix well.
Bake in 13x9 inch baking pan at 350 ºF for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Stir every 5 minutes.
Stir in raisins. Cool thoroughly. Store in tightly covered container.
tips: Wash hands with soap and water. Conventional Oven: Electric Skillet: - Combine all ingredients except raisins in a large microwave safe bowl; mix well. - Set electric skillet at 300 ºF and stir mixture constantly until lightly browned. - Place in a bowl and stir in raisins. Cool thoroughly. - Store in tightly covered container. Microwave: - Combine all ingredients, except raisins in a large microwave safe bowl; mix well. - Place in 11x7 glass baking dish. - Cook at HIGH about 8 minutes or until golden brown, stirring after every 2 minutes of cooking; stir in raisins. - Place onto un-greased cookie sheet or aluminum foil to cool. Cool thoroughly. Store in a tightly covered container.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: The creamy and tangy goodness of low-fat cottage cheese is the perfect balance to sweet grapes and cashews. Enjoy this salad as a sandwich filling or on a bed of lettuce.

steps: In a medium bowl, mix cottage cheese, grapes, celery, cashews, parsley, and ground black pepper.
Toast bread and build sandwiches following steps 3 and 4.
Spread 1/4 salad mix on 4 of the bread slices.
Add two lettuce leaves to each sandwich; top with 2nd bread slice.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: A fruit-packed, refreshing twist on salsa. Perfect for topping tacos or scooping up with tortilla chips.

steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Let stand at least 1 hour. Drain off excess liquid before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (North Dakota State University Extension Service)
desc_en: Water chestnuts give this spinach salad a delightful crunch when served with the spicy and tangy dressing.

steps: Tear spinach coarsely and place in large salad bowl.
Add mushrooms, water chestnuts, and grapefruit.
Mix together oil, vinegar, grapefruit juice, soy sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and dry mustard.
Toss dressing with spinach mixture and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Great Northern beans are white beans that have a mild flavor.

ingredients.en: Chicken, thawed, cut up, and skin removed from each piece
Tomatoes, diced, or 1/2 can, about 8 ounces, low-sodium diced tomatoes

steps: In a medium-sized bowl, soak beans in 3 cups of water overnight.
Drain the water and rinse beans.
In a large pot, brown onion, chicken, and turkey ham in oil over medium to high heat for about 5 minutes.
Add water, beans, and salt to pot. Mix well.
Bring pot to a boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Lower heat and cook for about 1 hour. Stir pot every 15 minutes.
Add tomatoes and vinegar to pot. Keep cooking over low heat for about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_fr: Steaks de bœuf à la grecque
desc_en: These beef steaks are marinated in oregano and garlic and then pan-fried in a hot skillet until crispy. These tasty chops make a easy meal with quick clean up.

steps: Put the beef, oil, vinegar, oregano, and garlic in the glass or ceramic bowl, or in a sealed plastic bag and mix well. Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Sprinkle the beef with the salt and pepper.
Place a large skillet on the stove over high heat. When hot, add the beef to the dry skillet, waiting about 30 seconds between each addition.
Cook about 7 minutes on each side until crispy. Serve right away.
خلطي 450 غ شرائح لحم البݣري مع معلقة زيت، معلقة خل، معلقة كبيرة أوريݣانو و2 حبات تومة مدقوقة فطبسيل ولا ميكة. غطي وخليه فالثلاجة 4 سوايع على الأقل ولا ليلة كاملة.
رشي اللحم بنص معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
سخني مقلة كبيرة على نار قوية. حطي اللحم فالمقلة الناشفة قطعة قطعة وخلي 30 ثانية بين كل واحدة.
طيبي 7 دقايق من كل جهة حتى يحمر. قدمي دغيا.
tips: الأوريݣانو والخل هما الطعم اليوناني.
قدميه مع شلاضة الخيار والدانون.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: A colorful salad loaded with lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, and olives topped with chicken and a creamy yogurt dressing.

steps: To make the dressing, add Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper to a small bowl. Mix well to combine.
Cover dressing and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Wash lettuce and tear into bite-sized pieces. Place in large salad bowl and add tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, olives, and chicken.
Sprinkle with feta cheese.
Top with yogurt dressing and enjoy.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Recipes, Adapted from Easy Greek Salad Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: While feta cheese is the star of any Greek salad, this recipe contains all of the must-have ingredients for a classic salad that is sure to please.

steps: Combine lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onion, and cheese in large serving bowl. Whisk together oil, lemon juice, oregano, and salt in small bowl.
Pour over lettuce mixture; toss until coated. Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (North Carolina Cooperative Extension Wayne County)
desc_en: Lemon pepper seasoning and garlic salt give a flavor punch to this mushroom, carrot, and green bean side dish.

steps: Place green beans and carrots in 1 inch of boiling water. Cover, and cook until tender but still firm. Drain.
Add oil to heated skillet. Sauté onions and mushrooms until almost tender. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in green beans, carrots, lemon pepper, garlic salt, and toasted almonds. Cover and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods Adapted from a recipe in Healthy Diabetes Recipes and More South Dakota Diabetes Control Program)
name_fr: Gratin de riz aux haricots verts
name_latin: Roz bel loubya khadra fel ferran
desc_en: This no-fuss side dish is a great addition to any meal and can be prepared in a flash.

steps: In a medium-sized pan, cook onions in vegetable oil until they start to turn light brown.
Add the rice, green beans, tomatoes, and water.
Bring to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Quick and Healthy, Vol.II ScaleDown Publishing, Inc.)
desc_en: Jazz up green beans with mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a quick and easy vegetable side dish.

steps: Spray a skillet with non-stick cooking spray.
Sauté onions, mushrooms, and garlic.
Add green beans and heat thoroughly.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Cookbook for African American Populations)
name_fr: Haricots verts et pommes de terre nouvelles
desc_en: Frozen green beans and potatoes are boiled in a pot with onion and salt to make an easy side dish for dinner.

steps: Add all ingredients to a large stock pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and reduce to medium heat.
Cook until green beans and potatoes are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
name_en: Green Beans with Tomatoes and Basil
name_latin: Loubya khadra bel matecha o hbeq
desc_en: Green beans get a flavor boost from fresh or dried parsley and basil, canned tomatoes, and onion.

steps: Cook beans in a large saucepan of boiling water for 5 minutes; beans will still be crisp. Drain and rinse under cold running water. Set aside.
In a large frying pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add tomatoes, basil and parsley. Cook 3 minutes to heat and combine flavors.
Stir beans into pan and cook 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper (optional).

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: In the spring, in areas where they grow, wild onions can be used in place of green onions. Yellow or white onions work as well.

steps: Open and drain can of sliced potatoes. Cut sliced potatoes into strips.
In a large skillet over medium heat, lightly brown potatoes in the vegetable oil for 5 to 10 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, add egg, egg whites, milk, and salt. Mix well
Stir in turkey ham, tomatoes, and green (or wild) onions.
Pour egg mixture over potatoes in the skillet.
Cover skillet and continue to cook eggs over medium heat until firm, not runny (about 8 minutes).
Cut the omelet into four pieces and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by the Lipton Teas and Infusions & AHA, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
name_fr: Smoothie thé vert, fruits rouges et banane
name_latin: Smoothie atay khder bel tout o banan
desc_en: A small handful of ingredients makes a big splash in this smoothie. The smoothie looks deep purple, but you can definitely taste the green tea thanks to the strong brew. Enjoy it as an on-the-go breakfast, a refreshing afternoon snack or a sweet ending after a meal.

ingredients.en: Bananas, peeled, cut in half and frozen

ingredients.fr: Graines de chia ou de lin

steps: Add the water to a small saucepan. Bring the water to a boil over high heat. Remove the pan from the heat.
Add the tea bags. (Be sure the tea bags are submerged.) Let steep for 4 minutes. Discard the tea bags.
Let the tea mixture cool for 30 minutes. Pour into a water pitcher. Refrigerate for 2 hours, or until chilled.
In a food processor or blender, process the tea, berries, bananas, yogurt, gingerroot and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into four glasses. Sprinkle with the chia seeds.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Grilled Asparagus and Shrimp Quinoa Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
name_fr: Salade de quinoa aux asperges et crevettes grillées
name_latin: Chladat quinoa bel asparagus o qemroun mechwi
desc_en: Grilling brings out the flavor in fresh vegetables like asparagus. Add shrimp, quinoa, and refreshing lemon vinaigrette, and you have a delicious and quick spring or summer salad.

steps: Place vinaigrette ingredients in a small bowl and whisk; set aside.
Cut vegetables as directed.
Heat grill and grilling tray.
Place vegetables and shrimp in a large bowl; add about 1/3 of the vinaigrette (about 3 tablespoons) and toss.
Spread shrimp-vegetable mixture over hot grilling tray.
Grill, turning shrimp and vegetables, until the flesh of the shrimp is an opaque color (about 5 to 6 minutes); remove from grill.
Serve grill mixture over cooked quinoa, and drizzle with vinaigrette.
للصلصة: خلطي معلقة صغيرة قشرة الحامض، 3 معالق عصير الحامض، 3 معالق زيت العود، معلقة صغيرة موطارد، نص معلقة زعيترة ونص معلقة إبزار.
طيبي 260 غ كينوا (غسليها قبل) ف500 مل ما 15 دقيقة.
قطعي 300 غ أسبارݣوس قطع ديال 5 سم، نص فلفلة مقطعة، حبة تومة مدقوقة و420 غ قلب القوق ديال البواطة مصفي.
فطبسيل كبير خلطي الخضرة مع 340 غ قمرون مقشر وثلث الصلصة.
فرشيهم على صينية الشواية ولا مقلة كبيرة سخانة.
شويهم وقلبيهم 5 حتى 6 دقايق حتى يولي القمرون أبيض ووردي.
قدمي الخضرة والقمرون فوق الكينوا وصبي باقي الصلصة.
tips: القمرون كيطيب دغيا، ما تخليهش أكثر من 6 دقايق.
كتاكل سخونة ولا باردة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This grilled cheese packs an unexpected twist with the sweetness of canned peaches! Not only is this sandwich a quick and easy lunch, but also a fun way to add more fruit and veggies to your day.

steps: Heat the 4 teaspoons of vegetable oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Place 4 slices of whole grain bread in the pan.
Layer (in this order) one slice of cheese, a handful of spinach, 4 to 6 peach slices, another slice of cheese, and a slice of bread on top of each original slice of bread.
After 4 to 5 minutes, flip each sandwich and cook another 4 to 5 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Quinoa Pilaf
name_fr: Pilaf de quinoa au poulet grillé et avocat
name_latin: Quinoa bel djaj mechwi o avoka
desc_en: This pilaf recipe pairs avocados and bell peppers with red quinoa and grilled chicken, for a satisfying, colorful meal.

steps: Heat grill.
Peel and cut avocado into chunks; place in a medium bowl.
Mix lemon juice, basil, an 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Drizzle over avocado chunks, toss, and set aside.
Cut chicken breasts in half crosswise.
Mix 1/2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and remaining black pepper. Brush mixture on chicken and red bell pepper.
Grill chicken and pepper until done. Set chicken breasts aside. Cut pepper into thin strips.
While chicken and peppers are grilling, heat remaining olive oil in a large pan, add garlic and onion, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add water, bouillon, and quinoa to pan; bring to boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer until liquid is absorbed and quinoa is cooked (about 15 to 20 minutes).
Place quinoa pilaf in a large bowl and add chicken, red peppers, and avocado. Toss gently.
قشري أفوكا وقطعيها كوبات وحطيها فطبسيل. خلطي 2 معالق عصير الحامض، 40 غ حبق مقطع ونص معلقة إبزار، وصبيهم فوق الأفوكا وقلبي بشوية.
قطعي 2 صدور ديال الدجاج على جوج. خلطي نص معلقة زيت العود، ربع معلقة ملحة وباقي الإبزار ودهني بيهم الدجاج وفلفلة حمرا.
شوي الدجاج والفلفلة على الشواية ولا مقلة سخانة حتى يطيبو. قطعي الفلفلة شرائح رقاق.
فطنجرة سخني باقي الزيت، زيدي حبة تومة مدقوقة ونص بصلة مقطعة وطيبيهم 5 دقايق.
زيدي 720 مل ما، 3 معالق صغار مرقة الدجاج بودرة و260 غ كينوا. خليها تغلي، غطي، نقصي النار وخليها 15 حتى 20 دقيقة حتى تشرب الما.
حطي الكينوا فطبسيل كبير، زيدي الدجاج مقطع، الفلفلة والأفوكا وخلطي بشوية.
tips: غسلي الكينوا مزيان قبل باش ما تبقاش مرة.
زيدي الأفوكا فالأخير باش ما تتهرسش.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Best of La Cocina GOYA: Healthy, Tasty, Affordable Latin Cooking/ Lo Mejor de la Cocina GOYA: Cocina Latina Saludable, Rica y Económica GOYA Foods)
name_en: Grilled Fish Tacos with Peach Salsa
name_fr: Tacos de poisson grillé, salsa de pêche
name_latin: Tacos hout mechwi b salsa khoukh
desc_en: Set the stage for a delicious plate with these healthy fish tacos with peach salsa. Perfect for a summertime taco night!

steps: In a medium bowl, stir together chopped peaches, bell pepper, onions, jalapenos, cilantro, and lemon juice
Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
tips: For the Salsa: For the Fish: - Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Using paper towels, pat fish dry, transfer to plate. - In a small bowl, stir together chili powder, low-sodium adobo and Sazon packet. - Rub fish with spice mixture to coat completely. - Place fish on hot greased grill grates. - Cook, flipping once until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork (145 °F), about 8 minutes. - Thinly slice fish. - To serve, fill each tortilla with 1/2 fish fillet and about 1/3 cup of salsa.

steps: للصالصا: فطبسيل خلطي 400 غ خوخ ديال البواطة مقطع، نص فلفلة حمرا مقطعة صغيرة، نص بصلة حمرا مقطعة صغيرة، فلفلة حارة مقطعة صغيرة، معلقة قزبور مقطع و2 معالق صغار عصير الحامض. غطي وخليها فالثلاجة.
رشي 4 فيلي تيلابيا بمعلقة كبيرة شيلي مطحون وشوية توابل.
شوي الحوت على الشواية ولا مقلة سخانة بشوية زيت 3 حتى 4 دقايق من كل جهة حتى يتفتت بالفرشيطة.
سخني 14 طورطيا صغيرة فمقلة ناشفة.
فتتي الحوت، حطيه فالطورطيا مع الصالصا ديال الخوخ من الفوق.
tips: الصالصا الحلوة ديال الخوخ كتمشي مزيان مع الحوت الحار.
زيدي شوية خس محكوك وكريمة إلا بغيتي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Fruit kabobs cooked on the grill make a tasty and healthy dessert.

steps: Place fruit chunks on a skewer to make kabobs.
Grill or broil on low heat until the fruit is hot and slightly golden.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: Grilled lamb is delightful with any green salad, especially this Asian-inspired version.

ingredients.en: Leg of lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes
Shredded Savoy, Napa, or green cabbage

steps: Mix marinade/dressing ingredients; divide evenly.
Place lamb cubes in a glass dish; pour half of the marinade/dressing over the lamb.
Cover and refrigerate at least two hours.
In a large bowl, toss cabbage, carrots, jicama (optional), onions, and sesame seeds.
Remove lamb and discard marinade.
Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes; divide lamb among the 4 skewers.
On hot grill, cook the lamb skewers 5 to 6 minutes per side (or to desired degree of doneness).
Remove lamb from skewers, add to salad, and toss.
To serve, divide salad evenly on four plates. Drizzle with remaining dressing.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Grilled Pineapple Ginger Glazed Chicken with Zucchini and Peppers
name_fr: Poulet grillé glacé ananas-gingembre, courgettes et poivrons
name_ar: دجاج مشوي بالأناناس والسكنجبير مع الݣرعة والفلفلة
name_latin: Djaj mechwi bel ananas o skenjbir
desc_en: Fresh pineapple chunks and an easy glaze made with pineapple juice add tropical and zingy flavors to grilled chicken.

steps: To make the glaze, combine pineapple juice, vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, ginger and mustard in a medium saucepan set over medium-high heat.
Bring to a boil; boil for about 15 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium heat. Cook couscous according to package directions.
While couscous is cooking, toss chicken breast with oil, salt and pepper.
Grill chicken, for 2 minutes per side or until grill-marked. Continue to grill, basting and turning with Pineapple Ginger Glaze, for 5 to 6 minutes or until cooked.
Grill onion, zucchini, red pepper, orange pepper and pineapple spears, basting with Pineapple Ginger Glaze, for 3 to 5 minutes or until grill-marked and tender.
Serve chicken with vegetables and pineapple over couscous.
Garnish with green onions.
للصلصة: فطنجرة حطي 220 مل عصير الأناناس، 40 مل خل التفاح، 3 معالق سكر أحمر، معلقة ونص صوجا، معلقة سكنجبير مدقوق ومعلقة موطارد. خليها تغلي 15 دقيقة حتى تخثر.
طيبي 180 غ كسكسو كامل.
خلطي 450 غ صدر الدجاج مع معلقة زيت العود، ربع معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
شوي الدجاج على شواية ولا مقلة سخانة 2 دقايق من كل جهة، ثم كملي 5 حتى 6 دقايق وانتي كتدهنيه بالصلصة وتقلبيه.
شوي بصلة مقطعة، 2 ݣرعات خضر مقطعين طول، فلفلة حمرا، فلفلة برتقالية و8 قطع أناناس، ودهنيهم بالصلصة، 3 حتى 5 دقايق.
قدمي الدجاج مع الخضرة والأناناس فوق الكسكسو، ورشي بصلة خضرا مقطعة.
tips: الصلصة فيها السكر، ما تخليهاش تحرق على النار القوية.
ممكن تشوي كلشي فالفرن على 220 درجة إلا ما عندكش شواية.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health)
name_en: Grilled Shrimp with Cantaloupe Avocado Salsa
name_latin: Qemroun mechwi b salsa dellah o avoka
desc_en: Savory sweet salsa featuring cantaloupe and avocado is the perfect complement to grilled shrimp.

ingredients.en: Unsalted canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Preheat grill.
Slice lime in half. In a small bowl, squeeze juice from one half of lime; reserve other half for garnish.
Add remaining salsa ingredients and gently mix.
Peel shrimp, leaving the tails on.
Skewer shrimp on bamboo skewers.
In a small dish mix together canola oil and garlic. Coat shrimp with oil-garlic mix.
Grill 4 to 5 minutes or until cooked.
To serve, top shrimp with salsa, garnish with lime wedges.
سخني الشواية ولا مقلة كبيرة.
قطعي ليمة على جوج. عصري نص فطبسيل وخبي النص الآخر.
زيدي أفوكا مقطعة كوبات، 300 غ دلاح أصفر مقطع، 40 غ بصلة حمرا مقطعة، 170 غ لوبيا كحلة مصفية، ربع معلقة ملحة، ربع معلقة إبزار و2 معالق قزبور، وخلطي بشوية.
قشري 450 غ قمرون وخلي الذيل.
دخلي القمرون ف4 عيدان بروشيت.
خلطي معلقة زيت مع حبة تومة مدقوقة ودهني بيها القمرون.
شويه 4 حتى 5 دقايق حتى يطيب.
قدمي القمرون مع الصالصا من الفوق وقطع الليم.
tips: القمرون كيطيب دغيا، ملي يولي وردي وملوي راه طاب.
الصالصا كتمشي حتى مع الحوت المشوي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Grilled Steak and Peppers Salad with Pears
name_fr: Salade de steak grillé, poivrons et poires
name_latin: Chladat steak mechwi bel felfla o bou3wid
desc_en: Grill whole bell peppers along with steak, then add pear slices, and you have the foundation of a delicious and colorful Italian-influenced salad.

ingredients.en: 100% white grape juice or apple juice
ingredients.fr: Jus de raisin blanc ou de pomme

steps: In a small bowl, whisk olive oil, vinegar, grape or apple juice, salt, and herb blend.
Boil water and cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain pasta, rinse in cool water.

Heat grill, rub peppers with 1/2 tsp olive oil. Grill whole peppers, turning as needed, until skin begins to brown and bubble. At the same time, grill beef sirloin to 145 °F, turning once. Remove from grill, let cool slightly.
Slice peppers into strips, discarding seeds and stem. Cut sirloin across the grain into thin slices. Slice pears into thin wedges.
Toss arugula and pasta in large bowl.
To serve, evenly divide pasta-arugula onto four plates, arrange beef, peppers, and pears on top, drizzle with vinaigrette, and sprinkle with crumbled Gorgonzola cheese.
للصلصة: خلطي معلقة زيت العود، 3 معالق خل، 40 مل عصير العنب ولا التفاح، ربع معلقة ملحة ومعلقة كبيرة أعشاب إيطالية.
طيبي 200 غ مقارونة (ملوية) وصفيها وغسليها بما بارد.
سخني الشواية ولا مقلة كبيرة. دهني فلفلة صفرا وفلفلة حمرا بنص معلقة صغيرة زيت وشويهم كاملين وقلبيهم حتى تحمر القشرة. فنفس الوقت شوي 340 غ ستيك البݣري وقلبيه مرة حتى يطيب. خليهم يبردو شوية.
قطعي الفلفلة شرائح وحيدي الزريعة. قطعي الستيك شرائح رقاق ضد الخيوط. قطعي 2 بوعويدات شرائح رقاق.
خلطي 180 غ روكيط مع المقارونة فطبسيل كبير.
قسمي الشلاضة على 4 طبسيلات، رتبي فوقها اللحم والفلفلة والبوعويد، صبي الصلصة ورشي 30 غ فرماج أزرق مفتت.
tips: إلا ما بغيتيش الفرماج الأزرق، استعملي الفيتا.
شلاضة كاملة ديال الصيف.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Connecticut Food Policy Council)
desc_en: Veggies are wrapped in foil and cooked on the grill for an easy side dish to your cookout. Don't have a grill? This recipe can also be made in the oven.

steps: Heat grill to medium heat or 350 °F.
Wash vegetables and slice.
Toss in a large bowl. Add dressing and toss until all vegetables are coated.

Tear 2 large squares of aluminum foil and place half of the vegetable mixture on each piece. Place an equal piece of foil over the top of vegetable mixture and fold bottom piece with top sheet to form a packet.
Place on heated grill for 20 to 30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. If you don't have a grill, bake Veggie Packets in the oven at 400 °F for 20 to 30 minutes.
Before you open the packets, poke holes in the foil with a fork. Be very careful opening the foil as the steam will be very hot and could burn you!
Empty vegetables onto serving plate or serve from foil packets.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC))
desc_en: Cooking out tonight? Try cooking vegetables coated in oil and garlic on the grill for a delicious side dish. If you don't have a grill, you can make these vegetables in the oven.

steps: Mix oil and garlic in a large bowl. Add vegetables and toss.
Place vegetable on broiler pan or grill. Cook 10 minutes, turning twice until vegetables are tender.
Place vegetables on platter. Serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simply Good Eating Recipe Cards, Vol. 1, 2000 University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Ground beef and canned tomato soup make a tasty base for the vegetables in this delicious and hearty stew.

ingredients.en: Ground beef, or ground turkey, or venison

steps: Brown meat. Drain fat, if any. Season lightly with salt and pepper (optional).
Add soup and 1 can of water to fry pan. Add vegetables.
Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, about 25 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat, cover for last 10 minutes to thicken.
Serve. Refrigerate leftovers.
حمري 230 غ كفتة ديال البݣري (ولا الديك الرومي) وصفي الشحمة. زيدي رشة ملحة وإبزار.
زيدي 55 غ شوربة الماطيشة المركزة (ولا 150 مل صلصة ماطيشة) و300 مل ما فالمقلة. زيدي 6 خيزوات، 2 حبات بطاطا و150 غ بصلة مقطعين.
خليها تغلي ثم تطيب مغطية 25 دقيقة حتى تطيب الخضرة. حيديها من النار وخليها مغطية 10 دقايق باش تخثر.
قدمي.
tips: قطعي الخضرة كوبات صغار باش تطيب دغيا.
زيدي كامون وفلفلة حلوة وقزبور للطعم المغربي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (5 A Day: Eat 5 to 9 Fruits and Vegetables US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion)
desc_en: Chili powder and lime juice provide a zesty dressing to this salad, which is full of root vegetables.

steps: Combine romaine lettuce and cilantro, and divide onto four plates.
Place parsnips, carrots, and turnips into 1 quart of boiling water. Return water to a simmer, cook vegetables for 2 minutes. Strain into a colander.
Mix ingredients for the dressing right before use.
Place hot vegetables on top of greens and top with homemade dressing.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from "Easy and Healthy Black Bean Soup" Bronson Wellness Center Bronson Healthcare - Michigan)
desc_en: This soup is full of flavor and is so easy to prepare. Using canned beans and salsa, along with cumin and cilantro, this soup is a great way to throw dinner together in minutes.

ingredients.en: Low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Lightly purée one can of black beans with broth, salsa, and cumin in a blender.
In a medium saucepan, combine puréed bean mixture with remaining beans and heat through.
To serve, ladle soup into 4 bowls.
Top each bowl with one tablespoon of sour cream and garnish with the cilantro.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: This tasty and satisfying soup can be served for lunch or dinner. The leftovers can be frozen for later.

ingredients.en: Beef round roast, thawed and chopped

steps: In a large pot, brown beef in oil over medium to high heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain fat.
Add water, squash, onion, celery, garlic, and oregano. If using parsley, add that too. Mix well.
Bring pot to a boil. Lower heat and cook for 20 minutes.
Add macaroni, tomatoes, green pepper, salt, and pepper.
Keep cooking over low heat for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
name_fr: Purée de pommes de terre riche
desc_en: Turn ordinary mashed potatoes up a notch with garbanzo beans for extra protein and fiber!

steps: Place the potatoes in a large sauce pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat then reduce to a simmer.
Add the garbanzo beans 10 minutes after potatoes start cooking. Continue cooking until potatoes are fork tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain water and place the sauce pan back on the stove. Mash the beans and potatoes using a potato masher or hand beaters.
Add the milk, cheese and seasonings.
Reheat if necessary. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Easy to make and delicious to eat, this soup can be made in under an hour! Squeeze the other half of the lime over the soup before serving for extra flavor.

steps: In a large pot cook onion, garlic and tomatoes on medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Stir often.
Add beans, potatoes and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low-medium heat. Cover and continue to cook slowly for 20 minutes.
Add cilantro, cumin and lime. Stir and continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve warm; sprinkle cilantro on top.
فطنجرة كبيرة طيبي بصلة مقطعة، 4 حبات تومة مدقوقة و410 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة على نار متوسطة قوية 3 دقايق، وحركي.
زيدي 840 غ لوبيا كحلة، 2 حبات بطاطا مقطعة و960 مل ما. خليها تغلي ثم نقصي النار. غطي وخليها تطيب 20 دقيقة.
زيدي 75 غ قزبور مقطع، ربع معلقة كامون وعصير نص ليمة. حركي وخليها 10 دقايق أخرى.
قدميها سخونة مع القزبور من الفوق.
tips: شوربة بلا لحم لكن مشبعة بزاف باللوبيا.
زيدي شوية فلفلة حارة إلا بغيتيها حارة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Seafood Nutrition Partnership)
name_en: Hearty Salmon Skewers over Brown Rice
name_fr: Brochettes de saumon sur riz complet
desc_en: Created for junior chefs, this simple and delicious recipe skewers just three ingredients -- omega-3-rich salmon, cherry tomatoes, and pineapple -- for a quick dinner served over whole grain brown rice.

ingredients.en: Kosher salt, freshly ground pepper, and paprika

steps: Cook rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Clean fish and pat dry.
Cut salmon into 24 1/2-inch cubes and coat all sides with topping of kosher salt, freshly ground pepper, paprika, or any desired spice.
Cut fruit into cubes and cut tomatoes in half. Set aside.
Slide piece of salmon onto skewer, then tomato, then fruit. Repeat 3 times on each skewer (or until skewer is full).
Heat 1/2 cup of canola oil in large skillet over medium-high heat for one minute.
Place skewers in pan and turn every 2 minutes per side. Squeeze lemon on skewers as they are cooking.
To serve, place 1/2 cup rice on plates and with 2 skewers on top. Squeeze a hint of lemon, if desired.
طيبي 370 غ روز كامل وخليه لجنب.
نشفي 450 غ سالمون وقطعيه 24 كوبة ديال 2 سم. رشي عليه ملحة، إبزار وفلفلة حلوة.
قطعي 150 غ أناناس كوبات و3 حبات ماطيشة صغيرة على جوج.
فكل عود بروشيت (8 عيدان) دخلي سالمون، ثم ماطيشة، ثم أناناس، وعاودي 3 مرات.
سخني شوية زيت فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة قوية.
حطي البروشيتات فالمقلة وقلبيهم كل 2 دقايق، وعصري الحامض فوقهم وهما كيطيبو.
قدمي نص كاس روز فكل طبق مع 2 بروشيتات، وشوية حامض من الفوق.
tips: السالمون كيطيب دغيا، 6 حتى 8 دقايق كافيين.
ممكن تشويهم على الشواية ولا فالفرن.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (North Dakota State University Extension Service)
name_fr: Soupe de bœuf aux légumes copieuse
desc_en: Frozen vegetables, canned tomatoes, and chicken broth make this an easy soup to throw together on a cold work night. Noodles and beef make it extra hearty and comforting.

steps: Heat broth and water. Add vegetables, meat, and seasonings. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and boil gently, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
Add noodles. Cook until noodles are tender, about 10 minutes
Remove bay leaf. Serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service)
name_en: Hearty Vegetable Salad with Herb Dressing
name_fr: Salade de légumes copieuse aux herbes
desc_en: Make this vegetable salad ahead of time and allow the flavors to blend in the refrigerator for a few hours before serving.

steps: In large bowl, combine all salad ingredients.
In a small jar with a tight fitting lid, combine all dressing ingredients and shake well.
Pour dressing over vegetables and stir to coat vegetables. Cover; refrigerate 1 to 4 hours to marinate, tossing occasionally.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Versatile and easy to prepare, these deviled eggs are great as an appetizer, side dish, or snack.

steps: Put eggs into a saucepan. Cover with cold water.
Bring eggs to a simmer (small bubbles) and cook for 12 minutes.
Remove from the heat and drain.
Crack eggs under cold water and allow to cool. Remove shells.
Split eggs in half, lengthwise and remove yolks.
Put yolks, dressing and mustard into a small zipper-lock plastic bag to mix.
Cut a small hole in a lower corner of the bag. Squeeze mixture into egg white halves. Garnish as desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eat for Health Toolkit Recipe by Missouri Nutrition Network)
desc_en: Prepare this marinated beef the night before, and have dinner on the table in less than half an hour!

ingredients.en: Beef chuck shoulder steak, cut 1-inch thick

steps: Mix onion, parsley, vinegar, mustard, garlic powder, and basil or thyme.
Place meat in plastic bag and pour in marinade.
Close bag securely, place in a bowl and marinate in refrigerator six to eight hours or overnight, turning at least once.
Pour off marinade and discard. Place meat on rack in broiler.
Broil 15 to 20 minutes or until desired doneness, turning once.
Cut into thin slices to serve.
خلطي 40 غ بصلة مقطعة صغيرة، 2 معالق معدنوس، 2 معالق خل أبيض، 3 معالق صغار موطارد، ربع معلقة تومة مطحونة وربع معلقة حبق يابس.
حطي 450 غ ستيك البݣري (كتف، غليض 2 سم) فميكة وصبي عليه الشرمولة.
سدي الميكة وخليها فالثلاجة 6 حتى 8 سوايع ولا ليلة كاملة، وقلبيها مرة على الأقل.
صفي الشرمولة وحطي اللحم على شبكة الفرن تحت الݣريل.
شويه 15 حتى 20 دقيقة وقلبيه مرة، على حسب الطياب اللي بغيتي.
قطعيه شرائح رقاق وقدميه.
tips: الشرمولة الطويلة كتطري اللحم.
خلي اللحم يرتاح 5 دقايق قبل ما تقطعيه.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Nebraska Recipe Collection Staff from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln Cooperative Extension)
name_fr: Salade de pommes de terre aux herbes
desc_en: Dried herbs and spices make this zesty side dish a family favorite!

steps: Scrub potatoes and cut into cubes.
Place in medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 12 minutes or until potatoes are done. Drain.
Mix dressing ingredients.
Combine hot potatoes, dressing, radishes, basil, thyme, and onion powder. Serve hot or cold.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Bank of Delaware)
desc_en: This recipe is a quick and easy way to use up leftover brown rice!

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Drain canned spinach to remove liquid.
Combine spinach with remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add to a 8x8 inch baking dish. You may also use a 9x3 inch baking dish, but the spinach bake will be thinner.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes, or until set.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: A creamy, savory, dip that can be prepared in under 5 minutes! Enjoy!

steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend all the ingredients thoroughly.
Pour the mixture into a clean container.
Cover and chill.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Bold and Beautiful Book of Bean Recipes - Washington State WIC Program Original name - Kelly's Herbed Lentils and Rice Casserole)
name_fr: Gratin de lentilles et riz aux herbes
name_latin: 3des o roz bel a3chab fel ferran
desc_en: Lentils and brown rice are combined with flavorful herbs and onions and topped with cheese for a delicious side dish.

steps: In a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish add the chicken broth, lentils, onions, brown rice, water, spices, and 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese.
Stir to combine.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 2 hours,
Check casserole after 1 hour and add more broth if it seems dry.
Remove foil and top with remaining cheese.
Bake another 2 or 3 minutes until all the cheese is melted.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_fr: Quiche aux épinards dans des champignons portobello
desc_en: Here's a savory, healthful, time-saving twist to breakfast quiche. Use portabella mushroom caps instead of high-fat pie pastry to make individual quiches.

steps: Place oven rack in center of oven; preheat oven to 375 °F.
Remove portabella stems; wipe clean with damp paper towel.
Spray baking sheet with cooking spray, and place mushroom caps on baking sheet.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together all remaining ingredients, except 1 tbsp Parmesan cheese.
Coat 10-inch non-stick pan with cooking spray and heat over medium flame.
Cook and scramble egg mixture until it just starts to thicken. Remove from heat.
Using a large spoon, scoop partially cooked, hot egg mixture into portabella caps.
Sprinkle tops with remaining Parmesan cheese. Bake about 20 minutes.
Serve immediately.
سخني الفرن على 190 درجة.
حيدي العيدان من 4 فقاعات كبار (بورتوبيلو) ومسحيهم بمنديل رطب.
دهني صينية الفرن بشوية زيت وحطي الفقاع فيها.
فطبسيل خفقي 3 بيضات، 6 بياض البيض، 55 غ شابلور، 60 مل حليب، معلقة صغيرة توابل تومة وأعشاب، 60 غ سلق مطيب ومصفي و15 غ بارميزان.
دهني مقلة بشوية زيت وسخنيها على نار متوسطة.
صبي البيض وحركيه حتى يبدا يخثر شوية. حيديه من النار.
عمري الفقاع بالبيض السخون بالمغرفة.
رشي باقي البارميزان (15 غ) ودخليهم للفرن 20 دقيقة.
قدميهم دغيا.
tips: الفقاع الكبير كيعوض العجين ديال الكيش، أخف بزاف.
ممكن تستعملي 6 بيضات كاملين بلاصة البياض.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Quick and Healthy Meals: Tips and Tools for Planning Meals for Your Family Ohio State University Cooperative Extension Cuyahoga County)
desc_en: Serve this savory side dish with your favorite entree. This recipe can be made in minutes!

steps: If using canned (low-sodium) vegetables, drain, saving 2 tablespoons liquid.
Cook onion, herbs, and garlic in the margarine/ butter in a small saucepan until onion is tender.
Stir in the vegetables and liquid or add water as needed.
Cook and stir until heated through.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eagle Adventure Recipes Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program Eagle Adventure Team)
desc_en: A cute and easy way to get kids excited about eating their veggies!

steps: Place one piece of celery in center of plate with the center facing up.
Use a butter knife to spread peanut butter on top edges.
Place second piece of celery on top, forming a log. Cut log in half.
Repeat steps 1-3 with remaining 2 pieces of celery.
Place cauliflower florets on ends of each log, securing with remaining peanut butter.
Enjoy your Hiding Rabbits.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Originally named "Yummy Bagels" Adapted from: Cooking For You or Two University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Did you know that you can make your own fresh, delicious, whole-grain rich bagels at home? This recipe makes enough to share with family and friends, or to freeze the extras.

steps: In a bowl mix sugar, yeast, water, and flours together to make dough.
Rub inside of another bowl with oil. Place dough in bowl and flip to coat with oil. Let rise 30 minutes.
Punch down dough and divide into 16 portions. Shape into a ball and poke a hole through the middle with your fingers.
Place on a well-greased baking sheet and cover with a clean dish towel to rise again for 15 to 20 minutes.
Put 2 inches of water in a pot and heat to boiling.
Using a slotted spoon, gently place each bagel into a rapidly boiling water for 1 minute on each side.
Remove and dry on a towel.
Place back on baking sheet. If desired, sprinkle bagels with cinnamon/sugar or salt.
Bake at 475 °F for 8 to 12 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Utah State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: A tangy and flavorful cranberry sauce that can be prepared in a flash!

steps: Peel orange and remove seeds.
Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until mixed well.
Heat up and serve over turkey.
For thicker sauce to do not blend just heat and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
name_fr: Purée de pommes de terre maison
desc_en: A creamy comfort food that is quick and easy to prepare!

steps: Peel the potatoes, and cut them into chunks.
Put the potatoes in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover them.
Cook the potatoes on medium heat for 15 minutes or until tender.
Remove the potatoes from the heat. Drain the water off the potatoes.
Mash the potatoes with a fork or potato masher.
Stir in enough milk to make the potatoes smooth and creamy.
Add the butter, salt and pepper.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Enjoy the freshness of a homemade pizza crust and enjoy the delicious aromas that fill your kitchen as it bakes!

steps: Mix yeast, water, salt, and oil. Add about 1 cup flour to make a stiff dough. The amount of flour may vary slightly.
Knead the dough until it is very elastic (will stretch and not make a hole).
Use a rolling pin or clean bottle to obtain even thickness.
Lay it on a greased baking sheet to rise while you prepare toppings for pizza.
Bake at 400 °F with desired toppings until crust is browned and top is bubbly.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University)
desc_en: What’s better than ranch dressing? Fresh, homemade ranch dressing! It’s the perfect addition to your salad, veggies, or just about anything you can dip!

steps: Collect and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Add the dried onion, salt, garlic powder, and dried parsley to a bowl, and stir gently to combine.
Add the Greek yogurt and buttermilk, and stir until spices are evenly distributed.
Chill before serving.
Keep leftovers refrigerated, and eat within 1 week.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Heart Healthy Home Cooking: African American Style US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Light and flaky biscuits make excellent additions to holiday meals and family gatherings.

steps: Preheat oven to 450 °F.
In medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
In small bowl, stir together buttermilk and oil. Pour over flour mixture and stir until well mixed.

On lightly floured surface, knead dough gently for 10 to 12 strokes. Roll or pat dough to ¾-inch thickness. Cut with a 2-inch round biscuit or cookie cutter, dipping cookie cutter in flour between cuts. Transfer biscuits to an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Michigan State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: This sweet and savory entree is packed with fiber, protein, and potassium!

steps: Combine rinsed lentils, bay leaf, and 5 cups water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and reduce heat. Simmer 30 minutes. Do not drain. After cooking, discard bay leaf.
Chop onion. Combine onions and carrots with 1 cup water. Add to lentils and stir into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Brown ground beef (if using). Drain and discard fat. Add the meat to the lentil mixture.
