Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Add garlic and stir 1 minute.
Add half the spinach and cook 1 minute.
Add remaining spinach. Cook until wilted, turning occasionally. Serve with chicken.
سخني الفرن على 200 درجة.
حطي 8 صدور ديال الدجاج بين ورقتين بلاستيك ودقيهم حتى يوليو رقاق (نص سنتيم).
غلفي الدجاج ب55 غ شابلور وحطيه فصينية الفرن مغطية بورق الألومنيوم. دخليه 10 دقايق.
حطي 220 غ موزاريلا فوق الدجاج ورجعيه للفرن 4 حتى 5 دقايق حتى يذوب الفرماج ويطيب الدجاج.
فنفس الوقت سخني معلقة زيت فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة. زيدي 4 حبات تومة مدقوقة وقلبي دقيقة.
زيدي نص من 800 غ سلق وطيبيه دقيقة.
زيدي باقي السلق وطيبيه حتى يطراو، وقلبي من وقت لوقت. قدميه مع الدجاج.
tips: الدجاج الرقيق كيطيب دغيا وكيبقى طري.
السلق كينقص بزاف ملي كيطيب.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Washington State University Extension)
desc_en: Try the original recipe using our Better Baking Mix, or try one of the variations with fruit and spice for a wonderful fresh baked treat.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Grease 12-cup muffin pan.
Mix the Better Baking Mix and sugar in a bowl.
Beat the egg with a fork.
Add egg, oil, and water to dry ingredients. Stir just until all ingredients are wet.
Spoon into the prepared muffin pan.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking Demo II Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
desc_en: Prepare this hearty soup with vegetable broth if you desire it to be vegetarian or vegan.

steps: Heat oil in large soup pot over high heat. Sauté onion, celery, carrots, and mushrooms until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients except for the parsley and bring to a boil.
Lower heat to a simmer and cook until the barley is tender, about 20 minutes.
Sprinkle parsley on top of soup and serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: Chopped mushrooms, when sautéed, blend seamlessly with ground meats. Swapping or adding mushrooms to a recipe can add an extra serving of vegetables to the plate.

steps: Chop mushrooms to approximate size and texture of cooked ground beef.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and mushrooms, and cook.
Sauté until ground beef is done.
Remove mushroom-beef mixture from pan.
Add onions and garlic to pan; cook until golden.
Return mushroom-beef mixture to pan, along with remaining ingredients.
Simmer about 10 minutes; remove from heat.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: Bring another serving of vegetables and important nutrients to your plate with this veggie-filled twist on classic fajitas. We've upped the vegetables ante by sautéing savory mushrooms and mixing them with steak for an umami-rich, flavorful punch. And we've sped up the preparation time for this Tex-Mex favorite, foregoing marinating the steak by using a tender cut.

steps: Slice beef across the grain into 1/4-inch strips. Place in a medium bowl with 1/2 tablespoon fiesta lime seasoning; toss to coat.
Place mushrooms, peppers, and onion and remaining fiesta lime seasoning in a large bowl; toss to coat.
Heat oil in large, non-stick skillet. Add beef strips; cook about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from skillet.
Place coated vegetables in skillet and sauté until vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 to 8 minutes.
Add beef back to skillet and sauté mixture 1 to 2 more minutes.
Assemble fajitas by dividing beef-vegetable mixture evenly on each tortilla, top with remaining ingredients and roll up.
قطعي 340 غ ستيك شرائح رقاق ديال نص سنتيم ضد الخيوط. حطيهم فطبسيل مع نص معلقة توابل بالليم وقلبي.
فطبسيل كبير خلطي 450 غ فقاع مقطع، 150 غ فلفلة خضرا، فلفلة حمرا وفلفلة صفرا مقطعين شرائح، وبصلة مقطعة، مع باقي التوابل.
سخني معلقة زيت العود فمقلة كبيرة. زيدي شرائح اللحم وطيبيها 3 حتى 4 دقايق. خرجيها.
حطي الخضرة فالمقلة وقلبيها 5 حتى 8 دقايق حتى تطراو شوية.
رجعي اللحم للمقلة وقلبي دقيقة ولا جوج.
قسمي الخليط على 8 طورطيات كاملة، زيدي ماطيشة مقطعة، خس محكوك ومعلقة كريمة حامضة، ولفيهم.
tips: سخني الطورطيا فمقلة ناشفة ثواني قبل ما تعمريها.
الفقاع كيخرج الما، خليه يطيب حتى يتبخر.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (North Dakota Food and Culture: A Taste of World Cuisine North Dakota State University Extension Service)
desc_en: Enjoy the amazing smell coming from your grill as you make this delicious naan. Be sure to savor the delicious flavor and texture while it is still warm!

steps: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand about 10 minutes, or until frothy.
Stir in sugar, milk, egg, salt, and enough flour to make a soft dough.
Knead for 6 to 8 minutes on a lightly floured surface or until smooth.
Let it rise 1 hour until the dough has doubled in volume.
Punch down dough and knead in garlic.
Pinch off small handfuls of dough about the size of a golf ball.
Roll into balls and place on a tray.
Cover with a towel and allow to rise until doubled in size, about 30 minutes.
During the second rising, preheat grill to high heat.
At grill side, roll one ball of dough out into a thin circle.
Lightly oil grill. Place dough on grill and cook for two to three minutes or until puffy and lightly browned.
Brush uncooked side with butter and turn over.
Brush cooked side with butter and cook until browned, another 2 to 4 minutes.
Remove from grill and continue the process until all the naan has been prepared.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cans Get You Cooking)
name_fr: Fettuccine au thon à la napolitaine
desc_en: Did you know that canned tomatoes have more lycopene and B vitamins than fresh tomatoes? That’s because the canning process seals in food’s natural goodness! So when you add canned tomatoes to this delicious dish, you’re adding nutrition, freshness and flavor.

ingredients.en: Canned tuna, packed in water, drained

steps: Cook fettuccine as label directs. Reserve 1 cup cooking liquid; drain.

Meanwhile, in 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook onion and garlic, about 5 minutes until just softened. Add diced tomatoes and capers; simmer 5 minutes. Add tuna, olives, salt, and pepper to taste.
Toss fettuccine with tuna mixture to mix well. Serve immediately. If necessary, add reserved cooking liquid.
طيبي 220 غ مقارونة فيتوتشيني كاملة. خبي كاس من الما ديال الطياب وصفي.
فمقلة على نار متوسطة سخني معلقة زيت العود، زيدي بصلة مقطعة و2 حبات تومة مدقوقة، طيبيهم 5 دقايق حتى يطراو. زيدي 410 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة و2 معالق صغار كبار، وخليها 5 دقايق.
زيدي 140 غ طون مصفي، 40 غ زيتون مقطع، ملحة وإبزار.
خلطي المقارونة مع الطون وقدمي دغيا. زيدي شوية من ما الطياب إلا كانت ناشفة.
tips: الطون ديال البواطة فالما أخف من ديال الزيت.
ما تطيبيش الطون بزاف باش ما ينشفش.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Stay Young at Heart: Cooking the Heart-Healthy Way US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Spice up your week with these delicious New Orleans Red Beans. Season with hot sauce if desired.

steps: Pick through beans to remove bad beans; rinse thoroughly.

In a large pot combine beans, water, onion, celery, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and cook over low heat for about 1-1/2 hours until beans are tender. Stir. Mash beans against side of pan.
Add green pepper, garlic, parsley, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Cook, uncovered, over low heat until creamy (about 30 minutes). Remove bay leaves.
Serve with hot cooked brown rice, if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Buy Better. Eat Better. Montana State University Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Sweet breakfast cookies that can be prepared in advance for breakfast on the go.

steps: Heat honey and peanut butter in a medium saucepan over low heat. Stir until blended.
Remove from heat. Stir in dry milk.
Fold in cereal and raisins. Drop by heaping tablespoons onto waxed paper to form mounds.
Cool to room temperature. Store in refrigerator.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Favorite Recipes for Family Meals Washington State University Extension)
desc_en: Boiled instead of baked, these chewy cookies are full of peanut butter, cocoa, oats, and raisins. Yum!

steps: In large sauce pan, bring the first six ingredients to a full, rolling boil for 1 minute, stirring as needed.
Remove from heat. Add oats, dry milk, and raisins and vanilla to boiled mixture.
Mix well.
Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper and let stand until cool, about 15 to 20 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Utah State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Full of fruit and oat bran, these tasty muffins can be enjoyed as a snack or a dessert.

ingredients.en: Raisins, dates, or other dried fruit

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F.
Mix the first four dry ingredients. Set aside. Mix the egg with orange juice, milk, and oil. Mix fruit and blend with dry ingredients.
Add the liquid ingredients to the dry until it is moist.
Spray muffin tin with a non-stick coating. Pour batter into muffin tins.
Bake for 15 to 17 minutes. Remove muffins from pan after 10 minutes. Cool on a rack. Freeze muffins for later use.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Futures Virginia Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: These oat snack cakes are full of whole grains and flavor, making them perfect for sharing with friends and family.

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F. Mix together oatmeal, flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Combine oil, vanilla, egg whites, and water. Stir into dry ingredients and raisins, mixing only until it holds together.
Place balls on baking pan (sprayed with non-stick cooking spray) and press out slightly to about 1/4 inch in thickness.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool, then store in an airtight container.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking Up Fun - Yeast Breads Cornell University Cooperative Extension Division of Nutritional Sciences)
desc_en: Packed with whole grains, this tasty bread is perfect as a snack topped with jam or peanut butter.

steps: Combine rolled oats and salt in a large mixing bowl. Stir in boiling water; cool to lukewarm (105 to 115 °F).
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water in small bowl.
Add yeast water, molasses, and oil to cooled oatmeal mixture. Stir in whole wheat flour and 1 cup all purpose flour. Add additional all purpose flour to make a dough stiff enough to knead.
Knead dough on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes.
Place dough in lightly oiled bowl, turning to oil top. Cover with clean towel; let rise in warm place until double, about 1 hour.
Punch dough down; turn onto clean surface. Shape dough and place in greased 9x5 inch pan. Cover with clean towel; let rise in a warm place until almost double, about 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375 °F. Bake 50 minutes or until bread sounds hollow when tapped. Cover with aluminum foil during baking if bread is browning too quickly. Remove bread from pan and cool on wire rack.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: What's better than a toasty muffin right out of the oven? Enjoy these oatmeal raisin muffins with your breakfast or as a snack or dessert.

steps: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Put the egg, milk, and oil in a small mixing bowl. Slowly stir them together.
In a large mixing bowl, mix the flour, oatmeal, sugar, baking powder, salt, and raisins. Stir until they are mixed.
Pour the egg-milk-oil mix into the large bowl with the dry ingredients.
Stir until the dry ingredients are barely moistened. Do not over-mix (the batter should be lumpy).
Grease each cup in the muffin pans with some margarine or butter.
Spoon the batter into the cups in each muffin pan, until each cup is half-full with batter.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the muffins are golden brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ohio Commission on Minority Health)
desc_en: Spicy and flavorful, this is an amazing side dish that doubles easily. Double up and enjoy it with a crowd during the summer months when okra is in season.

steps: In a large heavy pan sauté onions in oil until golden brown.
Add remaining ingredients and about 1/4 cup of water. Simmer over low heat, covered, until greens are tender.
Squeeze on lemon juice before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simply Good Eating Recipe Cards, Vol. 1, 2000 University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: This old fashioned bread pudding can be made in the microwave so you don't have to turn on the oven. Enjoy!

steps: Spread one side of bread with margarine or butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Cut into 1-inch cubes.
In lightly sprayed casserole dish, combine bread, sugar, and raisins. Then follow microwave or oven method below.
tips: Microwave method: - In bowl, blend eggs, milk, salt and vanilla. Pour liquid over bread mixture; lightly blend. - Cover, microwave on HIGH for 5 minutes. Turn dish 1/4 turn. Microwave on HIGH for 3-5 minutes longer (pudding is done when edges are firm and center is almost set). - Let sit covered for 10 minutes before serving. Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers. Oven method: - Preheat oven to 350 °F. In bowl, blend eggs, 2 cups (instead of 1 1/4 cups for microwaving) milk, salt, and vanilla. Pour liquid over bread mixture; lightly blend. - Bake uncovered for 1 hour (pudding is done when a table knife inserted in the pudding comes out clean). - Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Some call it dressing, while others call it stuffing. Either way, you'll call it delicious! Enjoy this old fashioned dressing with your next holiday meal or as a family-friendly side dish.

steps: Toast bread cubes and set aside for later use.
Melt margarine or butter in medium size fry pan.
Add celery and onion; cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add parsley, mushrooms, seasoning, and broth. Cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add the toasted bread cubes. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Serve immediately.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health)
name_en: One-Dish Roasted Potatoes and Apples with Chicken beef sausage
name_fr: Pommes de terre, pommes et saucisse de poulet rôties
name_latin: Btata o tfah o mergaz djaj fel ferran
desc_en: A scrumptious and easy one-dish baked meal that's perfect for chilly fall and winter evenings.

ingredients.en: Red potatoes or your favorite potato variety

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F.
Cut potatoes into chunks, place in 2-quart baking dish.
Drizzle with canola oil. Toss to coat.
Roast potatoes in oven for about 20 minutes.
While potatoes are roasting, cut apples and onions into chunks, and beef sausage into 1/2-inch slices.
Remove baking dish from oven and reduce heat to 375 °F. Add all remaining ingredients to baking dish and toss.
Return baking dish to oven and roast an additional 30 minutes until apples and potatoes are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kentucky Families on the Move: Food and Nutrition Calendar, 2005 University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension Service)
name_fr: Poulet et pommes de terre en une poêle
name_latin: Djaj o btata f meqla wahda
desc_en: This is an easy and flavorful one pan meal. Salsa adds an extra kick to the dish.

steps: Cook potatoes as directed.
In a large skillet, brown chicken in oil on high for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes; cook until potatoes are lightly browned.
Add salsa and corn. Cook until heated through.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Perfect for a busy weeknight, this one pan spaghetti dish has grains, vegetables, meat, and dairy. Enjoy it with a side of fruit.

steps: Brown meat and onions in a large skillet over medium-high heat (300 °F in an electric skillet). Drain fat.
Stir in water, tomato sauce, and spices; bring to a boil.
Add spaghetti, cover pan, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking.
When spaghetti is tender, top with grated cheese.
Refrigerate leftovers with in 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Try this quick one-pan meal may soon become a family favorite.

steps: In a large skillet or pot, brown ground turkey and cook onion. When done, use paper towel to soak up any grease.
Add remaining ingredients except cheese and mix together.
Heat until very hot.
Top with cheese before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by the Florida Department of Citrus, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
name_en: Orange and Honey Glazed Brussel Sprouts
desc_en: This spin on a classic dish combines 100% orange juice and Brussels sprouts to help replenish essential nutrients like vitamin C, potassium and folate. Great for entertaining or as a weeknight side.

ingredients.en: Olive oil or oil of choice

steps: Preheat oven to 450ºF with a large, rimmed baking sheet placed on the middle rack.
Add Brussels sprouts to a large bowl, and toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Remove baking sheet from oven, and carefully arrange Brussels sprouts cut side down on the sheet. Return to oven, and roast until golden, about 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the sprouts are baking, in a small saucepan over medium-high heat, combine orange juice, apple cider vinegar, honey and chili paste.
Bring to a boil and cook for 5 to 10 minutes, until reduced and syrupy. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.
Place sauce in a large bowl and add roasted Brussels sprouts. Toss to combine. Transfer to a serving plate and top with lemon zest.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipe Collection University of Nebraska at Lincoln Nebraska Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: The perfect treat to end a hot summer day. Toss the ingredients in the blender and enjoy!

steps: Put all ingredients in a blender and mix well.
Add more liquid if you want the drink thinner.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This cold orange drink can be enjoyed for breakfast or at any time of the day.

steps: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor.
Secure lid and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Fruity and flavorful, this delightful juice is full of fruit, honey, and cinnamon. Enjoy!

steps: Blend at high speed in blender until frothy.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of the Virgin Islands, Cooperative Extension Service 4-H/Family & Consumer Sciences Program)
name_fr: Ailes de poulet glacées à l'orange
desc_en: Orange marmalade seasons these delightful skinless chicken wings. Enjoy this appetizer with brown rice and grilled or roasted veggies.

steps: Rinse chicken wings and dry on paper toweling. Tuck the wing tip under the larger joint to form a triangle.
Heat butter in skillet (200 °F on temperature controlled gas burner).
Sprinkle wings with seasoned salt and place in heated butter. Sauté on temperature controlled gas burner (325 °F) until evenly brown on both sides, about 20 minutes.
Spread with orange marmalade, continuing to sauté while basting frequently for another 20 minutes.
Remove from skillet. Serve hot.
Hold at serving temperature on automatic burner or in 'Keep-Warm' oven set at 170 °F. They will be glazed and "sticky" good.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
name_fr: Courge au miel et à l'orange
desc_en: Orange juice, honey, butter, and spices are the perfect pairing for acorn squash. Enjoy this recipe with your favorite protein foods.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Cut squash in half. Remove seeds and place halves in shallow baking pan.
Combine orange juice and honey. Mix well. Put some of the orange juice/honey mixture in each squash cavity.
Add 1 tablespoon of the margarine to each squash half. Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.
Cover pan with aluminum foil to keep steam in and speed cooking.
Bake 30 minutes. Remove foil and continue baking 30 minutes more, or until squash is tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simply Seniors Cookbook Utah State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Sweet potatoes and oranges are a wonderful pairing to beef steaks. Enjoy this flavorful dish with a side of brown rice.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a medium skillet, brown beef steaks in a small amount of oil.
Cut sweet potato into 1/2-inch slices.
Place meat and sweet potato slices in a baking dish and top with orange slices; sprinkle with seasonings if desired.
Cover and bake for 1 hour until meat is tender.
Cook beef to 145 °F.
سخني الفرن على 180 درجة.
حمري 2 ستيكات ديال البݣري فمقلة بشوية زيت من الجهتين.
قطعي بطاطا حلوة شرائح ديال 1 سم.
حطي اللحم والبطاطا الحلوة فطبق الفرن، وفوقهم شرائح نص لتشينة، رشة قرفة، ملحة وإبزار.
غطي وخليه فالفرن ساعة حتى يطيب اللحم مزيان.
tips: الغطاء مهم باش يبقى اللحم طري.
الطعم ديال اللتشين مع القرفة كيمشي مزيان مع البطاطا الحلوة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (ChopChop Family)
name_fr: Galettes de pommes de terre au four
desc_en: These potato pancakes are easily baked in the oven and offer a healthier version of a traditional Hanukkah recipe.

steps: Preheat the oven to 425 °F. Lightly oil the baking sheets by spreading the oil around with your clean hand or a paper towel.
Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt in a small bowl.
Use the large holes on your grater to grate the potato, then grate the onion too.
Put the potato and onion mixture in the colander inside the sink. Using a paper towel, press the potato mixture down to squeeze out and blot up some of the extra moisture. Stir it and blot again.
Put the potato mixture in the large bowl, add the egg, and stir well. Add the flour mixture and stir it very well.

Use a spoon or your fingers to pluck a clump of the potato mixture from the bowl and spread it into a round, flat nest on the oiled baking sheet: it should make a circle that's about 3 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick. Repeat to fill the sheet. (You don't need to leave space between them.)
Bake until the bottoms are deeply golden, 15 to 20 minutes, then turn the pancakes over and put them back in the over for 10 more minutes.
Serve the latkes with applesauce and yogurt (optional).

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Maryland Cooperative Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
name_fr: Frites de patate douce au four
desc_en: Sweet potato fries are a quick and delicious way to add flavor and color to your dinner plate.

steps: Wash and peel sweet potatoes. Cut into 1/4 inch slices.
In a large bowl, toss slices in olive oil until coated. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake at 425 °F until tender and golden brown (about 20 minutes), turning occasionally to brown evenly.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: Oven fried fish pairs well with fresh summer vegetables or hearty root vegetables in the winter.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a small bowl, add egg, salt (if desired), and pepper and beat together.
Place the bread crumbs in a separate bowl. Dip fish fillets in the egg mixture, then dip in the bread crumbs to coat.
Melt butter in a shallow 9x13 inch baking pan for 1 minute in the oven. Tilt pan to coat with butter.
Arrange fish fillets in the pan.
Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve topped with lime or lemon slices (optional).

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Stay Young at Heart: Cooking the Heart-Healthy Way US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Yucca is a starchy vegetable with a taste and texture similar to while potatoes. Enjoy this yucca side dish with one of your favorite protein- or vegetable-based entrees.

ingredients.en: Yucca cut into 3-inch sections and peeled

steps: In a kettle, combine the yucca with enough cold water to cover it by 1 inch. Bring the water to a boil, and slowly simmer the yucca for 20 to 30 minutes, or until it is tender.
Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Transfer the yucca with a slotted spoon to a cutting board. Let it cool and cut it lengthwise into 3/4-inch wide wedges, discarding the thin woody core.

Spray cookie sheet with the nonstick cooking oil spray. Spread yucca wedges on cookie sheet and spray wedges with cooking oil spray. Cover with foil paper and bake for 8 minutes. Uncover and return to oven to bake for an additional 7 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Illinois Extension Illinois Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: A simple, roasted chicken is perfect for dinner any time of the year.

steps: If chicken is frozen, thaw in the refrigerator 24 hours before cooking.
Place chicken on a pan or plate while thawing in the refrigerator.
Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Remove necks and giblets from chicken cavity, if present before cooking. Reserve for another use.
Place chicken, breast side up, in a roasting pan.
Brush chicken skin with Italian dressing and sprinkle with garlic salt.
Stuff lemon or orange into chicken cavity.
Roast 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer inserted into chicken thigh registers 165 °F.
Let chicken set for 15 minutes after removing from the oven before carving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: This simple and delicious vegetable dish is perfect with your favorite entrée.

steps: Preheat the oven to 450 °F.
In a small bowl, mix the oil, lemon juice, herbs, salt, and pepper.
Wash, peel, and cut the fresh vegetables to get 3 cups cut-up vegetables.
Spread vegetables on baking sheet pan.
Pour the oil mixture over the vegetables and mix together.
Bake for 20 minutes. Stir after the first 10 minutes of baking.
Serve the vegetables while they are still hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_fr: Porridge de la veille aux fruits rouges
desc_en: A mixture of milk, yogurt, and raspberries combine with dry oats to become a smooth make-ahead breakfast. Just mix and refrigerate overnight for the next day.

steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract in a container or jar with a lid.
Add oats and mix well.
Gently fold in raspberries.
Cover and refrigerate 8 hours to overnight.
Enjoy cold or heat as desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Lake Family Resource Center Be-Fresh Program)
desc_en: Overnight soaking cuts down on prep time in the morning, so you can enjoy a healthy and hearty, cooked breakfast, even after hitting the snooze button.

steps: Put all ingredients in a cooking pot and cover. Let sit overnight in refrigerator.

In the morning, put on a stove burner and cook on medium heat until simmering, then turn on low and heat for 10 to 15 minutes more or less depending on type of oats -- quick (5 minutes), regular, or steel cut.
Serve warm with a little milk (or milk alternative), a drizzle of maple syrup, and a side of fresh fruit, if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_en: Pan Roasted Tilapia with Tomatillo Salsa
name_latin: Hout tilapia fel meqla b salsa khadra
desc_en: Tilapia fillets are pan-fried until golden brown and served with a fresh salsa made from roasted tomatillos, serrano peppers, lime, and cilantro.

steps: To prepare the tomatillos, peel back the husk from the smooth green tomatillo skin. Rinse the tomatillos with warm water and cut into quarters. (Canned tomatillo salsa can be used instead of fresh.)

Place the husked tomatillos, onion, chilies, garlic, and 1 teaspoon oil in the baking pan, stir well and transfer to the oven. Roast about 20 minutes until the tomatillos are soft and dark green. Set aside to cool.
Transfer the mixture to the blender; add the salt, lime juice, and cilantro. Purée.
tips: Preheat the oven to 450 °F. To make the tomatillo salsa: To cook the tilapia: - Place the skillet on the stove over high heat and when it is hot, carefully add 2 teaspoons oil. - Put the tilapia fillets in the pan, waiting about 30 seconds between additions. Cook about 5 to 6 minutes, until golden brown on both sides. - Transfer the tilapia to the serving plate and top with generous amounts of salsa. Serve right away.

steps: للصالصا: قشري 450 غ طوماطيو (ولا ماطيشة خضرا)، غسليهم بما دافي وقطعيهم على ربعة.
حطيهم فطبق الفرن مع 75 غ بصلة مقطعة، 2 فلفلات حارة، 3 حبات تومة ومعلقة صغيرة زيت. حركي ودخليهم للفرن على 200 درجة 20 دقيقة حتى يطراو ويولي لونهم أخضر غامق. خليهم يبردو.
حطيهم فالخلاط مع ربع معلقة ملحة، معلقة عصير الليم و40 غ قزبور، وخلطي.
سخني 2 معالق صغار زيت فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة قوية. حطي 4 فيلي تيلابيا وطيبيهم 3 حتى 4 دقايق من كل جهة حتى يحمرو ويتفتتو بالفرشيطة.
قدمي الحوت مع الصالصا الخضرا من الفوق.
tips: إلا ما لقيتيش طوماطيو، استعملي ماطيشة خضرا ولا صالصا خضرا ديال البواطة.
الصالصا كتبقى 3 أيام فالثلاجة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Washington State University Extension)
desc_en: Using a pre-made baking mix -- like our Better Baking Mix -- is a great shortcut to making homemade pancakes!

steps: Put all the ingredients in a bowl.
Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients.

Preheat skillet on medium-high heat. The skillet is ready when drops of water "dance" on the dry surface. Add a teaspoon of vegetable oil or use cooking oil spray. For each pancake, pour 3 to 4 tablespoons of batter onto hot skillet.
Cook slowly until the surface is covered with bubbles. Turn and cook until second side is lightly browned.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Creative Vegetable Cookery North Dakota State University Extension Service)
desc_en: A quick, delicious, cruciferous delight. Try this recipe with green or purple cabbage, or a mixture of the two.

steps: Melt butter or margarine in a heavy saucepan or skillet.
Add cabbage and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add water.
Cover pan with a tight-fitting lid to hold in steam.
Cook over low heat until cabbage is tender (6 to 8 minutes), stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Add lemon juice and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Arkansas Cooperative Extension Service Expanded Food and Nutrition Education Program (EFNEP))
name_latin: Khbizat bel parmesan o besla khadra
desc_en: Enjoy these savory biscuits with your favorite holiday meal.

steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Stir together to mix well. Do not over mix.
Turn out onto a floured board. Roll to a 1-inch thick square.
Cut into 12 squares. Bake on a cookie sheet, spaced slightly apart, in a 400° F oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Give (these) peas a chance! Try varying this recipe by using other types of cheese or adding different seasonings.

ingredients.en: Cans of peas, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat margarine or butter in a medium skillet over medium heat (300 °F in an electric skillet). Add peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until peas are heated through.
Add lemon juice and pepper and mix well. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve warm.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Bronson Wellness Center Bronson Healthcare - Michigan)
name_latin: Pesto ma3dnous o louz o hamed
desc_en: Instead of basil, this recipe uses fresh parsley to make a pesto that is simply delicious!

steps: In a food processor, combine the almonds, cheese, parsley, and lemon juice.
Slowly pour in oil and mix it into the rest of the ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: If you're looking for delicious ideas for turnips, you've come to the right place! This recipe is full of vegetables and flavor, blended together to create a hearty, satisfying soup.

steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and celery and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, salt, and pepper; cook for1 minute.
Stir in the parsnips, potato, broth, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer for 20 minutes or until the parsnips and potatoes are soft.
Stir in the margarine or butter and let the soup sit uncovered for 5 minutes.
Purée the soup in batches in a blender, using the manufacturer's directions for puréeing hot liquids.
Heat the soup before serving, stirring in water if it seems too thick.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids… Get Cooking! California Department of Health Services California Children’s 5-A-Day Power Play Campaign)
desc_en: A tasty and colorful dish that the whole family will enjoy. Use whatever frozen veggies you have on hand.

ingredients.en: Vegetables such as carrots, broccoli, and cauliflower, thawed

steps: Heat a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Add ground turkey and paprika. Cook and stir until meat is brown and no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, chicken broth and pasta. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer until pasta is almost tender, about 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove lid. Place vegetables on top of pasta. Replace lid. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Prepare the Tasty Topping. Mix parsley, bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle over vegetables in skillet. Cover and let sit for 3 minutes before serving.
سخني مقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة. زيدي 230 غ كفتة الديك الرومي ومعلقة صغيرة فلفلة حلوة. قلبي 5 دقايق حتى تحمر.
زيدي 55 غ ماطيشة مهرسة، 280 مل مرقة الدجاج و200 غ مقارونة (فرطيطو). خليها تغلي، نقصي النار، غطي وخليها 10 حتى 15 دقيقة حتى تقرب المقارونة تطيب.
حيدي الغطاء، حطي 450 غ خضرة (خيزو، بروكلي، شيفلور) فوق المقارونة، غطي وخليها 5 دقايق حتى تطيب الخضرة.
للزواق: خلطي 75 غ معدنوس مقطع، 30 غ شابلور و30 غ بارميزان. رشيهم فوق الخضرة، غطي وخليها 3 دقايق قبل التقديم.
tips: كلشي فمقلة واحدة، ما كاين لا سلق لا صحون بزاف.
الخضرة المجمدة كتمشي مزيان هنا.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Prairie Fare North Dakota State University Extension Service)
desc_en: Passover is a Jewish holiday observed in the springtime, but this fruity and delectable dessert is good any time of the year. If you do not wish to eat cornstarch feel free to substitute instant tapioca pudding in equal amounts.

steps: In a shallow 2-quart baking dish, combine 1 1/4 cups sugar and cornstarch*. Add rhubarb, raspberries, and lemon juice - mixing gently but thoroughly.
Meanwhile, in a food processor or a bowl, whirl or rub together with your fingers the matzo meal, the remaining 1/2 cup sugar, margarine, and nutmeg to create fine crumbs.
Squeeze matzo mixture to compact into lumps, then crumble over rhubarb mixture.
Baked in a 375 °F oven until cobbler is bubbling in center and top is golden brown, about 1 hour. Let cool 15 minutes.
Spoon cobbler into bowls and top with sorbet or whipped cream (optional).
tips: If you do not wish to eat cornstarch feel free to substitute instant tapioca pudding in equal amounts.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This rich red sauce combines ground beef, carrots, celery, onion, and tomatoes with a touch of milk for added creaminess. This sauce is slow simmered and delicious served over any favorite pasta.

steps: Put skillet on the stove over medium heat and when it is hot, add oil.
Add carrot, celery, and onion and cook about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown.

Raise the heat to high. Pinch off tablespoon-sized pieces of the beef and add a few at a time, stirring well between additions. Cook, breaking the meat apart until it is no longer raw, starts to give off liquid, and no longer clumps together, about 10 minutes.
Add the water, tomatoes, and tomato paste, stirring well. Cook about 10 minutes until the sauce begins to thicken.
Slowly stir in the milk, a little bit at a time. Turn the heat down to low and cook 45 minutes until all the liquid has been absorbed.
tips: Bolognese Sauce: Pasta: - Fill a large pot halfway with water. Bring it to a boil over high heat. - Add the pasta and about 12 minutes cook until just tender. - Drain the pasta and divide into 4 bowls. - Top each bowl with about 3/4 cup Bolognese and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese. - Serve right away.

steps: سخني معلقة زيت فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة.
زيدي خيزوة، عود كرافس وبصلة مقطعين صغار وطيبيهم 10 دقايق حتى يبداو يحمرو.
طلعي النار. زيدي 340 غ كفتة ديال البݣري قطعة قطعة وحركي، وفتتيها حتى تطيب وما تبقاش ملصقة، تقريبا 10 دقايق.
زيدي 240 مل ما، 800 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة و60 غ طوماطيش مركز، حركي. خليها 10 دقايق حتى تبدا تخثر.
زيدي 240 مل حليب بشوية وانتي كتحركي. نقصي النار وخليها 45 دقيقة حتى يشرب الما كامل.
قدميها فوق 220 غ مقارونة كاملة مطيبة مع 30 غ بارميزان.
tips: الحليب كيعطي الطراوة للصلصة، هادي هي الطريقة الإيطالية الأصلية.
الصلصة كتبقى 3 أيام فالثلاجة وكتولي أبنن.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_en: Pasta with Chickpeas, Tomato, and Spinach
name_fr: Pâtes aux pois chiches, tomate et épinards
name_latin: Mqarouna bel hommos o matecha o selq
desc_en: Chickpeas, tomatoes, spinach, and a hint of rosemary make this delicious pasta dish. Served warm with a sprinkle of Parmesan, this quick and easy recipe makes a perfect weeknight meal.

steps: To cook the pasta, fill the pot halfway with water. Bring it to a boil over high heat. When the water is boiling, add the pasta and cook until just tender, about 12 minutes. Just before draining, reserve 1 1/2 cups of the pasta water. Drain the pasta and set aside.

While the pasta is cooking, cook the sauce: Put the skillet on the stove over medium-low heat and when it is hot, add the oil. Add the garlic, onion, carrots, celery, and rosemary and cook until the garlic is golden, about 15 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and using the fork, lightly mash half of them. Add the reserved pasta water and tomatoes and cook 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach to the skillet mixture and cook until the spinach is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed by the pasta, about 10 minutes. Add the red pepper flakes, if desired.
Mix well and serve immediately, garnished with Parmesan cheese.
طيبي 220 غ مقارونة كاملة فما مغلي 12 دقيقة. قبل ما تصفيها خبي 360 مل من الما ديالها. صفي.
فنفس الوقت سخني معلقة زيت فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة هادية. زيدي 2 حبات تومة مدقوقة، بصلة، 2 خيزوات وعود كرافس مقطعين ونص معلقة أزير. طيبيهم 15 دقيقة حتى تصفار التومة.
زيدي 400 غ حمص مصفي وهرسي النص منو بالفرشيطة. زيدي ما المقارونة و400 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة وطيبي 10 دقايق.
زيدي المقارونة و120 غ سلق وطيبي 10 دقايق حتى يطراو السلق ويشرب أغلب الما. زيدي نص معلقة فلفلة حارة مهرسة إلا بغيتي.
خلطي وقدمي دغيا مع 30 غ بارميزان.
tips: الحمص المهرس كيخثر الصلصة بلا كريمة.
طبق كامل بلا لحم، غني بالبروتين.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Eating Recipes University of Nebraska Cooperative Extension)
name_fr: Frittata de pâtes aux petits pois
desc_en: Perfect for any meal of the day, this easy and flavorful frittata is quick and easy to prepare.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and place in a 9-inch pie plate that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Combine eggs, seasonings, cheese, and peas. Spread the egg mixture over the top of the spaghetti so the mixture covers the frittata and some of it sinks between the spaghetti strands.
Bake for 20 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let frittata stand 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Tomato Variation: Instead of mixing 1 cup of peas with the egg, seasonings, and cheese mixture, sprinkle the chopped tomatoes evenly over the top of the frittata before putting it in the oven.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eat Smart. Be Fit. University of Maryland Extension)
name_en: Pasta with Greens, Beans, and Chicken
name_fr: Pâtes au poulet, verdure et haricots
name_latin: Mqarouna bel djaj o khodra o loubya
desc_en: Loaded with protein and fiber, this delicious dish can be made quickly. Enjoy with a side of your favorite fruit.

steps: Cook the pasta according to directions on box, and drain.
On medium heat, add vegetable oil and onion to a large pan.
Cook for 5 minutes, add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Stir in chopped chicken and cook until heated through.
Add spinach (or chard), beans, chicken or vegetable stock, and spices.
Add in cooked pasta and stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, until pasta is heated through.
Add salt and pepper, to taste (optional), and garnish with Parmesan cheese before serving (optional).
طيبي 450 غ مقارونة كاملة وصفيها.
فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة سخني معلقة زيت وزيدي نص بصلة مقطعة.
طيبيها 5 دقايق، زيدي 3 حبات تومة مدقوقة وطيبي دقيقة.
زيدي 280 غ دجاج مقطع وطيبيه حتى يسخن (ولا يطيب إلا كان نيء، 7 دقايق).
زيدي 360 غ سلق مقطع، 430 غ لوبيا بيضا مصفية، 280 مل مرقة الدجاج ومعلقة صغيرة أعشاب إيطالية.
زيدي المقارونة وحركي.
طيبي 5 دقايق حتى يسخن كلشي.
زيدي ملحة وإبزار ورشي البارميزان.
tips: طبق كامل فمقلة واحدة: مقارونة، بروتين وخضرة.
ممكن تبدلي السلق بالكرومب كال ولا البروكلي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: This recipe is quick and easy to prepare and will become a favorite in your home.

steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Add frozen vegetables during the last 5 minutes of cooking time.
Drain pasta and vegetables and set aside.
Bring the spaghetti sauce to a boil over medium heat.
Stir in the pasta and vegetables.
Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Use whole grain pasta to boost the fiber in this tasty spring salad.

steps: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse in cold water to stop cooking and prevent sticking. Drain.
Cook vegetables until just tender. Drain and cool.
Combine cold pasta, vegetables, envelope of soup mix and salad dressing.
Top with sliced eggs and cheese.
Refrigerate until time to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education, Adapted from Pasta Primavera ONIE Project)
name_fr: Pâtes primavera à la sauce tomate
desc_en: This recipe is quick and easy to prepare and will become a favorite in your home.

steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Add frozen vegetables during the last 5 minutes of cooking time.
Drain pasta and vegetables and set aside.
Bring the spaghetti sauce to a boil over medium heat.
Stir in the pasta and vegetables.
Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Utah State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: A flavorful spring recipe that you and your family will savor. Use your favorite spring vegetables from your garden or local farmers market: kohlrabi, sugar snap peas, carrots, and asparagus are all delicious options.

steps: Cook noodles according to package directions.
While noodles are cooking, heat oil in a skillet.
Add vegetables and sauté until tender; stir constantly.
Add tomato and sauté 2 more minutes.
Toss vegetables with noodles and margarine.
Add seasonings; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit)
name_fr: Salade de pâtes, vinaigrette aux herbes
name_latin: Chladat mqarouna bel vinaigrette o a3chab
desc_en: This recipe starts with whole wheat pasta and includes fresh broccoli, tomatoes, carrots, and hard-cooked eggs. Tossed with a refreshing vinaigrette flavored with basil, oregano, and garlic salt, this classic salad is a go-to recipe for an appetizer, main dish, or as a side.

ingredients.en: Uncooked whole wheat pasta, cooked, drained

steps: Whisk dressing ingredients in a small bowl until blended.
Combine pasta, broccoli, tomato, and carrot in a large bowl; toss. Pour dressing over pasta mixture; toss until evenly coated. Add eggs; toss briefly.
Refrigerate, covered, at least 4 hours to blend flavors.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Easy and Nutritious Family Recipes University of California Cooperative Extension Fresno County)
desc_en: Easy and delicious, make this tasty pasta salad for your next picnic.

steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain and place in bowl or pan.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Cool in refrigerator before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart Being Active Recipes Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: Try this tasty salad with whole grain pasta in your favorite shape. Enjoy with family and friends at your next gathering.

steps: Mix all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Mix again before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Originally named Uncooked Tomato Sauce Farm Fresh Summertime Recipes Connecticut Food Policy Council)
desc_en: Combine fresh veggies from your garden or the farmers' market with pasta to make this your new favorite summer recipe.

steps: Chop tomatoes and mix with all the remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Let the mixture stand at room temperature for about 20 minutes. Toss with cooked pasta and top with grated cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Westmoreland County Pennsylvania SNAP-Ed Program)
desc_en: While avocados tend to get all the guacamole glory, sometimes they’re not available, not ripe, or just too expensive! Check out this tasty, bright, and satisfying recipe that put the humble green pea in the leading role.

steps: Mash peas until smooth.
Add the lime juice, tomato, onion, green chilies, cilantro, garlic, salt (if using), and black pepper. Mix well.
Serve with an assortment of raw vegetables and whole-grain tortilla chips.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking Matters Colorado)
desc_en: Enjoy this gorgeous, bright green pesto on your favorite protein food or pasta.

steps: For the pesto, add peas, Parmesan cheese, basil, spinach, walnuts and garlic into a food processor or blender.
Add in water, oil, salt and pepper. Blend until the ingredients are combined to form a thick sauce.
Place pesto in an airtight container. Refrigerate until needed.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipes and Tips for Healthy, Thrifty Meals USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This delicious dessert is the perfect ending to any meal. This recipe is simple to prepare and the dish is satisfying to taste.

ingredients.en: Peaches, in light syrup , drained, sliced

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly grease 9x9x2 inch casserole dish.
Combine peaches, apples, vanilla, and cinnamon in a bowl. Toss well and spread evenly in greased casserole dish.
Combine flour and sugar in small bowl. Cut in margarine with two knives until the mixture resembles coarse meal.
Sprinkle flour mixture evenly over fruit.
Bake until lightly browned and bubbly, about 20 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: On a hot summer day, freeze the drained peaches (or fresh) for at least 45 minutes before preparing this sweet and tangy drink.

steps: Put the ingredients in a blender. Blend well.
Sprinkle with nutmeg if you like.
Serve cold.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: The perfect dessert when peaches are in season. Simple to prepare but absolutely scrumptious.

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Slice the peaches.
Spread the peach slices on the bottom of the baking pan.
Melt the margarine in a saucepan.
In a small bowl, mix everything but the peaches. Stir until the mix is well blended.
Sprinkle the oat mix on top of the peaches.
Bake for 20 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This simple peach sauce recipe is the perfect complement to your favorite dishes. Sweet peaches and aromatic cinnamon enhance savory dishes when topped on grilled chicken, or add extra sweetness and fruit to waffles, pancakes, and yogurt.

steps: Drain peaches and pour into a medium saucepan with cinnamon.
Cook on low to medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes.
Mash to desired consistency with either a potato masher or wooden spoon.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (SNAP4CT UConn Health SNAP-Ed)
name_fr: Pitas beurre de cacahuète et pêche
name_latin: Pita b zebdat kawkaw o khoukh
desc_en: Packed with fresh fruit, this pita pocket makes a wonderful breakfast, lunch, or snack. If you don't have peaches, try with plums or nectarines.

steps: Cut pitas in half to make 4 pockets and warm in the microwave for about 10 seconds to make them more flexible.
Carefully open each pocket and spread a thin layer of peanut butter on the inside walls.
Fill with a combination of apple, banana, and peach slices. Serve at room temperature.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Peachy pops will be the perfect partner to your playful summer picnic. Enjoy these frosty treats on a hot day.

steps: Use a knife to remove the skin from the peaches, and to chop the peaches.
Spoon the peaches into each of the 6 paper cups.
Place the yogurt in a medium mixing bowl.
Slowly pour and stir the orange juice into the yogurt. Mix well.
Pour some of the juice and yogurt mix into each cup to cover the peaches.
Place a spoon in the center of each cup.
Cut 6 squares of aluminum foil big enough to cover the tops of cups. Stab each spoon handle through each piece of foil. The foil will hold the spoon in the center of the cup.
Place cups in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
Just before serving, peel the paper cups away from the pops to eat.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (CSAAC (Community Services for Autistic Adults and Children))
name_fr: Wraps beurre de cacahuète et pomme
name_latin: Wrap b zebdat kawkaw o tfah
desc_en: Quick, filling, and delicious, these wraps can be made in a flash and enjoyed right away or packed away for lunch at school or work.

steps: Lay tortilla flat and spread peanut butter over 2/3 of the tortilla leaving edges at sides
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons granola over peanut butter.
Cut apple slices into small chunks and place them on top of the granola.
Fold over the edges of the tortilla and roll up "burrito style."
Eat and Enjoy.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Nebraska Cooperative Extension)
name_latin: Shake ftour b zebdat kawkaw o banan
desc_en: Hurried in the morning? Need breakfast to be made at breakneck speed? Toss all of the ingredients in the blender and enjoy this shake on the go.

steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a tall glass and garnish with a sprinkle of cocoa powder, if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This delicious blend of milk, yogurt, bananas, and peanut butter makes for a filling breakfast on-the-go. Cocoa powder lends a touch of sweet that also hits the spot as an afternoon snack.

steps: Peel bananas, chop into small pieces and place in freezer until hard.
Gather all ingredients and put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses. Serve right away.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: This treat can be made with your kids in the morning, then frozen for an afterschool snack.

steps: Peel bananas. Spread the entire outside of each banana with peanut butter.
Roll the bananas in crushed nuts, sprinkles or other items.
Cut the bananas in one inch slices.
Store in the refrigerator or freezer until ready to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service)
desc_en: For a peanut butter extravaganza, spread smooth or chunky peanut butter on top of a slice of this delicious bread! Top with banana or strawberry slices.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly grease or spray with non-stick spray, a loaf pan.
In large bowl, beat eggs. Add milk, sugar, and peanut butter. Mix well.
In a separate bowl combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix thoroughly.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients. Mix only enough to moisten all ingredients.
Pour into prepared pan. (Pan will be half full.) Bake for 1 hour.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
name_fr: Barres de céréales au beurre de cacahuète
desc_en: These bars make a great on the go snack to satisfy a sweet tooth. Trying adding pumpkin seeds, chia seeds, or chopped nuts to add a little extra crunch.

ingredients.fr: Raisins secs ou autres fruits secs

steps: In a saucepan, bring honey to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and stir in peanut butter.
Add cereal, oats and raisins; mix well. Remove from heat
Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking pan. Press mixture into pan. When cool, cut into 16 bars.
Store in an airtight container for up to a week.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Enjoy these nutty muffins with a touch of jelly or jam for a satisfying dessert.

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Line 12 muffin cups with paper baking cups (or grease the bottom of each cup with butter or margarine).
Put the peanut butter and honey in a mixing bowl. Beat until well blended.
Add the eggs 1 at a time, beating well after each egg.
Add the milk, and mix well.
Add the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir just until they are moistened. Don’t stir them too much.
Fill each muffin cup 2/3 full.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
Put on a wire rack.
Cool for at least 10 minutes before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Power of Choice USDA Food and Nutrition Service and US Department of Health and Human Services Food and Drug Administration (FDA))
name_fr: Sandwich beurre de cacahuète et fruits
desc_en: A filling, fruity, and nutty sandwich that you and your children will enjoy.

steps: Spread 2 tablespoons peanut butter on bread.
Place fruit slices on top.
Optional: Top with grated carrot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit)
name_latin: Wrap kawkaw o khoukh o ananas
desc_en: Inspired by an all-time favorite, peanut butter and jelly sandwiches, this wrap is easy and fun for kids to make. With the sweet flavor of fruit and the crisp texture of green pepper and lettuce, it's a great way to fit one cup of fruit and veggies into a "wrap 'n go" meal.

steps: In a medium bowl, combine peaches, pineapple, bell pepper, and cinnamon.
Warm the tortillas.
Spread 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on one side of each tortilla, leaving room on the edges.
Spoon equal portions of the peach mixture over peanut butter, then top with lettuce.
Fold the side and bottom edges of each tortilla toward the middle over the filling, then roll so the tortilla covers the filling.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by Potatoes USA, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
desc_en: A hearty stew combining creamy peanut butter, hearty vegetables, and spices. Perfect for a chilly evening, it brings the warmth of garlic, ginger, and cumin to your table for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.en: Yellow or red potatoes, peeled, halved, and cut into quarters

steps: Heat oil over medium heat in a pot and add onions. Cook for a few minutes.
Add ginger and garlic. Cook for 1-2 minutes. Add cumin and salt.
Add peanut butter, tomato paste, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil and add potatoes.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender and cooked through.
Add kale, and continue to cook for 1-2 minutes,
Serve garnished with lime zest, lime juice, and crushed peanuts; drizzle with Sriracha for a spicy kick (optional)

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
name_latin: Merqa bel kawkaw o btata hlowa
desc_en: A spicy and savory one pot dish that the whole family will enjoy. Add some cayenne pepper for an extra kick.

steps: Combine first 9 ingredients in a soup pot. Bring to boil, then turn down to medium low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter and milk. Return to gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 5 minutes.
Stir in spinach and cook until wilted, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Ladle stew into bowls and top with peanuts and green onion, if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USA Pears (recipe) and Pear Bureau Northwest (photo))
name_en: Pear Kabobs with Strawberry Dipping Sauce
desc_en: Fruity kabobs that you can enjoy for a snack or dessert. Try experimenting with different patterns and fruits.

steps: In a small bowl, combine the vanilla yogurt and strawberry preserves. Set aside.
Thread the fruits by alternating the pears, strawberries, bananas, and pineapple onto the skewers.
Serve the fruit skewers with a dollop of the strawberry sauce on the side.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Delicious Heart-Healthy Latino Recipes/ Platillos Latinos Sabrosos y Saludables US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Sweet and simple, this warm and cozy dessert is the perfect end to a fall or winter meal.

steps: Peel the pears and cook in a double boiler for 15 minutes.
Mix sugar and orange juice and cook over low flame for 5 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes.
Place steamed pears on individual plates. Pour 1/4 of the juice mixture over each and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USA Pears and Pear Bureau Northwest)
desc_en: Scrumptious, sweet salsa that will be a party favorite. Use a tart apple variety for best results.

steps: Combine pear, apple, kiwifruit, and orange in a medium-sized bowl.
Pour honey and lemon juice over fruit and gently toss.
Scoop up bites of fruit salsa using bites of cinnamon graham crackers (optional).

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Pear Dish USA Pears)
name_fr: Bouquet de poires au beurre de cacahuète
name_latin: Bou3wid b zebdat kawkaw o confiture
desc_en: Beautiful, nutritious, and delicious, this open-faced sandwich is worth the extra effort.

steps: Use a flower-shaped cookie cutter to cut each slide of bread. If bread sticks to cutter, gently push the petals out with your fingers.

Wash the pear and dry it with a paper towel. Cut the pear in half, and remove the core. Cut each pear half into four slices, then cut each slice into five pieces. You will only use the center three pieces of each slice, so go ahead and eat the end pieces.

Spread 1 teaspoon of peanut butter in a circle in the center of each of the flowers. Place 3 pieces of pear on the peanut butter on each flower. Arrange the pears so the skin is facing out and the white centers are touching in the middle.
Drizzle 1/2 teaspoon of strawberry preserves in the center of each flower and over the pears.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: An easy way to add more fruit to your day is to incorporate them into your meals. Canned pears and cheese go well together in this quesadilla, with lots of added flavor from basil, onion, and pepper jack cheese.

steps: Sprinkle cheese, onion, and dried basil on half of each tortilla.
Place pear slices on top of other ingredients in each tortilla.
Brush each side of folded tortillas with olive oil.
Heat each folded tortilla in a non-stick skillet until cheese melts, about 2 to 3 minutes on each side.
Cut quesadilla into four pieces and serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: A cute and fruity "rabbit" snack that kids can help make.

steps: Place 2 pear halves, flat side down, on a small plate to make the body.
Use butter knife to cut a tail, ears and feet from another pear half. Add each part to the body.
Use butter knife to cut one raisin in half and place on small end for eyes.
Enjoy your pear rabbit!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Get your servings of fruits and veggies in one dish! This salad is sweet and tangy with a yogurt and orange juice dressing. Serve it as a side salad to complement another entree, or have it alone for a healthy snack option!

steps: Put salad greens, chopped vegetables, pears, nuts and raisins in a large salad bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together vinegar, yogurt, and orange juice to prepare dressing.
Stir dressing into salad mix. Serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USA Pears and Pear Bureau Northwest)
desc_en: Creamy peanut butter, crunchy celery, and juicy pears make the perfect snack for kids and adults.

steps: Spread the peanut butter into the center of the celery pieces.
Place the pear chunks on top of the peanut butter.
Serve on a plate and enjoy with your friends.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Simple Stuffed Peppers, Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
name_en: Peppers Stuffed with Rice and Beans
name_fr: Poivrons farcis au riz et haricots
name_latin: Felfla m3emmra bel roz o loubya
desc_en: These simple stuffed peppers are fun and flavorful. Use yellow, red, green, and orange peppers for a colorful dish.

steps: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Wash the peppers under running water.
Cut the tops off the peppers and spoon out the seeds.
Drain and rinse the black beans.
Combine the beans, rice, salsa, and salt (optional).
Spoon about 3 tablespoons of the mixture into the bottom of each pepper.
Place a slice of tomato on top of the mixture and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of cheese.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 to fill the pepper completely, but do not top with cheese.
Bake peppers for 30 minutes.
Top each pepper with 2 tablespoons of cheese and continue baking for 15 minutes more.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by Brighter Bites, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
name_en: The Perfect "Pear" and Brussels Sprout Salad
name_fr: Salade de poires et choux de Bruxelles
desc_en: This sweet and savory salad is fresh and light and sure to please! This salad "pears" perfectly as a side dish at your holiday gathering. This dish is kid-tested and mom-approved!

steps: In a large mixing bowl, add the pear, Brussels sprouts, and all other ingredients and mix until well incorporated.
Serve and enjoy!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Fluffy, pumpkin pancakes will delight your taste buds at breakfast or dinner. Top with sliced banana or applesauce.

ingredients.fr: Mélange d'épices pour tarte (cannelle, gingembre, muscade)

steps: Combine flour, brown sugar, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
In a medium bowl, combine egg, canned pumpkin, milk, and vegetable oil; mix well.
Add wet ingredients to flour mixture, stirring just until moist. Batter may be lumpy. (For thinner batter, add more milk.)
Lightly coat a griddle or skillet with cooking spray and heat on medium.

Using a 1/4 cup measure, pour batter onto hot griddle. Cook until bubbles begin to burst, then flip pancakes and cook until golden brown, 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter. Makes about 1 dozen 3 1/2 inch pancakes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: A perfect treat for pumpkin lovers. A seasonal treat for the holidays or any time of year that you're craving pumpkin.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a medium bowl, stir together the pumpkin, brown sugar, eggs, and oil. Mix well.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, oats, cinnamon, baking powder, and baking soda.
Add the pumpkin mix to the flour mix. Stir well.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter or margarine.
Pour the batter into the greased baking pan.
Bake for 30 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This recipe starts with seasoned and browned ground beef simmered with tomatoes and beans and is finished with a mix of olives and raisins. Served over rice, this flavorful dish makes a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.ar: كفتة ديال الديك الرومي ولا البݣري

steps: Cook as instructed on the package.
Set aside.
tips: Prepare the Rice: Prepare the Picadillo: - Place the skillet on the stove over medium heat and when hot, add oil. Add the onion, pepper, and garlic. Cook and stir about 10 minutes until the onion is softened and lightly browned. - Add oregano, cumin, pepper, and salt, and stir well. - Add beef, in small amounts. Stir well and cook about 5 minutes until the beef is cooked throughout. - Add beans and tomatoes and simmer about 15 minutes until mixture blends together. - Add olives and raisins. Stir well and cook about 2 minutes until heated through. - Serve over rice or refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 3 days. Serve with avocado, if desired.

steps: طيبي 180 غ روز كامل ف480 مل ما وخليه لجنب.
سخني 2 معالق صغار زيت فمقلة كبيرة. زيدي بصلة مقطعة، فلفلة مقطعة، 2 حبات تومة مدقوقة، معلقة ونص صغيرة أوريݣانو، معلقة صغيرة كامون، ربع معلقة إبزار وربع معلقة ملحة. قلبي 5 دقايق.
زيدي 340 غ كفتة (ديك رومي ولا بݣري) وحمريها 5 حتى 7 دقايق.
زيدي 400 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة، 400 غ لوبيا كحلة مصفية، 40 غ زيتون أخضر مقطع و40 غ زبيب. خليها تطيب 10 دقايق.
قدميها فوق الروز.
tips: الزيتون والزبيب مع بعض هما الطعم الخاص ديال البيكاديو.
كتمشي أيضا فالطاكوس ولا مع البطاطا.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (California Health Department, Los Angeles County Es Facil Campaign)
desc_en: A fun flavorful dish that is full of veggies and lean protein and can be made in a flash.

steps: Brown ground turkey in a non-stick frying pan.
Add onions, carrots, squash, potatoes, salt, pepper, and cumin. Sauté for about 5 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer, uncovered, until vegetables are tender.
Dissolve cornstarch in about 1 tablespoon of cold water, add to mixture, bring back to a boil until gravy thickens. Serve.
حمري 450 غ كفتة الديك الرومي فمقلة.
زيدي بصلة مقطعة، 5 خيزوات، 2 ݣرعات خضر و2 حبات بطاطا مقطعين كوبات، معلقة صغيرة ملحة، رشة إبزار ونص معلقة كامون. قلبي 5 دقايق.
زيدي 190 غ ماطيشة ديال البواطة وما يغمر الخضرة. خليها تغلي، نقصي النار وخليها تطيب بلا غطاء حتى تطيب الخضرة.
ذوبي معلقة صغيرة مايزينا فمعلقة ما بارد، زيديها وخليها تغلي حتى تخثر المرقة. قدمي.
tips: طبق ديال الخضرة والكفتة كيشبه للمرقة المغربية.
كيتاكل مع الروز ولا الخبز.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Latino Recipes Made with Love California Department of Health Services California Latino 5-A-Day Campaign)
desc_en: A fantastic recipe to try when your garden or market is overflowing with fresh, flavorful tomatoes!

steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ohio State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Fluffy and fruity, this airy cake is delicate and sweet, the perfect after dinner treat.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Prepare Angel Food cake recipe, steps 1-4.
Add the pineapple to the cake mix.
Pour into an ungreased 13x9 inch pan.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes, until golden brown or an inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool and serve with whipped topping (optional).

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health)
name_latin: Chladat djaj bel ananas o avoka
desc_en: Delicious sandwich, wrap, or pita filling featuring chunks of avocado, pineapple, and chicken. Avocado helps make a creamy, luscious dressing.

steps: Mash 1/2 avocado in a small dish; add yogurt, rice vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Cut remaining avocado into small chunks and mix together with pineapple, bell pepper, carrots, cabbage, green onion, and chicken.
Add dressing; mix gently.
Fill pita pockets and serve.
هرسي نص أفوكا فطبسيل صغير، زيدي 2 معالق دانون ݣريك، معلقة خل الروز، ربع معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
قطعي باقي الأفوكا قطع صغار وخلطيها مع 150 غ أناناس مقطع، فلفلة حمرا مقطعة، 75 غ خيزو محكوك، 30 غ كرومب محكوك، بصلة خضرا مقطعة و280 غ صدر الدجاج مطيب ومقطع.
زيدي الصلصة وخلطي بشوية.
عمري خبز البيتا الكامل وقدمي.
tips: زيدي شوية عصير الليم باش ما تكحلش الأفوكا.
كتمشي أيضا فوق الخس بلا خبز.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Serve this tangy chicken dish with brown rice. Add brightly colored vegetables for a tasty and simple meal!

steps: Coat frying pan with nonstick cooking spray and set heat to low.
Once pan heats up, add chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cook uncovered until chicken begins to brown, then add crushed pineapple and water.
Cover chicken until chicken is tender.
May serve over rice.
دهني مقلة بشوية زيت وحطيها على نار هادية.
ملي تسخن المقلة زيدي 1.1 كيلو دجاج بلا عظم وبلا جلدة مقطع. رشي ربع معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
طيبيه بلا غطاء حتى يبدا يحمر.
زيدي 400 غ أناناس مهرس مع العصير ديالو و60 مل ما.
غطي وخليه يطيب حتى يولي الدجاج طري، تقريبا 15 دقيقة.
قدميه فوق الروز.
tips: الأناناس ديال البواطة كيمشي مزيان، استعملي العصير ديالو.
الأطفال كيبغيو هاد الطعم الحلو.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
name_latin: Danone mtellej bel ananas o letchin
desc_en: A fruity and tropical treat to keep you cool during the dog days of summer.

steps: Place yogurt and fruit in large plastic bag and flatten. Freeze overnight.
Combine fruit, yogurt, and juice in food processor or blender and blend until smooth.
Serve immediately or place back in the freezer to harden until ready to serve, up to 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Stir before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Savory and sweet, delicious pineapple beef steaks are a fast and flavorful meal. Enjoy over brown rice or quinoa.

steps: Cut the green pepper into strips.
Heat the oil in a large skillet.
Place beef steaks on the heated skillet. Sprinkle the salt on top.
Cook the beef for 5 minutes on low heat on each side.
The beef should lose its pink color when it’s cooked enough.
Remove the cooked beef from the skillet. Place it in a serving dish.
Put the green pepper slices in the skillet.
Stir the in pineapple chunks with their juice.
Stir in the ginger and cinnamon.
Simmer for about 3 to 5 minutes.
Spoon the pineapple mixture over cooked beef.
قطعي فلفلة خضرا شرائح.
سخني معلقة زيت فمقلة كبيرة.
حطي 4 ستيكات ديال البݣري فالمقلة ورشي ربع معلقة ملحة.
طيبي اللحم 5 دقايق من كل جهة على نار هادية حتى يطيب.
خرجي اللحم وحطيه فطبق التقديم.
حطي شرائح الفلفلة فالمقلة، زيدي 150 غ أناناس مقطع مع العصير ديالو، ربع معلقة سكنجبير وربع معلقة قرفة.
خليها تطيب 3 حتى 5 دقايق وصبيها فوق اللحم.
tips: اللحم ديال البݣري خاصو يطيب أكثر من الخنزير الأصلي، زيدي دقيقتين إلا كان غليض.
الأناناس بالقرفة كيعطي طعم حلو زوين.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service)
desc_en: A cozy and creamy dessert that your whole family will enjoy.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly coat an oven safe 2 quart casserole dish with nonstick spray or oil.
In a large mixing bowl, beat together eggs, milk, and sugar.
Add undrained crushed pineapple, cinnamon, nutmeg, and vanilla.
Stir in cooked rice. Pour into prepared casserole dish.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in center of pudding comes out clean.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service)
desc_en: Stuffed with fruits and veggies, this hearty cake can be shared after a light lunch or dinner.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Grease or lightly spray with non-stick cooking spray, a 9x13 inch pan.
In a large bowl, beat eggs, sugar, vanilla, and oil. Add zucchini.
In a separate bowl, combine baking powder salt, baking soda, and flour. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
Stir in fruit and nuts, if using.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until cake springs back when lightly pressed with your finger.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (From the Farm to the Table University of Connecticut Cooperative Extension Hispanic Health Council)
desc_en: Pretty in pink! Enjoy this colorful and flavorful salad at a picnic or cookout with family and friends.

steps: Boil the potatoes in 2 cups of water in a deep kettle. Cover and cook over moderate heat for about 20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
When thoroughly cool, dice potatoes and place in a big bowl.
Add diced beets and mix with the potatoes.
Set aside 1/4 cup of peas for garnishing and add the rest to the bowl.
Save 1 egg to use as a garnish. Chop the rest and add to the bowl.
Peel the skin off the apple and remove the core. Cut the apple into small pieces, place in a small bowl, and sprinkle with lemon juice. Add apple to the salad.
Add the vinegar, olive oil, and sugar.
Mix thoroughly. Chill and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ohio State University Cooperative Extension Ross County Extension Office)
desc_en: Teach your teenagers how to make this tasty and easy recipe as an afterschool snack.

steps: Spray a small non-stick skillet with non-stick cooking spray.
Over medium heat, break egg into pan; break yolk.
When egg is done turn over sprinkle with cheese and top with beef pepperoni (optional). Cook until cheese is melted.
Open bun, spread with pizza sauce and top with cooked egg.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ohio State University Cooperative Extension)
name_latin: Kefta fel ferran b ta3m pizza
desc_en: There are microwave and oven directions for this recipe, so that you can make this meal in a way that is quick and convenient for you and your family. Enjoy with a fresh green salad or steamed spinach on the side.

steps: Lightly grease 9 inch pie plate with vegetable oil. Pat turkey into pie plate.

Cover turkey with waxed paper. Cook in microwave on high; rotate plate 1/4 turn after 3 minutes. Cook until turkey reaches an internal temperature of 160 °F, about 5 more minutes. Drain excess liquid. OR - Place turkey in 350 °F oven; bake until turkey reaches an internal temperature of 160 °F, about 30 to 35 minutes. Drain any excess liquid.
Top cooked turkey with vegetables, spaghetti sauce, and cheese.
Return turkey to either the microwave or oven and heat until cheese is melted, about 1 to 2 minutes.
دهني طبق فرن مدور (23 سم) بشوية زيت. فرشي فيه 450 غ كفتة الديك الرومي.
فالفرن: دخليه على 180 درجة 30 حتى 35 دقيقة حتى تطيب الكفتة. صفي الما الزايد. (ولا فالميكرو: غطي وطيبي 8 دقايق.)
حطي فوق الكفتة 75 غ فلفلة خضرا و40 غ بصلة مقطعين صغار، 75 غ صلصة الماطيشة و30 غ موزاريلا.
رجعيه للفرن دقيقة ولا جوج حتى يذوب الفرماج.
tips: بحال البيتزا لكن بلا عجين، مزيان للدراري.
زيدي أوريݣانو فوق الصلصة للطعم الإيطالي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Rhode Island SNAP-Education)
name_en: Plantain Cups with Shredded Chicken | Mofonguitos
name_fr: Coupelles de banane plantain au poulet effiloché
desc_en: Mofonguitos are a delicious Puerto Rican inspired dish consisting of small, plantain cups filled with savory, seasoned chicken.

steps: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add shredded chicken and onions. Cook for about 1-2 minutes.
Add spices to the mixture and cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes. Set aside for later.
Wash and scrub plantains. Cut off each end and make 3 vertical cuts along the side of the plantain. Using your thumb, peel the skin away from the flesh of the plantain and cut into 1-inch chunks.

Heat the oil over medium heat in a skillet for about 1 minute. Add the plantain chunks and sprinkle the salt on top. Cook on all sides of the chunks (about 5-6 minutes on each side). Using tongs, be sure to turn the plantain pieces on their sides so the insides cook throughout, and they turn a golden color.
Turn the heat down to low and remove the plantain chunks from the pan.
Take 2 plantain chunks at a time and shape them into a cup using either your hands, a small pestle and mortar, or a lemon squeezer.
Fill the plantain cups with the chicken mixture and top with a low-fat yogurt dip (optional).
Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kansas State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: A fun recipe to make with kids. Use your favorite fruit and whole grain tortillas, and enjoy!

steps: Warm tortillas in microwave or oven to make them easier to handle.
Peel and chop fruit into pieces.
Place 1/4 of the fruit on half of each tortilla.
In a small bowl, stir together brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Sprinkle over fruit.
Roll up the tortillas, starting at the end with the fruit.
Place on an greased baking sheet and make small slashes to allow steam to escape. Brush with milk and sprinkle with additional sugar, if desired.
Back at 350 °F in oven for 8 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown.
Serve warm or cool.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (California Health Department, Los Angeles County Es Facil Campaign Recipe submitted by Gloria Vargas)
desc_en: Enjoy this creamy and flavorful dish, packed with cheese, beans, peppers, and corn.

ingredients.en: Kernel corn mixed with green and red peppers

steps: In a medium sauce pan, bring the water to a boil. Gradually add the cornmeal or polenta. Reduce heat to low.
Continue stirring, add the corn, chilies, and the salt. Cook 6 to 8 minutes or until mixture thickens, stirring occasionally.
Gently stir in the margarine, cheese, and beans.
Remove from the heat and transfer to a serving dish.
Garnish with red bell pepper rings and cilantro.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Nutrition Education Programs)
desc_en: A great snack for adults and kids. A crunchy and sweet treat, enjoy this snack by yourself or double the recipe and share it with a group of friends.

steps: Pop popcorn.
Mix popped corn, raisins, and cereal in a large bowl.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in small dish.
Drizzle melted margarine or butter over mixture.
Add sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Shake or stir until all ingredients are evenly distributed.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by Brighter Bites, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
desc_en: This is the perfect dish for winter. It is bright and fresh and has a "pop" that makes every bite exciting. This recipe is great as an appetizer with whole wheat pita chips or as a topping for grilled fish or chicken. This recipe is kid-approved!

steps: Add all of the ingredients into a bowl and mix until well incorporated. Serve over chicken or fish or as a snack with whole wheat pita chips.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Spend Smart. Eat Smart. Iowa State University Extension)
name_fr: Rôti de filet de bœuf aux légumes
desc_en: A perfect recipe for meat and potatoes fans. Enjoy this recipe with a fresh side salad and a piece of fruit for dessert.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
In a bowl mix veggies with 1 tablespoon oil, salt, and pepper.
Lay veggies around the edge of a 9x13 inch pan and put in oven.
Use a small bowl to make the rub. Mix the brown sugar, garlic, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in the bowl.
Sprinkle the rub over the loin. Press gently so the rub sticks to the roast. Wash your hands after handling the raw meat.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the loin. Brown the sides of meat. Turn after about 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to the center of the pan with veggies. Bake for about 40 minutes. A meat thermometer should read 145 °F. Check the temperature after 30 minutes in the oven.
Remove from oven. Let set for 5 minutes. Slice and serve.
