source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by The National Pork Board, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
desc_en: The beef Power Bowl combines savory, tender beef tenderloin with a colorful mix of vegetables and grains, creating a balanced and nutritious meal. This dish offers a flavorful and wholesome option for a satisfying lunch or dinner.

ingredients.en: Purple or orange carrots, ribbon peeled
Beef tenderloin, cut into 1 ½ inch cubes
No salt added black beans, drained and rinsed
Red bell pepper, cut into strips
Chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for garnish

steps: In a large mason jar add the carrots, radish, vinegar, garlic, salt, honey and water, shake to combine. Let sit for 30 minutes.
In a medium bowl toss the beef, 2 Tbsp. lime juice, 1 Tbsp. olive oil, paprika and cumin. Cover and marinate for 15 minutes. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.

Place the quinoa, stock and kale in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Thread the beef onto skewers and grill over medium-high heat, turning frequently, until beef reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees F. Let beef rest for 3 minutes.

Divide the quinoa between four bowls. Arrange the beans, peppers, avocado, carrots and radishes on top of the quinoa. Remove the beef from the skewers and place it on top of the bowls. Drizzle with dressing and garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
tips: Dressing (Optional): - In a food processor, add yogurt, 3 Tbsp. olive oil, 1 Tbsp. lime juice, ½ an avocado, green onion and cilantro. Puree until smooth, season with salt and pepper. Thin dressing with cold water, if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: This is a tender and satisfying roast beef dinner. Serve with a green salad and bread.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Season the roast with salt and pepper.
In a large pan, brown the roast in the oil over medium to high heat for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain fat.
Use a large iron skillet or roasting pan. Put the roast in the middle of the pan. Add the potatoes, turnips, onions, and carrots around the roast.
Pour the tomato juice over the roast and vegetables.
Cover the pan with a lid or foil and bake for 1 hour or until potatoes are cooked.
If desired, cut roast into one inch chunks. Mix and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
name_fr: Gratin de pommes de terre au bœuf
desc_en: A casserole perfect for meat and potato lovers. Savor this recipe with a fresh green salad on the side and piece of fruit for dessert.

ingredients.en: Cream of mushroom soup, reduced sodium

steps: Peel onion and dice into 1/4-inch pieces.
Cook ground beef and onions in a skillet until the meat is browned. Drain of fat.
Add mushroom soup and 1/2 can water.
Use a brush to scrub potatoes under cold running water. Slice potatoes into 1/2-inch thick pieces and places in the bottom of a casserole dish.
Spread meat and soup mixture over potatoes.
Bake at 350 °F for 45 minutes until potatoes are tender and casserole is bubbly and browned.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_fr: Poêlée pommes de terre, haricots noirs et kale
name_latin: Btata o loubya kehla o kromb fel meqla
desc_en: A lively Southwestern skillet dish featuring diced potatoes, kale, and black beans, spiced up with garlic, chili, and cayenne, and topped with a dollop of non-fat Greek yogurt.

ingredients.en: 15 oz. no salt added black beans

steps: Dice potatoes into 1/4 inch pieces.
Chop kale.
Heat oil, in large skillet over medium heat, Add garlic and onions; cook 2 to 3 minutes until just starting to brown.
Add diced potatoes, chili, salt, and pepper to skillet, cover with lid and cook 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped kale and black beans. Cook about 3 to 5 more minutes, stirring gently.
Serve with Greek yogurt.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Food and Nutrition Service Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Enjoy these potato cakes with fat-free sour cream or fat-free yogurt and chives.

steps: Put mashed potatoes into a bowl.
Add flour and onion. Mix well.
Pat potato mixture on a lightly floured board until 1/2 inch thick.
Cut with a 3-inch round cutter.
Place on a baking sheet, cover and refrigerate until just before cooking.
Heat oil in a frying pan or griddle.
Fry cakes over medium heat, turning to brown on both sides. Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: How can you make nachos better? Combine them with potatoes! Change up your toppings or trying new seasonings when cooking the ground turkey.

steps: Slice potatoes into small circles about 1/4 inch thick.
Lightly coat the potato slices with oil (or spray for 3 seconds with cooking spray).
Arrange slices on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake in the oven at 450 °F for 25 to 30 minutes, depending on desired darkness.
Meanwhile, add ground turkey and chili powder to a skillet. Cook, stirring over medium heat (300 °F in an electric skillet) for 8 to10 minutes or until turkey browns.
Remove potatoes from the oven.
Transfer baked potatoes to an oven-safe dish. Top with turkey and sprinkle with cheese. Put back in the oven to melt the cheese, about 2 minutes.
Remove from oven and top with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, cilantro, and salsa.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: A creamy yogurt, olive oil, and mustard sauce is tossed with tender potatoes and celery then topped with scallions and parsley to make up this favorite classic side dish.

steps: Put potatoes in a pot and cover with cold water.
Bring to a boil over high heat and cook about 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Drain and set aside to cool to room temperature.
While potatoes are cooling, mix the yogurt, olive oil, and mustard in a small bowl.
Add the yogurt mixture to the cooled potatoes and gently mix.
Stir in the celery, scallions, and parsley.
Serve right away or cover and refrigerate up to 2 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Perfect for your next cookout or picnic, this simple potato salad will be enjoyed by your friends and family.

steps: Scrub the potatoes, and peel them.
Cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Put the potatoes into a saucepan. Cover with water.
Bring the potatoes to a boil on medium heat.
Let the potatoes simmer for 15 minutes until they’re soft.
Drain the hot water, and let the potatoes cool.
While the potatoes are cooling, peel and chop some onions until you have 1 cup of chopped onions.
Chop the celery until you have 1/2 cup of chopped celery.
Put the chopped onion and celery in a medium mixing bowl.
Add the mayonnaise and pickle relish. Stir together.
Add the cooled potatoes. Stir again.
Cover the bowl. Put in the fridge for at least 2 hours before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_fr: Peaux de pommes de terre au poulet buffalo
desc_en: This lively dish gives a nod to buffalo chicken wings but without extra fat and calories. Start with a foundation of nutritious potatoes -- which are naturally high in potassium, vitamin C, and fiber -- and replace fried wings with shredded chicken breast and top with fresh tomatoes and onions. Don't forget the celery sticks.

steps: Center oven rack and preheat oven to 425 °F.
Place chicken in a sauté pan, add water, and cover. Simmer for 20 minutes and remove from pan; let cool slightly. When chicken is cool enough to handle, shred using two forks, one in each hand.
While chicken is simmering, wash and scrub potatoes with a clean vegetable brush under running water and slit each one lengthwise about 1-inch deep.
Place potatoes in a microwave-safe dish and microwave on high, uncovered, for about 10 minutes. Let cool slightly.

Slice each potato in half length-wise, scoop out potato, leaving a 1/4 inch shell. Mash potato together with hot pepper sauce, sour cream, margarine, and milk. Fold in blue cheese and shredded chicken.
Spoon mixture into potato skins slightly denting center (to hold fresh toppings after baking).
Place filled potato skins on a 9x13 inch baking sheet and bake about 15 to 20 minutes until tops are golden brown.
Dice tomatoes and green onions. Cut celery stalks into four inch sticks.
To serve, top potatoes with onions and tomatoes. Serve celery sticks on the side for scooping potato contents.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: This rich-tasting and hearty potato soup is full of flavor and perfect for lunch or dinner.

ingredients.en: Chicken, thawed, cut up, and skin removed from each piece

steps: In a large pot, brown onion and garlic in oil over medium to high heat for 5 minutes.
Add chicken to pot and brown for about 5 minutes.
Add water, potatoes, rice, and chili powder to pot.
Bring pot to a boil, and cook for 15 minutes.
Lower heat and cook for about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir pot every 10 minutes.
Add peas and cook for about 8 minutes. If using cayenne or jalapeño chilies, add that too. Mix well.
Remove pot from heat. If using parsley or cilantro, add that now.
Mix well and cover for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Warm up a cold winter night with this cozy soup. Enjoy with dark green vegetables and broiled fish, meat, or tofu.

steps: Peel and chop the onion.
Chop the celery.
Peel the potatoes, and cut them into small cubes.
Melt the margarine in a large saucepan on low heat.
Add the onion and celery. Cook for a few minutes.
Add the potatoes, salt, pepper, and 1 1/2 cups water.
Cook for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
In a small bowl, stir together the dry milk and flour.
Add 1 1/2 cups water slowly, stirring as you add it.
Add the milk mix to the potatoes.
Cook until the soup is heated and slightly thickened.
Adjust the seasonings.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Fix it Fresh! Recipe Series Kansas State University Research and Extension)
desc_en: This casserole would be wonderful for brunch or dinner. Top with fresh tomatoes or your favorite salsa!

ingredients.en: Cheese, reduced fat Monterey Jack, shredded

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F.
In large bowl, combine hash browns, green pepper, 1/4 cup onion, salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Spray a 8x8 inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Press potato mixture into bottom.
Bake until lightly browned around edges, 20 to 25 minutes.
In large bowl, stir together evaporated milk, egg whites, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, cheeses, spinach, remaining 1/4 cup onion, and tomatoes.
Reduce oven temperature to 350 °F.
Pour mixture over potato crust. Bake uncovered until center is set, 40 to 45 minutes.
Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Cut into 6 pieces. Serve hot. Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: A unique and flavorful meat-free lasagna layered with sliced potatoes instead of noodles.

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Bring water to a boil in large sauce pan.
Thinly slice potatoes, add to boiling water and cook 5 minutes, drain and rinse with cool water; drain again.
Heat olive oil in medium skillet, add onions and garlic; sauté about 2 to 3 minutes until just starting to brown.
Add spinach, sauté 1 more minute.
Remove from heat and drain off liquid.
In a medium bowl, mix cheese with egg until well blended.
Add layers to 8 inch square baking dish as follows, using about 1/4 of each: pasta sauce, potato slices, sautéed spinach mixture and cheese mixture.
Repeat layers until all ingredients are used.
Cover with foil.
Bake about 35 to 40 minutes.
Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Have fun with the kids making pretzel shapes! A great snack for the whole family.

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F.
In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water, add honey and let set for a few minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, measure flour and salt.
Add yeast mixture to flour mixture and stir until it forms a smooth ball. Add a little more flour if the dough is sticky.
Knead dough on countertop or dough board until it forms a smooth ball. Add a little flour if the dough is sticky.
Divide dough into 12 pieces about the size of a walnut. Roll each ball into a snake and then twist to make a pretzel, letter, or other fun shape.
Place pretzels on a baking sheet lightly coated with cooking spray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_en: Pulled beef Sandwich with Red Cabbage and Carrot Slaw
name_fr: Sandwich de bœuf effiloché, salade de chou rouge et carotte
name_ar: سندويتش اللحم المفتت بشلاضة الكرومب والخيزو
name_latin: Sandwich lham mfettet b chladat kromb o khizzou
desc_en: beef shoulder is slow cooked and served on a whole wheat roll with tangy red cabbage and carrot slaw.

ingredients.en: % whole wheat dinner rolls or slider buns

steps: Put everything in the slow cooker and turn the heat to medium. Cook, undisturbed, for 8 hours or until it is fork-tender (about 190 °F with a meat thermometer).
Remove the beef from the slow cooker but keep the liquid. While still hot, use two forks to shred the meat. Remove any fat found between the shreds.
Skim as much fat as possible from the liquid in the slow cooker. Add about 1 cup of the cooking liquid to the shredded beef.
tips: Pulled Pork: Red Cabbage and Carrot Slaw: - Put the shredded cabbage and carrots in a bowl. - Mix the canola oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl and stir or whisk well. - Add the dressing to the cabbage mixture and coat thoroughly. - Add 1/2 cup of pulled pork to each roll or bun and top with 1/2 cup cabbage and carrot slaw. Serve right away.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Pumpkin and bean lovers alike will savor this fast and flavorful soup that is packed with fiber.

steps: Blend white beans, onion, and water with a potato masher or blender till smooth.
In a large pot, add the pumpkin, juice, cinnamon, nutmeg, black pepper, and salt. Stir.
Add the blended bean mix to the pot.
Cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, until warmed through.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ohio State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Wonderful for holidays or any time that you want the light airy texture of angel food cake and the earthy spicy flavor of pumpkin.

ingredients.fr: Mélange d'épices pour tarte (cannelle, gingembre, muscade)

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Prepare Angel Food cake recipe, steps 1-4.
In a large bowl, beat all ingredients with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds. Then, beat on medium speed for 1 minute.
Pour into an ungreased 10-inch angel food cake pan.
Bake 37 to 47 minutes or until golden brown and cracks are dry.
Remove from oven and immediately turn pan upside down until cooled.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food for Fitness and Fun Iowa State University Extension)
desc_en: Sweet and spicy, this pumpkin bread makes a wonderful holiday treat.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a large mixing bowl, beat together pumpkin, sugar, oil, and yogurt.
In a medium bowl, combine the flours, baking powder, soda, cinnamon, and salt. Add to pumpkin mixture, stirring until just moistened.
Stir in raisins.
Pour into 2 greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pans and bake for about 1 hour.
Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (California Health Department, Los Angeles County Es Facil Campaign Recipe submitted by Maria Pallares)
desc_en: A great option for cheesecake lovers. Less fat and saturated fat than a standard cheesecake but all of the flavor.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Place the cream cheeses, eggs, and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Mix at medium speed until creamed. Add the remaining ingredients and mix at medium speed until ingredients are well mixed.
Spoon the mixture evenly in each pie crust and place both in the oven for approximately 50 minutes until pies look firm in the middle.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Bronson Wellness Center)
desc_en: Canned or puréed pumpkin adds a hearty and nutritious flavor to this savory chili recipe.

steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium high heat.
Add onion, bell pepper, jalapenos and garlic and cook, stirring frequently until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add turkey and cook until browned.
Add tomatoes, pumpkin, water, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium low then add beans.
Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes more.
Ladle chili into bowls and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (With Veggies, More Matters! Michigan State University Extension - Midland County)
desc_en: This dense, moist chocolate muffin contains no fats or oils. The secret ingredient is canned (or puréed) pumpkin that binds the ingredients together for a tasty, satisfying treat.

steps: Whisk all the dry ingredients together. Add pumpkin and water.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips.
Place batter into 24 prepared muffin tins and bake at 350 °F for 10 to 12 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Bake these cookies the night before and enjoy a delicious treat on busy mornings.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Mix pumpkin, brown sugar, eggs, and oil thoroughly.
Blend dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture.
Add raisins and nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (CSAAC (Community Services for Autistic Adults and Children))
name_fr: Macaronis au fromage et potiron (1 portion)
name_latin: Mqarouna bel fromage o ger3a l wahed
desc_en: To make this dish even faster, use leftover cooked pasta, preferably whole grain, to make this meal in under 5 minutes.

steps: Stir the "wet" ingredients (soup, pumpkin purée, milk, and mustard), and heat in microwave for 45 to 60 seconds; stir again until creamy.
Add cooked pasta to cream and sprinkle cheese on top. Heat another 30 to 45 seconds or until cheese melts.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: No cooking required for this tasty pumpkin pudding. Kids can help prepare with supervision.

ingredients.fr: Mélange d'épices pour tarte (cannelle, gingembre, muscade)

steps: In a large bowl mix pumpkin, salt and pumpkin spice together.
Slowly stir in milk and mix well. Add instant pudding mix and stir for 2 minutes until it thickens. Refrigerate until serving time.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
name_latin: Mqarouna m3emmra bel ger3a o ricotta
desc_en: Welcome the flavors of fall with these pumpkin ricotta stuffed shells! Rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, pumpkin adds a nutritious twist to traditional stuffed shells.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Cook pasta shells according to package directions. Drain and place each on a baking sheet to cool.
In a medium bowl, stir together ricotta, pumpkin, spices, and all but 1 tablespoon of the cheese. Reserve the 1 tablespoon cheese for topping.

Spread pasta sauce in the bottom of a baking dish that holds all the shells in a single layer. Fill each shell with about 3 tablespoons of pumpkin mixture and place shells close together on top of the sauce.
Cover pan with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and bake for 15 minutes more.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Canned pumpkin tastes good and is easy to use. The blend of ingredients in this soup gives it a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.en: Beef round roast, thawed, sliced thinly

steps: In a medium-sized pot, bring water to a boil.
Add beef roast to boiling water. Boil for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add pumpkin, maple syrup, and pepper to pot. If using cinnamon, add that too. Mix well.
Lower heat and cook for about 10 minutes.
Put 2 teaspoons of onion on top of each bowl of soup. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Connecticut Family Nutrition Program Senior Nutrition Awareness Project (SNAP) Newsletters)
desc_en: Get pumped for this pumpkin soup. This soup pairs well with a spinach salad topped with a scoop of tuna or egg salad.

ingredients.fr: Bouillon de légumes ou de poulet

steps: Blend white beans, onion, and water.
In a soup pot, mix bean puree with pumpkin, broth, and spices.
Cover and cook over low heat about 15 to 20 minutes until warmed through.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Delicious Heart-Healthy Latino Recipes/ Platillos Latinos Sabrosos y Saludables US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: This recipe is lower in saturated fat than traditional pupusas, but are still loaded with flavor! Enjoy these pupusas with curtido (cabbage salad).

steps: In a non-stick skillet over low heat, sauté chicken in oil until chicken turns white. Constantly stir the chicken to keep it from sticking.
Add onion, garlic, green pepper, and tomato. Cook until chicken mixture is cooked through. Remove skillet from stove and let mixture cool in the refrigerator.
While the chicken mixture is cooling, place the flour in a large mixing bowl and stir in enough water to make a stiff tortilla-like dough.
When the chicken mixture has cooled, mix in the cheese.

Divide the dough into 24 portions. With your hands, roll the dough into balls and flatten each ball into a 1/2 ich thick circle. Put a spoonful of the chicken mixture in the middle of each circle of dough and bring the edges to the center. Flatten the ball of dough again until it is 1/2 inch thick.
In a very hot, iron skillet, cook the pupusas on each side until golden brown.
Serve hot.
فمقلة على نار هادية طيبي 450 غ كفتة الدجاج فمعلقة زيت حتى تولي بيضا، وحركي بلا وقفة باش ما تلصقش.
زيدي نص بصلة، حبة تومة، فلفلة خضرا وماطيشة مقطعين صغار ونص معلقة ملحة. طيبي حتى يطيب كلشي. خليه يبرد فالثلاجة.
فطبسيل كبير خلطي 750 غ فرينة الدرة (ماسا) مع 1.4 لتر ما بشوية حتى يولي عجين قاسح شوية بحال ديال الطورطيا.
ملي يبرد الدجاج زيدي 230 غ موزاريلا محكوكة.
قسمي العجين على 24 كورة. فلسي كل كورة دائرة ديال 1 سم. حطي معلقة من الدجاج فالوسط وجمعي الجوانب للوسط. فلسيها مرة أخرى حتى 1 سم.
فمقلة سخانة بزاف طيبي البوبوسا من كل جهة حتى تحمر.
قدميها سخونة.
tips: البوبوسا بحال الخبز المعمر المغربي (البطبوط المعمر).
إلا ما لقيتيش فرينة الدرة، استعملي سميدة رقيقة مع شوية فرينة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Kids are going to love this purple treat, which is perfect for a hot summer day. They will never know that it is high in vitamin C!

steps: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor.
Secure lid and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Tortillas, eggs, cheese, and salsa can be enjoyed at any meal. Enjoy this main dish with a salad and a piece of fruit for a well balanced lunch.

steps: Put 2 tablespoons cheese and 1/4 of the scrambled eggs on each tortilla.
Heat 2 quesadillas at a time in microwave on high for 30 to 45 seconds or until cheese melts.
Top with salsa and fold tortilla in half to serve.
Add parsley if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit)
name_en: Quick and Easy Baked Potato Salad
name_fr: Salade de pommes de terre au four express
desc_en: If you love baked potatoes but associate them primarily with the colder winter months, this Baked Potato Salad will fill that void come summer. With reduced-fat cheddar cheese, chives, and real turkey bacon, you’ll feel like you’re eating a traditional baked potato in a dish that’s just slightly more summer picnic-friendly. The best part? There’s no need to fire up the oven when you have a microwave handy!

ingredients.en: Real turkey bacon bits or pieces

steps: Place whole potatoes (do not poke holes) into microwave-safe dish.
Cover dish. (If covering dish with plastic wrap, poke small holes in plastic.)
Microwave on high for 10 to 12 minutes depending on strength of microwave.
Use oven mitts or a towel to remove dish from microwave. Carefully remove cover from dish due to steam build up and let cool.
Cut potatoes into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowel with remaining ingredients. Stir and mix well.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University Extension)
desc_en: This recipe uses a traditional pizza dough recipe with yeast, but only needs 15 minutes for the dough to rise. Once you try this fresh, homemade pizza, you might never go back to frozen or delivery!

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Collect, shred, and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
In a medium bowl, mix 1 cup flour, yeast, sugar, and water with a spoon.
Gradually stir in the other cup of flour until the mixture forms a ball.
Dust a cutting board or clean countertop surface with flour. Put the ball of dough on the surface, then use your clean hands to knead the dough on the surface for about 5 minutes.

Spray a bowl with nonstick cooking spray. Put the dough in the bowl, and cover it with a clean dishtowel. Put the bowl on the oven while it is preheating (but not on a burner that is turned on), and let it sit for 10 to 15 minutes (preheating the oven will cause the stovetop to be slightly warm and will help the dough rise).

Spray a 12-inch x 16-inch baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spread the dough into an even layer on the baking sheet. Spread the dough into an even layer on the baking sheet. For a thicker crust, use a smaller baking sheet.
Add a thin layer of the Easy Marinara Sauce from the Eating Smart, Being Active Let's Cook! Cookbook, leaving a 1/2 inch crust on all edges.
Add the shredded cheese and pizza toppings. Be careful not to put too many toppings on the pizza, or it will be soggy.
Bake for approximately 15 minutes until the crust is brown and the cheese melts and is slightly browned in spots.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Eat within 3 to 5 days.
سخني الفرن على 190 درجة.
فطبسيل خلطي 125 غ فرينة، معلقة كبيرة خميرة سريعة، معلقة كبيرة سكر و160 مل ما دافي بالمعلقة.
زيدي بشوية 125 غ فرينة أخرى وحركي حتى يولي كورة.
رشي الطابلة بالفرينة وعجني العجين 5 دقايق.
حطي العجين فطبسيل مدهون بالزيت وغطيه بفوطة. خليه فبلاصة دافية 10 حتى 15 دقيقة.
دهني صينية الفرن وفرشي العجين طبقة واحدة.
فرشي 240 مل صلصة الماطيشة وخلي 1 سم من الجوانب.
زيدي 170 غ موزاريلا محكوكة والخضرة اللي بغيتي. ما تعمريهاش بزاف.
دخليها للفرن 15 دقيقة حتى يحمر العجين ويذوب الفرماج.
tips: العجين رقيق كيطيب أسرع، الغليض خاصو 5 دقايق زيادة.
زيدي ديك رومي مقطع ولا طون للبروتين.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit)
name_fr: Gratin de pommes de terre rapide
desc_en: This potato dish packs lots of flavor with reduced-fat cheddar cheese, onions, Italian herb seasoning, and Dijon mustard.

steps: Spray an 8-inch microwave-safe baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place 1/3 of the potatoes and 1/2 of the onions on the bottom of the dish and sprinkle with 1/3 the cheese and 1/2 the herbs.
Repeat layers, then top with the last 1/3 of the potatoes, layering potatoes so that there is a solid layer of potatoes with no gaps; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Stir together stock, Dijon mustard, and garlic salt, and pour over the potatoes.
Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on HIGH until internal temperature registers 165 °F on a food thermometer, about 20 minutes.
Use oven mitts or a towel to remove dish from microwave; carefully remove cover due to steam build-up and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking Demo II Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
desc_en: Tasty turkey turkey bacon and frozen black-eyed peas are the star ingredients in this recipe. Add a little chipotle pepper and sauce, cayenne pepper, or jalapeños if you prefer some additional heat.

steps: Over medium high heat cook turkey bacon for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer and allow to cook until the peas are tender, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
desc_en: This simple corn and bean salad can be made in minutes. Enjoy it on top of eggs, on whole grain tortilla, or on pita chips.

steps: Leave frozen corn in the fridge overnight to defrost. If you forget to do this ahead of time, defrost it in the microwave.
Drain and rinse the black beans.
Combine all ingredients together and serve as a side dish.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Quick and Healthy Black-Eyed Peas Cooking Demo II Food and Health Communications, Inc.)
desc_en: Tasty turkey turkey bacon and frozen black-eyed peas are the star ingredients in this recipe. Add a little chipotle pepper and sauce, cayenne pepper, or jalapeños if you prefer some additional heat.

steps: Over medium high heat cook turkey bacon and onions for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer and allow to cook until the peas are tender, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: A great way to use properly stored and handled leftover chicken. Using frozen veggies helps cut down prep time.

steps: Put the tomatoes, potatoes and broth in the pot. Cook on medium heat until they boil.
Add the onion. Turn the heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Cover the pan.
Cook for at least 5 more minutes over low heat until vegetables are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simply Good Eating Recipe Cards, Vol. 1, 2000 University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service)

steps: Thoroughly cook ground beef in skillet until browned (internal temperature of 160 °F). Do not undercook ground beef. Carefully wash your hands and any surfaces that have come in contact with raw meat.
Drain off fat into container.
Stir in kidney beans with liquid, tomato sauce, onion, and chili powder.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers within 2 hours of cooking. Use refrigerated leftovers within 4 days.
طيبي 230 غ كفتة ديال البݣري فمقلة حتى تحمر مزيان.
صفي الشحمة.
زيدي 55 غ لوبيا حمرا مع الما ديالها، 250 غ صلصة الماطيشة، معلقة كبيرة بصلة يابسة (ولا بصلة صغيرة مقطعة) ومعلقة ونص كبيرة شيلي مطحون.
خليها تغلي. نقصي النار، غطي وخليها 10 دقايق.
tips: زيدي لوبيا أكثر باش يكفي العائلة.
كيتاكل مع الروز ولا الخبز ولا فوق البطاطا.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Originally named: Yummy Bean Dip Adapted from: University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Beans make delicious dips for delectable snacks and side dishes.

steps: Place beans in a small, resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out extra air and seal. Mash beans with fingers.
Add yogurt and salsa. Seal bag and mix with fingers.
Open bag or cut off corner of bag and squeeze out dip.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Favorite Recipes for Family Meals Washington State University Extension)
desc_en: Try this fun macaroni salad that combines vegetables, tuna, onions, cheese, and pickles with a creamy dressing. It's great for your next cookout or picnic with family and friends.

steps: Prepare elbow macaroni according to package directions and drain.
Add vegetables, tuna, onions, cheese, and pickles.
Mix yogurt, salad dressing, lemon juice, salt, and seasoned pepper.
Toss with macaroni mixture.
Chill before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers promptly.
tips: * Add chopped carrots if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: A tasty dessert that can be enjoyed on its own or with added fruit.

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Open the can of peaches. Pour the peaches and their juice into the casserole dish. Heat them on the stovetop until they bubble.
Slightly beat 1 egg.
In a mixing bowl, mix the egg, sugar, flour, baking powder, salt, and margarine.
Drop spoonsful of this mixture on top of the hot, bubbling peaches.
Use pot holders to carefully remove the casserole dish from the stove.
Put the casserole dish in the oven. Bake for about 30 to 40 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Right Is Basic Michigan State University Cooperative Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This lasagna can be prepared entirely on the stovetop and uses Parmesan and cottage cheese. Add fresh veggies like green peppers, spinach, or whatever you have on hand to increase flavor and nutrients. Make a meal of it with your favorite fruit.

steps: Chop onion. Cook beef and onion, in a large frying pan until beef is brown and onion is tender. Drain off excess fat.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, parsley, water, and garlic powder to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil and simmer until sauce is thick, about 25 minutes.
Cook noodles in a separate saucepan according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked, drained noodles to the beef mixture. Stir to prevent sticking.
Mix cheeses and drop by spoonfuls into the frying pan.
Cover and heat over low heat about 5 minutes.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Cookbook for African American Populations Recipe by Tara Caulder, Soaad Ali, and Laide Bello (Supervised by Dr. Mira Mehta and Terri Kieckhefer))
desc_en: This creamy casserole can be easily prepped in advance. Enjoy it with roasted sweet potatoes or winter squash for a colorful meal.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Bring 1 quart of water to a boil in a large pot and cook the egg noodles in the water for 2 minutes.
Cover the pot, remove from heat, and let stand for 10 minutes.
In the meantime, mix the water, soup, and milk together in a bowl.
Combine tuna and peas with the mixture and pour into a 1-quart casserole dish.
Drain the noodles well and combine with the tuna mixture.
Sprinkle the top with bread crumbs if desired.
Bake for 30 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Delicious Heart-Healthy Latino Recipes/ Platillos Latinos Sabrosos y Saludables US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
name_fr: Salade de quinoa aux haricots noirs
desc_en: Quinoa (pronounced "KEEN-wah") is a whole grain with origins in South America. It is combined in this recipe with black beans, savory vegetables, and spices for a cold salad that is light and refreshing. This salad is high in protein and can be served as a main or side dish.

steps: Rinse the quinoa in cold water. Boil water in a saucepan, and then add the quinoa.
Return to boil, and then simmer until the water is absorbed, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes.
While quinoa is cooking, mix olive oil, lime juice, cumin, coriander, chopped cilantro, and scallions in a small bowl, and set aside.
Combine chopped vegetables with the black beans in a large bowl, and set aside.
Once quinoa has cooled, combine all ingredients and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Rainbow Bell Pepper Boats with Garbanzo Beans and Kale
name_fr: Poivrons farcis pois chiches et kale
name_latin: Felfla m3emmra bel hommos o kromb
desc_en: Red, orange, and yellow bell peppers stuffed with garbanzo beans, kale, walnuts, and brown rice make a delicious Mediterranean-influenced vegetarian dish.

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Slice bell peppers in half vertically and remove seeds.
Reserve about half of garbanzo beans; mash remaining portion with a fork.
Mix rice with kale, garbanzo beans (mashed and whole), nuts, salt, and pepper.
Fill peppers with mix; place in baking dish and cover.
Bake about 30 minutes.
Remove lid and bake more 5 more minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (2009 Recipe Calendar University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This easy and colorful salad tastes best after marinating it overnight. Enjoy it as a side dish at lunch or dinner.

steps: Mix all the vegetables together in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over vegetables.
Sprinkle with pepper.
Stir gently, coating all vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Simmer eggplant, zucchini, red peppers, and tomatoes with onion, garlic, and seasonings for a delicious flavor in this classic dish.

steps: Put the pot on the stove over medium-low heat and when it is hot, add the oil. Add the onion and garlic and cook until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, basil, and oregano and cook, covered, until the eggplant is very, very soft, about 40 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Serve right away, garnished with lemon quarters and basil, or cover and refrigerate up to 3 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Here is the perfect recipe to make when your garden or market is overflowing with peppers, eggplant, and tomatoes. Add cooked chicken or tofu to make this side dish a complete meal.

steps: Heat oil in a large saucepan and sauté onion, garlic, bell peppers, and eggplant until tender, about 15 minutes.
Add tomatoes and basil, cook about 10 minutes. Add pepper and parsley before serving.
Serve hot. Cover and refrigerate within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Whole grain tortillas filled with mashed red beans, spinach, cheese, and avocado are heated until and warm, melted, and golden brown.

ingredients.en: Shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Red kidney beans and tomatoes and flavored with garlic, onions, peppers, and seasonings and simmered until tender. Serve the bean mixture over rice and top with avocado and cilantro for a traditional meal or side dish.

steps: Put the rice and water in the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Turn the heat down to low and cook, covered, until the rice is tender, about 45 minutes.
tips: To prepare the rice: To prepare the beans: - Place the large skillet on the stove over medium-high heat. When it is hot, add the oil. Add the garlic, onion, bell pepper, and 2 tablespoons water. Cook until the mixture is golden, about 10 minutes. - Add the tomato, salt, cumin, beans, and water and cook until the beans are very soft, about 20 to 30 minutes. - Divide the cooked rice among 4 bowls or plates, and top with equal amounts of the bean mixture. - Top with avocado and sprinkle with cilantro, if using. - Serve right away, or cover and refrigerate up to 3 days.

steps: طيبي 180 غ روز كامل ف480 مل ما: خليه يغلي على نار قوية، نقصي النار، غطي وخليه 45 دقيقة حتى يطيب.
فمقلة سخني 2 معالق صغار زيت. زيدي 2 حبات تومة مدقوقة، بصلة مقطعة وفلفلة مقطعة، قلبيهم 5 دقايق. زيدي 40 مل ما إلا بداو يلصقو.
زيدي ماطيشة مقطعة، ربع معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة كامون، طيبي 3 دقايق.
زيدي 870 غ لوبيا حمرا مصفية و360 مل ما. خليها تطيب 15 دقيقة حتى تخثر.
قدمي اللوبيا فوق الروز مع أفوكا مقطعة و2 معالق قزبور من الفوق.
tips: هرسي شوية من اللوبيا بالمعلقة باش تخثر الصلصة.
طبق كامل بلا لحم ومشبع.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food and Drug Administration (FDA) US Department of Health and Human Services)
desc_en: This flavorful dish is a Monday night tradition in many homes. This vegetarian recipe uses dry beans, onion, pepper, and spices.

steps: Pick through beans to remove shriveled or broken beans. Rinse beans thoroughly.
In a 5-quart pot, mix beans, water, onion, celery, and bay leaves. Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and cook over low heat for about 1 to 1/2 hours or until beans are tender. Stir and mash beans against side of pan.
Add garlic, parsley, thyme, salt, black pepper, and red or green pepper.
Cook uncovered, over low heat, until creamy, about 30 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Serve over hot cooked rice.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (2009 Recipe Calendar, Adapted from Easy Red Beans & Rice University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This flavorful dish is traditionally eaten on Monday nights in many homes and uses dry beans, onion, pepper, and spices.

ingredients.en: Green bell pepper, washed, seeded and chopped
Low-sodium kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Spray skillet with cooking oil spray, if using.
Cook onion and pepper over medium heat for 5 minutes or until tender.
Add garlic powder, tomatoes, and kidney beans.
Bring mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A River of Recipes: Native American Recipes Using Commodity Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Spicy and savory, this four ingredient stew is simple and delicious.

steps: Wash chilies, removing stems and seeds. Place in blender with 1 cup water and blend into paste.
Put beef fat into deep skillet until there is enough on the bottom of the skillet to prevent meat from sticking. Discard remaining fat.
Brown beef lightly. Add the chili paste and mix well, adding water if mixture is too thick. Add oregano and garlic. Cover pan and simmer slowly for one hour.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Stay Young at Heart: Cooking the Heart-Healthy Way US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Spice up your weeknight dinner plans with this Red Hot Fusilli. Loaded with juicy tomatoes, this dish is wonderful with or without the optional chicken!

steps: Heat oil in a medium saucepan. Saute garlic and parsley until golden.

Add tomatoes and spices. Cook uncovered over low heat 15 minutes or until thickened, stirring frequently. If desired, add chicken and continue cooking for 15 minutes until chicken is heated through and sauce is thick.
Cook pasta firm in unsalted water.
To serve, spoon sauce over pasta and sprinkle with coarsely chopped parsley. Serve hot as a main dish and cold for the next day's lunch.
tips: *Cost estimate and nutritional analysis does not include chicken.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Big Book of Lentils Cookbook Canadian Lentils)
desc_en: Traditionally, latkes are pancakes made from potatoes, but these latkes also include lentils, cheese, and hot sauce. Flavorful and tasty, this dish makes a great weeknight meal. Enjoy it along with a side salad.

ingredients.en: Parmesan cheese, grated or other cheese

steps: Add the lentils to a medium saucepan and add water to cover by about an inch. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to a simmer and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, remove the excess water from the potato: you can either squeeze it by the handful, or put the entire pile on a clean tea towel and wring it out.

Crack the egg in a medium bowl and beat it lightly. Add the potato, cooked lentils, garlic, green onion, and cheese and hot sauce if you're using them in a medium bowl. Add the salt and a good grinding of black pepper, and stir until combined.

Heat a large skillet over medium heat, then add a generous drizzle of oil (1-2 tablespoons). Working in batches, so as not to crowd the pan, add clumps of the potato-lentil mixture (about the size of a golf ball or slightly larger works well), and flatten each as soon as it's in the pan, making them about a half inch thick.

Cook for about 4 to 5 minutes per side, until the latkes are deeply golden brown and cooked through. Add a little more oil to the pan for each additional batch. Serve immediately or keep the latkes warm in a 200 °F oven for up to an hour.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Northern Valley Catholic Social Service)
desc_en: This smoothie has two cups of fruit per serving and kale for an added veggie boost. Try it for breakfast or as a snack.

steps: Using a blender, mix the greens and the liquid of your choice.
Gradually add in the rest of the ingredients, blending after each addition.
Separate into two cups and reserve one serving for later.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Hearty, delicious, and sure to please any crowd. This recipe is filling enough to stand alone or could make a great side dish.

steps: Scrub potatoes, but do not peel. Cut into quarters. Cook in boiling water or steam until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes.
While potatoes cook, heat butter or margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add onion and cook until it becomes clear, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage begins to brown, about 4 to 6 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add milk, salt, and pepper. Cover and cook until cabbage is tender, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Drain potatoes. Add cabbage mixture to potatoes. Mash with a potato masher or large fork to reach desired texture. Serve warm.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_fr: Salade de pommes de terre rouges
desc_en: This all-time favorite mix of tender potatoes, celery, and onions has been updated with a tangy yogurt sauce. This classic side is sure to please a hungry family or backyard BBQ guests.

steps: To prepare sauce, combine yogurt, mayonnaise and mustard in a small bowl. Mix well and refrigerate.
Wash potatoes and place in pot. Cover with water about 1 inch above potatoes.
Bring water and potatoes to a boil and simmer until potatoes are fork tender.
Drain potatoes and set aside to cool.
When potatoes are cooled, cut into bite-sized cubes. Place cut potatoes into large bowl.
Add celery, onions, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Top with sauce and mix well.
Garnish with parsley and enjoy.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: A great twist on a classic dish, this is the perfect mix of sweet and tart. Whether you are making this for an event or for your family at home, this treat is sure to please!

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
In a medium bowl, stir together brown sugar, flour and oats. Mix in the margarine or butter and set aside.
Spread the rhubarb and blueberries in an 8x8 inch baking dish and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, mix cornstarch and sugar and stir in the juice. Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until the mixture has thickened. Turn off the heat.
Stir in vanilla and pour the mixture over the rhubarb and blueberries.
Crumble oat mixture on top of the fruit.
Bake for 45 minutes or until topping is browned and fruit is bubbling at edges. Serve warm or cold.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
name_en: Rice Bowl Breakfast with Fruit and Nuts
name_fr: Bol de riz petit-déjeuner aux fruits et noix
name_latin: Roz ftour bel fwakeh o gergaa
desc_en: The sweet and savory combination of ingredients in this rice bowl makes it a great start to your day. Rice, fruit, and nuts come together to create a nutritious, filling breakfast.

steps: Combine cooked rice, milk and cinnamon in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on HIGH for 45 seconds. Stir and heat for another 45 to 60 seconds, or until rice mixture is heated through.
Divide rice mixture between two bowls. Top with fruit and nuts. Serve warm.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_en: Rice with Chicken | Arroz Con Pollo
desc_en: This stewed chicken and rice dish comes together with tomatoes and traditional seasonings. This one-pan meal is an all-time favorite.

steps: To trim, lay chicken thighs on the cutting board, skin side up. Push the chicken down so the excess fat is on the cutting board (the excess is the part that isn’t right on top of the chicken). Using kitchen scissors or a sharp knife, cut off excess fat and discard. Pat chicken dry with paper towels, and discard towels.
Place the skillet over medium high heat and when it is hot, add the chicken thighs, skin side down and cook until browned, then flip, about 5 minutes on each side.
Turn the heat off, carefully remove the chicken from the skillet and transfer to the plate. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat.
Reheat the skillet over low heat and add the onion, pepper, garlic, cumin, and oregano and cook until the onion is softened, about 10 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice and tomatoes and stir well.
Add the water and bouillon cube and bring to a boil over high heat. Return chicken to pan, skin side down, turn the heat down to low and cover.
Cook chicken for 20 minutes and then carefully flip so that the skin side is up.
Cover and cook for an additional 20 minutes. Serve right away.
حيدي الشحمة الزايدة من 280 غ فخد الدجاج ونشفيه.
سخني مقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة قوية، حطي الدجاج بالجلدة للتحت وحمريه 5 دقايق من كل جهة. خرجيه وحيدي الشحمة من المقلة وخلي غير معلقة.
على نار هادية زيدي بصلة مقطعة، فلفلة مقطعة، 3 حبات تومة مدقوقة، معلقة صغيرة كامون ومعلقة صغيرة أوريݣانو، وطيبيهم 10 دقايق حتى تطراو البصلة.

زيدي 480 مل ما وكيب ديال الدجاج وخليها تغلي على نار قوية. رجعي الدجاج بالجلدة للتحت، نقصي النار وغطي.
طيبي 20 دقيقة، قلبي الدجاج بالجلدة للفوق.
غطي وخليه 20 دقيقة أخرى. قدميه دغيا.
tips: الكامون والأوريݣانو هما الطعم ديال هاد الطبق، ما تنقصيهمش.
إلا الروز نشف قبل ما يطيب زيدي شوية ما سخون.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking Up Fun - A Pyramid of Snacks Cornell University Cooperative Extension Division of Nutritional Sciences)
desc_en: A fun and unique twist on pizza using rice as the crust. Enjoy this main dish with all of your favorite toppings!

steps: Heat oven to 350 °F. Grease a 12-inch pizza pan or baking sheet.
Cook rice following directions on the package; set aside.
Grate cheese; set aside.
Crack egg and place in mixing bowl, stirring to blend. Measure and add 2 cups cooked rice, 1 cup grated cheese, and salt. Mix well to combine ingredients.
Spread rice mixture in prepared pan, pressing firmly and making outer edge slightly raised.
Spread tomato purée evenly over rice mixture.
Place pan in oven. Bake for 25 minutes.
Remove pan from oven sprinkle pizza with remaining cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.
Remove pizza from oven. Cut into 12 slices.
tips: Create-a-Flavor Changes: - Try different kinds of rice. - Try different kinds of cheese. - Use sliced or chopped green peppers, onions, mushrooms, or other vegetables as toppings.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: Easy, delicious, and full of fruit, Rice Dessert is a nice way to end a good meal.

steps: Put aside 1/4 cup of drained pineapple.
Mix all other ingredients together in a medium-sized bowl.
Serve in small dishes.
Top with the remaining crushed pineapple.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipes and Tips for Healthy, Thrifty Meals USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Serve this recipe fresh off the stove or after it has chilled in the refrigerator.

steps: In sauce pan, heat milk and water.
Add rice, bring to boil, lower heat to simmer; stir mixture every 10 minutes. Cook uncovered until rice is tender, about 30 minutes.
In large bowl, mix eggs, 3/4 cup evaporated milk, vanilla, and sugar. Set aside.
Add remaining 1/4 cup evaporated milk to rice mixture.
Spoon 1 cup of rice mixture into egg mixture and stir. Pour egg-rice mixture into remaining rice.
Heat pudding until it boils, stirring continuously. Remove from heat, and sprinkle with cinnamon.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simply Good Eating Recipe Cards, Vol. 1, 2000, Adapted from Easy Rice Pudding University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Enjoy this classic rice pudding recipe that uses cinnamon and raisins, or any other favorite dried fruit, to make a wholesome dessert that has just the right amount of sweetness.

steps: Combine rice, water, and butter or margarine in large microwave safe dish. Cover loosely, so steam will escape.
Cook in microwave on high for 5 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce setting to defrost (50% power), and cook an additional 10 minutes.
Mix other ingredients together while rice is cooking.

Without allowing rice to cool, remove cover and quickly stir milk-water-raisin mixture into hot rice. Cover loosely again and continue cooking on defrost (50% power) for 10 minutes. After cooking time is finished, let pudding sit, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir gently and put in individual serving dishes.
Eat warm or cover and refrigerate immediately. Enjoy the refrigerated pudding within 2 days.
tips: * Used in analysis

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University and University of California at Davis)
desc_en: Enjoy this versatile recipe with family and friends. You can substitute other frozen and fresh veggies than the ones listed in the ingredients depending on what you have on hand.

steps: Mix rice, vegetables, and raisins in a medium-sized bowl.
Mix mayonnaise, dressing and salt in a small bowl. Stir into rice/vegetable mixture.
Refrigerate leftovers.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids… Get Cooking! California Department of Health Services California Children’s 5-A-Day Power Play Campaign)
desc_en: This cobbler can be made quickly in the microwave. Enjoy this tasty treat for breakfast or as a sweet dessert.

steps: In a large microwave-safe bowl, mix peaches, pears, prunes, and vanilla extract.
Rub an orange against a grater to remove 1 teaspoon of the orange peel. Then, cut the orange in half and squeeze 1/4 cup orange juice. Add orange peel and juice to fruit mixture. Stir.
Top with granola.
Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Let stand for 2 minutes.
Spoon into 4 bowls and serve warm.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Minnesota Extension)
desc_en: Roasted chicken is a simple and classic recipe that will never go out of style. Experiment with different seasonings, if you'd like. Try it with your favorite vegetables on the side for a delicious meal.

steps: Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Combine Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper (optional).
Rub chicken with oil, then rub with spice mixture.
Place chicken, breast side down, in roasting pan or Dutch oven.
Bake, uncovered, until internal temperature reaches at least 165 °F.
Let chicken rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Utah State University Cooperative Extension)
name_en: Roast Turkey Breast with Rosemary, Sage, and Thyme
name_fr: Rôti de dinde au romarin, sauge et thym
name_latin: Sder dik roumi mhammer bel a3chab
desc_en: Perfect for a holiday gathering, this roast turkey breast can be prepated in less time than a whole turkey. Enjoy!

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Place turkey breast in roasting pan along with onion and carrot.
Mix spices with olive oil. Rub turkey with olive oil.
Roast turkey at 400 °F for 15 minutes. Baste with margarine and chicken broth (optional).

Reduce turkey temperature to 350 °F and roast turkey, basting every 20 minutes with pan juices (or margarine and chicken broth), about 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until meat thermometer inserted in thick part of meat registers 165 °F.
Remove to carving board and let rest for 10 minutes.
سخني الفرن على 200 درجة.
حطي 1.4 كيلو صدر الديك الرومي فطبق الفرن مع بصلة كبيرة وخيزوة كبيرة مقطعين على ربعة.
خلطي معلقة صغيرة سالمية، معلقة صغيرة زعيترة ومعلقة صغيرة أزير مع 3 معالق زيت العود، ملحة وإبزار. دهني بيهم الديك الرومي.
دخليه 15 دقيقة على 200 درجة.
نقصي الفرن ل180 درجة وخليه ساعة وربع، وصبي عليه المرقة ديال الطبق (ولا شوية مرقة الدجاج) كل 20 دقيقة، حتى يطيب من الداخل.
خرجيه وخليه يرتاح 10 دقايق قبل ما تقطعيه.
tips: الراحة قبل التقطيع كتخلي اللحم عصير.
ممكن تطيبي دجاجة كاملة بنفس الطريقة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Roasting brings out the natural sweetness of the bell peppers. Modify this recipe by trying other seasonings, such as oregano or dried basil.

steps: Preheat oven to 450 °F.

Wash bell peppers and remove tops and seeds. Cut peppers in half and rub with vegetable oil. Place cut side up on a rimmed baking sheet and sprinkle with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Roast until peppers are tender and blistered in spots, about 30 to 35 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Roasted Brussels Sprouts, Potatoes, and Chicken
name_fr: Choux de Bruxelles, pommes de terre et poulet rôtis
name_latin: Kromb sghir o btata o djaj fel ferran
desc_en: A versatile, fall, baked dish, our tasty version features potatoes and Brussels sprouts. Other fall vegetables -- such as parsnips, carrots, and cabbage -- could be substituted.

steps: Preheat oven to 325 °F.
In a 2 quart baking dish coated with cooking spray, toss Brussels sprouts, potatoes, onion, and garlic with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix cheese with milk.
Coat chicken breasts with remaining olive oil.
Nest among vegetables in baking dish.
Top with cheese mix.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is done.
سخني الفرن على 160 درجة.
فطبق فرن مدهون خلطي 450 غ كرومب صغير مقطع على جوج، 4 حبات بطاطا حمرا مقطعين قطع، 75 غ بصلة مقطعة و2 حبات تومة مدقوقة مع معلقة زيت العود، ربع معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار.
فطبسيل صغير خلطي 55 غ ريكوتا (ولا جبن) و30 غ موزاريلا مع 2 معالق حليب.
دهني 450 غ صدر الدجاج بمعلقة زيت العود.
حطي الدجاج وسط الخضرة.
فرشي خليط الفرماج فوق الدجاج.
غطي بورق الألومنيوم ودخليه 40 حتى 45 دقيقة حتى يطيب الدجاج.
tips: حيدي الورق فآخر 10 دقايق باش يحمر الفرماج.
الكرومب الصغير كيولي حلو ملي كيتحمر فالفرن.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Roasting Brussels sprouts creates a warm, flavorful, and versatile vegetable dish. This recipe is simple and does not require many ingredients.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Wash and trim Brussels sprouts. Cut large Brussels sprouts in half from top to bottom; leave small Brussels sprouts whole.
In a large bowl, toss Brussels sprouts with the oil, salt, and pepper.
Place Brussels sprouts in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Lining the baking sheet with foil or baking parchment will help with clean-up.
Roast for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring once after 10 to 15 minutes. Sprouts should be tender and browned.
Remove from oven and drizzle with lemon juice.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Cauliflower steaks are a fun way to get in some of your daily vegetables! This simple recipe spices up cauliflower using lemon juice and garlic powder.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Lightly grease a large baking sheet.
Slice cauliflower from top to bottom through the core into 1- to 1 1/2- inch thick steaks. Put steaks on the baking sheet along with end pieces, flat side down.
In a small bowl, mix the rest of the ingredients, except cheese.
Spoon on and spread or brush the cauliflower with half the mixture. Roast for 20 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, carefully turn the steaks and spread the rest of the mixture. Roast for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cauliflower is browned and tender.
Sprinkle with cheese, if desired, and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Maryland Cooperative Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Oven-roasted cauliflower sprinkled with cheese is a simple and delicious side dish that pairs well with any entrée.

steps: Remove outer leaves of cauliflower. Cut florets off the stem. Wash and drain.
Combine oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Toss the cauliflower florets in the oil mixture.
Spread cauliflower on a large rimmed baking sheet.
Roast in the oven at 450 °F for 15 to 20 minutes until the cauliflower starts to soften and begins to brown.
Sprinkle with cheese. Continue to roast for 5 to 10 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP))
desc_en: These crunchy chickpeas make a great on-the-go snack or a healthy topping to your favorite salad. Experiment with different spices to see which ones you like best.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Drain and rinse the beans until there is no foamy residue. Pick out the skins and discard. Wrap the drained beans in a clean towel to dry thoroughly.
Measure oil into a 9x13 baking dish or foil lined pan. Pour beans into dish, sprinkle with salt and spices. Mix oil and spices well to coat all the beans.
Bake for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring or shaking every 15 minutes. Longer makes more crunch, but watch to prevent burning!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
name_fr: Pommes de terre rôties aux herbes
desc_en: Rosemary adds a delicious flavor and aroma to these potatoes. Enjoy your herb roasted potatoes as a side to your favorite protein food entrée.

steps: Preheat the oven to 450 °F.
Coat a baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray.
Wash and peel the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes, and put them in a large bowl.
Put the oil, rosemary, and salt in a small bowl. Stir together.
Pour the oil mix over the potatoes. Stir to coat the potatoes evenly.
Spread the potatoes on the baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by the National Pork Board, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
name_en: Roasted beef Tacos with Pico de Gallo
name_fr: Tacos de bœuf rôti, pico de gallo
desc_en: Enjoy the bold flavors of roasted beef steak tacos, perfectly complemented by a fresh and zesty pico de gallo. This vibrant dish brings together tender meat and a medley of vibrant ingredients for a satisfying meal that’s sure to impress.

ingredients.en: Red onion, cut into small cubes

steps: Pico de gallo: In a bowl, mix all the ingredients. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Seasoning: In a small bowl, mix the paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Remove the silver skin from the beef tenderloin, rub it with oil and coat the entire loin with the seasoning.
Place the beef tenderloin on the grill at medium/high heat (400˚F), over indirect heat, for approximately 6 minutes on each side, 18 minutes total.
Cook until it reaches internal temperature of 145˚F with a 3-minute rest. Then chop it into small pieces.
To make the tacos, heat the tortillas and place some beef tenderloin and pico de gallo on top.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Everyone loves these roasted potatoes, and they are easy to make.

steps: In a medium-sized bowl, mix potatoes, onions, green peppers, and garlic.
Add vegetable oil, salt, and pepper to bowl. If using parsley and paprika, add that too. Mix well.
Cover bowl and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Spread potato mixture evenly on a cookie sheet. Bake for about 35 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Regional Mental Health Center Cookbook Regional Mental Health Center)
name_fr: Mélange de graines de courge grillées
desc_en: A quick and tasty snack mix that can be tossed together and enjoyed instantly while you are on the go, no cooking required.

ingredients.en: Crispy rice or wheat cereal squares

steps: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service)
desc_en: A variety of root vegetables like sweet potatoes, beets, and turnips make this colorful dish festive and nutritious.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Cut vegetables into large chunks.
Place in a medium-sized bowl and pour oil over top. Add seasonings or Parmesan and mix well.
Spread an even layer on a baking sheet or pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until tender. Check a few vegetables to see if they are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (2009 Recipe Calendar University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: For a delicious way to enjoy heirloom tomatoes in peak season, here is a great recipe to celebrate your tomato harvest.

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F.
Spray a large baking sheet with cooking oil spray.
Cut each tomato in half. Place tomatoes on the sheet, cut side up.
Drizzle tomatoes with 1/2 of the oil and season with pepper.
Cook for 30 minutes, or until tomatoes are beginning to brown on the bottom.
Mix the remaining oil, parsley, garlic, and cheese in a small bowl.
Remove tomatoes from the oven and sprinkle the herb mixture over the tomatoes.
Return to oven for another 10 minutes, or until spices begin to brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (For Cooking Without Looking, Use a Crock Pot University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service Dunn County UW-Extension Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: A hearty, savory, and delicious dish that is packed with meat, potatoes, and tomatoes that can be easily prepared in a slow cooker.

steps: Season round steak lightly with garlic salt, salt and pepper.
Cut into serving pieces and place in crock pot with sliced onion, which has been separated into rings.
Add potatoes and green beans.
Top with tomato soup and tomatoes.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Remove cover during last half-hour if there is too much liquid.
To cook in 2-quart crock pot, reduce ingredients slightly.
تبلي 910 غ لحم البݣري بمعلقة صغيرة ملحة بالتومة، ملحة وإبزار.
قطعيه قطع ديال الأكل وحطيه فالطنجرة (ولا السلو كوكر) مع بصلة مقطعة حلقات.
زيدي 3 حبات بطاطا مقطعين و400 غ لوبيا خضرا.
صبي فوقهم 290 غ شوربة الماطيشة (ولا صلصة ماطيشة) و410 غ ماطيشة مقطعة ديال البواطة.
فالسلو كوكر: غطي وخليه على الهادية 8 سوايع. فالطنجرة: غطي وخليه على نار هادية ساعتين ونص حتى يطيب اللحم.
حيدي الغطاء فآخر نص ساعة إلا كان الما بزاف.
tips: اللحم ديال الكتف ولا الفخد كيمشي مزيان للطياب الطويل.
زيدي شوية كامون وفلفلة حلوة للطعم المغربي.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (California 5 A Day, It’s So Easy, Adapted from Oprah's Outtasight Salad Contra Costa Health Services)
name_en: Salad with Pineapple, Nuts, and Raisins
name_fr: Salade ananas, noix et raisins secs
name_latin: Chladat ananas bel gergaa o zbib
desc_en: This dish is overflowing with fresh veggies and fun flavors. Pineapple adds extra tang.

steps: Put mixed salad greens on a large platter or in a salad bowl.
In a large bowl, mix chopped vegetables and pineapple or orange segments.
Add dressing and stir.
Spoon mixture over salad greens.
Top with raisins and nuts. Serve.
tips: Dynamite Dressing preparation: - In a small bowl, mix all ingredients. - Refrigerate until ready to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (North Dakota Food and Culture: A Taste of World Cuisine North Dakota State University Extension Service)
name_en: Salata Ma Jibna (Salad with Parmesan Cheese)
desc_en: Onions, carrots, and cabbage give this dish a crunchy and crisp texture. Lemon juice and vinegar give the veggies a tangy flavor. Enjoy along side of your favorite entrée.

ingredients.en: Onions, cut into slivers or thin slices
Cabbage, cut into slivers or thin slices
Carrots, cut into very thin slices

steps: In a salad bowl, combine onions, cabbage, carrots, and tomatoes.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Sprinkle garlic and Parmesan over salad.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Salmon Burgers and Sweet Potato Oven Fries
name_fr: Burgers de saumon et frites de patate douce
name_ar: بورݣر السالمون مع فريت البطاطا الحلوة
name_latin: Burger salmon m3a frite btata hlowa
desc_en: A colorful, casual meal that's surprising simple to prepare.

steps: Place oven rack in center, heat oven to 425 °F.
Wash and scrub sweet potatoes, slice into wedges, length-wise.
In a large bowl, toss potato wedges with canola oil and seasoning.
Spread on cookie sheet. Roast in the oven, turning occasionally, until tender and golden brown, about 30 to 40 minutes.
While sweet potatoes are roasting, prepare salmon burgers. Drain salmon; place in a medium mixing bowl and flake.
Fold in green onions and red pepper, crushed crackers, lemon juice, egg whites, and yogurt.
Shape into 4 patties.
Coat large nonstick skillet lightly with cooking spray; heat.
Cook salmon burgers until golden brown, turn, and continue cooking until other side is golden brown.
Serve burgers with sliced tomatoes and lettuce, and sweet potato oven fries.
سخني الفرن على 220 درجة.
غسلي 4 حبات بطاطا حلوة وقطعيهم أصابع بالطول.
فطبسيل كبير خلطيهم مع معلقة ونص زيت ومعلقة كبيرة توابل بالحامض والإبزار.
فرشيهم فصينية الفرن ودخليهم 30 حتى 40 دقيقة، وقلبيهم من وقت لوقت، حتى يطيبو ويحمرو.
للبورݣر: صفي 400 غ سالمون ديال البواطة وفتتيه فطبسيل.
زيدي 2 بصلات خضر مقطعين، 75 غ فلفلة حمرا مقطعة، 8 بسكويات مالحين مهرسين، 2 معالق صغار عصير الحامض، 2 بياض البيض مخفوق و2 معالق دانون. خلطي.
صاوبي 4 كفتات.
دهني مقلة كبيرة بشوية زيت وسخنيها.
طيبي الكفتات حتى تحمر من جهة، قلبيها وحمري الجهة الثانية.
قدميها ف4 خبزات بورݣر كاملين مع شرائح 2 ماطيشات وورق الخس، والفريت ديال البطاطا الحلوة.
tips: إلا كانت الكفتة كتفتت، زيدي شوية شابلور.
السالمون ديال البواطة كيمشي مزيان وأرخص من الطري.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Nebraska at Lincoln Nebraska Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This simple recipe makes good use of canned salmon, or you can also use leftover salmon if you have some on-hand. Out of both? Try canned tuna!

steps: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together. Mixture will be moist.
Spray a large skillet with non-stick cooking spray. Heat skillet. Drop fish mixture onto the skillet using a 1/3 or 1/2 cup measuring cup. Brown on both sides.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Wellness Ways Resource Book University of Illinois Extension Service)
desc_en: This delicate salmon loaf is lower in calories than traditional meat loaf, and pairs well with steamed spinach or broccoli and roasted sweet potatoes.

steps: Preheat oven to 325 °F.
Drain salmon and remove skin if desired. Mash bones with meat.
Add the other ingredients.
Add enough milk so that the mixture is moist but not runny.
Place in a lightly oiled 9x5 inch loaf pan.
Bake for 45 minutes.
Serve.
سخني الفرن على 160 درجة.
صفي 55 غ سالمون ديال البواطة (ولا أكثر إلا بغيتي) وحيدي الجلدة. هرسي العظم الرقيق مع اللحم.
زيدي 220 غ خبز مفتت، بصلة مقطعة صغيرة مقلية فمعلقة زبدة، 40 غ كرافس مقطع، معلقة عصير الحامض، معلقة صغيرة معدنوس و2 بيضات.
زيدي من 240 مل حليب حتى يولي الخليط رطب لكن ماشي سايل.
حطيه فقالب ديال الكيك مدهون بشوية زيت (23 على 13 سم).
دخليه 45 دقيقة.
قطعيه شرائح وقدمي.
tips: هاد الوصفة رطبة بالخبز، زيدي علبة سالمون كاملة (400 غ) باش تكون أغنى.
كتمشي مع صلصة الدانون بالحامض.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eat for Health Toolkit Recipe by Missouri Nutrition Network Optional additions from ONIE Project & Colorado State University Extension)
desc_en: Tasty patties cooked in a skillet that are perfect topped with fresh lettuce, tomato, and a side of fresh or canned pineapple.

steps: Wash fresh vegetables (if using).
Collect, mince, and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Open salmon, and drain liquid into a liquid measuring cup. Add lemon juice and cold water to the salmon liquid to make 1/2 cup liquid total, and set aside.
Put the salmon in a separate mixing bowl. Mix in the celery (if using), green pepper (if using), and onion.
In another small bowl, beat the eggs. Then, add them to the salmon mixture.
Add the bread or cracker crumbs, flour, pepper, and the salmon liquid mixture to the salmon mixture, and stir until all ingredients are mixed together.
Use 1/3 cup measuring cup to measure salmon mixture. Shape into a 1/2 inch thick patty, and place on a plate. Repeat to make 6 patties.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, then add 3 patties.
Cook for about 2 to 3 minutes (or until golden brown) on each side.
Remove patties from skillet, and place on a clean paper towel-lined plate to drain. Cook remaining 3 patties, then serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Eat within 3 to 5 days.
حلي 400 غ سالمون ديال البواطة وصفي الما ديالو فكاس. زيدي معلقة عصير الحامض وما بارد حتى 120 مل. خبيه.
حطي السالمون فطبسيل وخلطيه مع شوية كرافس مقطع صغير، شوية فلفلة خضرا ونص بصلة مقطعة صغيرة.
خفقي 2 بيضات وزيديهم للسالمون.
زيدي 35 غ شابلور، 2 معالق فرينة، ربع معلقة إبزار والما ديال السالمون، وحركي حتى يتخلط كلشي.
صاوبي 6 كفتات غلاضهم 1 سم.
سخني معلقة زيت فمقلة على نار متوسطة وحطي 3 كفتات.
طيبيهم 2 حتى 3 دقايق من كل جهة حتى يحمرو.
خرجيهم على منديل وطيبي الباقي. قدميهم سخانين.
tips: إلا كانت الكفتة رطبة بزاف زيدي شوية شابلور.
كتمشي مع صلصة الدانون بالحامض والشلاضة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Connecticut Family Nutrition Program Senior Nutrition Awareness Project (SNAP) Newsletters)
desc_en: A zesty spread that is perfect as a snack. Serve with whole grain bread, crackers, or rice cakes.

steps: Drain salmon and flake with a fork into a bowl.
Mix in all other ingredients.
Serve on bread, crackers, or a rice cake.
Sprinkle chopped parsley to garnish.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (2009 Recipe Calendar University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Spicy, savory beans make a great fiber-filled side dish.

steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until tender.
Stir in the beans and salsa.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Serve over rice, pasta, or baked potato.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Nebraska SNAP-Ed, Adapted from Easy No-Cook Salsa)
desc_en: This fresh tasting salsa is easy to whip up for your next get together.

steps: In a large bowl, stir together all the ingredients until well mixed. Cover and chill at least 4 hours.
Serve with Baked Tortilla Chips or raw vegetables.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eat Smart New York! Cornell University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: There are endless options for where you would want to add this seasoning blend -- rice, meat, fish, vegetables, and more! Try on your favorite dish to boost flavor but not salt.

steps: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl, using a spoon.
Place mix into a container that allows you to shake to dispense.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Houston Food Bank Chef Jose Montoya)
desc_en: This tuna salad gets its creamy flavor from the avocado and a slight punch from the crushed red pepper.

steps: Drain tuna. Transfer to a mixing bowl and mix well with avocado for texture.
Add tomatoes, onion, pepper, lime juice, salt, and mango.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion Recipe submitted by Sarah, MyPlate Nutritionist)
desc_en: This is a healthier version of my mom’s green bean casserole recipe. My version has more vegetables and almost half the sodium per portion. The secret ingredient is the onion powder mixed with the cracker crumb topping. It tastes a lot like the fried onions in my mom’s recipe. I knew the result was good when my husband said he liked it better than the original. Enjoy!

steps: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Blanch the green beans in boiling water for about 4 minutes for crisper beans or longer for a softer texture. Then plunge in ice water. Drain and set aside.
Place diced onions and mushrooms in a microwaveable bowl and microwave for about 2 1/2 minutes on high to soften. Set aside.
Melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, stir in flour with a whisk and cook for about 1 minute (continuously whisking).
Whisk in the milk and cook over low heat until you have a thick white sauce.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt.
Stir the drained green beans, onions, and mushrooms into the white sauce (including any liquid with the onions and mushrooms).
Pour into a casserole dish sprayed with nonstick spray. Crush the crackers and toss cracker crumbs with olive oil and onion powder. Sprinkle over the top of the casserole.
Bake at 350 °F for about 30 minutes or until crackers are golden brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion Recipe submitted by Sarah, MyPlate Nutritionist)
name_fr: Soupe de dinde au curry épicée
desc_en: This turkey curry soup is a fun and flavorful dish to make with turkey dinner leftovers. You can use your leftover cranberry sauce to garnish the soup. A spoonful of cranberry sauce or chutney adds a cooling sweet, tangy flavor to balance the spicy curry.

steps: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and celery and cook for about 7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in flour, curry powder, and cinnamon and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in chicken broth and scrape up any brown bits at the bottom of the pan.
Bring to a simmer. Then add carrots, spinach, potatoes, and turkey.
Bring to a boil. Then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer (covered) for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve in bowls and garnish with a spoonful of cranberry sauce.
سخني معلقة زيت العود ومعلقة زبدة فطنجرة كبيرة على نار متوسطة. زيدي 150 غ بصلة و150 غ كرافس مقطعين وطيبيهم 7 دقايق.
زيدي 2 معالق فرينة، ثلاثة أرباع معلقة كبيرة كاري وربع معلقة قرفة، وحركي 2 حتى 3 دقايق.
صبي 560 مل مرقة الدجاج وحكي القاع ديال الطنجرة.
خليها تبدا تغلي، زيدي 300 غ خيزو مقطع، 120 غ سلق، 3 حبات بطاطا حمرا مقطعة و420 غ ديك رومي مطيب ومقطع.
خليها تغلي ثم نقصي النار.
غطي وخليها تطيب 30 دقيقة وحركي من وقت لوقت.
قدميها فطبسيلات مع معلقة كونفيتور التوت الأحمر من الفوق (اختياري).
tips: ممكن تستعملي الدجاج بلاصة الديك الرومي.
الكاري مع القرفة كيعطي طعم دافي، زيدي شوية إلا بغيتيها حارة أكثر.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
name_latin: Sandwich sardine bel khyar o matecha
desc_en: Toasted whole grain bread is stacked with cucumbers, sardines, tomato, and sliced red onion. Try canned tuna or salmon as tasty alternatives for sardines.

steps: Put 4 slices toasted bread on the cutting board. Arrange cucumber slices on top of each slice.
Distribute the sardines evenly on top of the cucumber and using the fork, gently mash them. Spread the mashed sardines to cover the cucumber. Squeeze the lemon juice over the sardines.
Put the tomato slices on top of the sardines. Add the red onion. Top with the remaining slices of toast and press down gently to hold the sandwich together.
Cut the sandwich in half and serve right away.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Don’t throw away your beet greens! The leafy tops of beets can be so tasty. In this recipe, lemon juice, vegetable oil, and seasonings give them a bold flavor profile.

ingredients.en: Garlic, minced or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder (cloves)

steps: Heat oil in a medium-sized pan over medium heat.
