Brown ground beef and turkey and minced onion in skillet. Drain fat.
Place cooked and drained meat mixture, bread crumbs, water, and pepper into mixing bowl.

Drain tomatoes, reserving liquid, and add 1/2 cup of tomato juice from can to meat mixture. Mix well; then place 1/4 cup of filling on each parboiled, drained cabbage leaf. Place folded side down in large skillet.
In skillet top cabbages with tomatoes, sliced onion, water, shredded cabbage, and carrot. Cover and simmer about 1 hour (or until cabbage is tender), basting occasionally.
Remove cabbage rolls to serving platter; keep warm.
Mix lemon juice, brown sugar, and cornstarch together in small bowl. Add to vegetables and liquid in skillet, and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened and clear. Serve over cabbage rolls.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Massachusetts Extension Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: These tostadas are layered with refried beans, turkey, and cheese to create a delicious and easy dinner. Top with tomatoes, lettuce, and onions to increase your veggies.

steps: Preheat oven to 375° F.
Wash and prepare vegetables.
In a large skillet over medium heat, combine turkey, taco seasoning, and water.
Bring mixture to boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place tortillas on a baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 4 to 7 minutes or until tortillas are crispy.
Spread tortillas with a tablespoon of beans. Top with 1/4 meat mixture and cheese.
Return tortillas to oven to cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Top with tomatoes, lettuce, onions, and taco sauce. Garnish with yogurt and guacamole, if desired.
سخني الفرن على 190 درجة.
غسلي وقطعي الخضرة: 75 غ ماطيشة، 30 غ خس و2 معالق بصلة.
فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة خلطي 280 غ كفتة الديك الرومي، 2 معالق توابل الطاكو و360 مل ما.
خليها تغلي، نقصي النار وخليها 5 دقايق وحركي.
حطي 4 طورطيات ديال الدرة فصينية الفرن ودخليهم 4 حتى 7 دقايق حتى يقرمشو.
فرشي معلقة لوبيا مهرسة على كل طورطيا. زيدي ربع الكفتة و30 غ فرماج محكوك.
رجعيهم للفرن 2 حتى 3 دقايق حتى يذوب الفرماج.
زيدي الماطيشة، الخس، البصلة و2 معالق صلصة الطاكو على كل واحدة. زوقي بالدانون والݣواكامولي.
tips: الطورطيا المقرمشة كتكسر إلا عمرتيها بزاف.
ممكن تستعملي كفتة البݣري ولا الدجاج.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: A great way to try turnips. Full of vegetables and packed with flavor, turnip pancakes will satisfy audiences of all ages.

steps: In a large bowl, mix flour, pepper, egg, garlic, soy sauce, and water in a bowl until smooth.
Stir in the turnip, carrot, and green onion
Heat half of oil in a large skillet over medium heat (350 °F in an electric skillet). Pour about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake into skillet. Flatten with a fork into a 3-inch circle.

Cook until edges look dry and bottom is golden, about 3 to 4 minutes. Turn once. Cook until bottom is golden and crispy. Repeat with remaining batter, adding remaining oil as needed. Pancakes will be moist in the center.
Combine dipping sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Serve with warm pancakes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This simple and fun snack is created using only fresh apples and canned oranges.

steps: Wash apple. Cut in half (see notes).
Place apple half in center of small plate.
Put mandarin oranges next to apple for arms, legs, and head.
Enjoy your Turtle Apple.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit)
name_fr: Poêlée de pommes de terre à la toscane
desc_en: Lemon zest, garlic, and rosemary add a delightful Tuscan twist to this green bean, potato, and chicken skillet. The best part? Only having to use one pan to whip up this weeknight favorite, which also makes clean-up a breeze!

steps: Cut each potato into 4 wedges. Place in a large microwave-safe bowl and season with salt and pepper. Microwave on HIGH for 4 minutes. Stir and microwave for 4 minutes more.
While potatoes are cooking, cut each chicken tenderloin into 4 equal pieces.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until nicely browned, stirring frequently.
Add remaining oil and potatoes; cook and stir for 5 minutes more to brown potatoes and fully cook chicken.
Stir in rosemary, garlic, green beans, lemon zest and juice. Cook for a few minutes more to heat through. Season to taste with salt and pepper
قطعي 10 حبات بطاطا حمرا صغار على ربعة. حطيهم فطبسيل ديال الميكرو مع نص معلقة ملحة وربع معلقة إبزار. طيبيهم فالميكرو 4 دقايق، حركي، و4 دقايق أخرى (ولا سلقيهم 10 دقايق).
قطعي 450 غ دجاج قطع صغار.
سخني معلقة زيت العود فمقلة كبيرة على نار متوسطة قوية. زيدي الدجاج وطيبيه 5 دقايق حتى يحمر، وحركي.
زيدي معلقة زيت أخرى والبطاطا، وقلبي 5 دقايق حتى تحمر البطاطا ويطيب الدجاج.
زيدي معلقة أزير مقطع، 4 حبات تومة مدقوقة، 420 غ لوبيا خضرا، قشرة حامضة وعصيرها. خليها دقايق حتى تسخن. زيدي ملحة وإبزار على حسب الذوق.
tips: اللوبيا الخضرا ديال البواطة ولا المجمدة كتمشي مزيان هنا.
الأزير الطري كيعطي الطعم الإيطالي، إلا ما عندكش استعملي زعيترة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
name_latin: Chili b jouj anwa3 dyal loubya
desc_en: This no-fuss chili is a great way to use ground beef and beans to make a tasty main dish. Chili can be served by itself, with crackers, cooked rice, or baked potato.

steps: In a medium-sized pot, brown ground beef over medium to high heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain fat.
Add kidney beans, vegetarian beans, onions, chili powder, tomato juice, and pepper.
Cook over low heat for about 40 minutes. Serve hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Original Recipe Name - Indian Vegetables and Rice Skillet Meal Healthy Recipes Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: An easy and delicious one-pot dish that makes plenty of leftovers to savor!

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, turmeric, and cumin, stir while cooking for 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat.
Simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.
Refrigerate leftovers with in 2 to 3 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Cooked turkey combined with your favorite frozen veggies means you can throw this stir fry together quickly for a healthy weekday dinner.

steps: Heat fry pan. Add oil and heat on high temperature.
Add ginger, garlic, turkey, and vegetables. Stir fry about 1 minute to coat with oil.
Adjust heat to prevent scorching. Add sugar. If vegetables are tender, stop cooking at this time.
If the vegetables are firm, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of water, cover and cook for 2 minutes or until tender.
Serve at once, or if you wish to add a gravy, mix the gravy ingredients well, pour over vegetables and turkey, cook for 30 seconds.
قطعي 450 غ ديك رومي قطع صغار، و560 غ خضرة (خيزو، بروكلي، فلفلة) رقاق.
سخني مقلة كبيرة على نار قوية، زيدي معلقة زيت.
زيدي 2 شرائح سكنجبير طري، حبة تومة مدقوقة، الديك الرومي والخضرة. قلبي دقيقة حتى يتغطى كلشي بالزيت.
نقصي النار شوية باش ما يحرقش، زيدي نص معلقة صغيرة سكر ونص معلقة ملحة.
إلا الخضرة مازال قاسحة، زيدي معلقتين ما، غطي وخليها 2 دقايق.
للصلصة: خلطي معلقة كبيرة مايزينا مع 70 مل مرقة و2 معالق صغار صوجا، صبيها فوق وقلبي 30 ثانية حتى تخثر.
tips: النار خاصها تكون قوية باش تبقى الخضرة مقرمشة.
قطعي كلشي قبل ما تبدي، القلي كيمشي دغيا.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Nebraska at Lincoln Nebraska Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Swiss cheese, vegetables, and curry powder make this thick and creamy soup a filling meal on a cold night this winter. Serve with whole wheat toast on the side.

steps: Bring 2 cups water to a boil. Add vegetables, onions, salt, and curry powder. Cover and cook until almost tender.
Mix dry milk, 1 cup water and cornstarch together. Add to partially cooked vegetables.
Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until thickened.
Add cheese and stir until melted. Add more water if too thick.
Top with green onions if desired.
خلي 480 مل ما يغلي. زيدي 450 غ خضرة مخلطة، 40 غ بصلة مقطعة، معلقة صغيرة ملحة ورشة كاري. غطي وطيبي حتى تقرب الخضرة تطيب.
خلطي 240 مل حليب بودرة (ولا حليب عادي) مع 240 مل ما ومعلقة ونص كبيرة مايزينا. زيديهم للخضرة.
طيبي على نار متوسطة وحركي حتى تخثر.
زيدي 55 غ فرماج إيمونتال محكوك وحركي حتى يذوب. زيدي ما إلا كانت خاثرة بزاف.
زوقيها بالبصلة الخضرا.
tips: شوربة سريعة كيبغيوها الدراري بالفرماج.
الخضرة المجمدة كتمشي مزيان.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: Chunks of zucchini, sweet potatoes, and frozen corn add a creative twist to this chili dish. Combined with canned beans and diced tomatoes this tasty one-pot meal will hit the spot.

ingredients.en: 16 ounce low-sodium dark red kidney beans

steps: Put the pot over medium heat and when it is hot, add the oil. Add the onions, zucchini, sweet potatoes, garlic, and spices and cook, stirring from time to time, for 20 minutes.
Add the kidney beans and tomatoes. Stir and cook, covered, until the squash is tender, about 30 minutes.
Add the corn and cook until warmed throughout.
Serve right away or transfer to a container once cooled. Refrigerate up to 5 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Illinois Extension Service)
desc_en: Honey and brown mustard are the secret ingredients in this dip, the perfect compliment for raw veggies. Whip this up today, and start snacking.

steps: Mix together all ingredients.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: This rice dish blends the flavors of soy sauce, pepper, and vegetables for a quick meal. It's cooked in one pan so clean up is quick too.

steps: Make 2 cups of cooked white rice. Use the package directions to make the rice.
Chop 1/2 cup of celery and 1/4 cup of onion.
Heat the oil in a skillet or large frying pan.
Add the celery and onion. Stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetables to the pan. Keep stirring the vegetables until they are tender-crisp.
Add the cooked rice.
Sprinkle with soy sauce and pepper.
Stir fry for 2 minutes until the rice is heated and the flavors are blended.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (California 5 A Day, It’s So Easy Contra Costa Health Services)
name_fr: Légumes et dip à la salsa
desc_en: Use this colorful veggie plate at your next party or gathering.

steps: Arrange vegetables on a platter.
In a small bowl, mix sour cream and salsa. Serve.
tips: Fresh Salsa Preparation: - In a medium bowl, mix lime juice, tomatoes, onions, jalapeño chiles, cilantro, and salt. - Store salsa in refrigerator for up to three days in a covered plastic or glass container.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Spunky Vegetable Pizza, California 5 A Day, It’s So Easy Contra Costa Health Services)
desc_en: Enjoy fresh, delicious pizza made at home. You can spice this up with red pepper flakes or garlic powder. Try with whatever vegetables you have on hand.

steps: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.
Spoon pizza sauce on pizza shell.
Put pizza shell on a cookie sheet. Arrange vegetables over sauce. Sprinkle on the cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes.
When baked, cool pizza for 3 minutes before slicing. Cut into 8 wedges.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Celebrate Health with a Lowfat Fiesta California Department of Health Services California Project LEAN)
desc_en: Rice, vegetables, and seasoning are a winning flavor combination in this tasty side dish.

ingredients.en: Mexican or Italian style tomatoes, low-sodium

steps: Heat oil in medium-sized saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the rice until just golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup of chicken broth if moisture is needed.
Add onions and garlic and cook for a minute or two.
Stir in the tomatoes and their juice, the rest of the chicken broth, salt, and bell pepper (if using). Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until the broth is absorbed.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wyoming Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: This tasty, marinaded veggie salad uses canned veggies and can be enjoyed at any time of the year. Use fresh vegetables if you have them on hand.

steps: Drain corn, carrots, and chickpeas. Throw away liquid. Rinse vegetables and drain again.
Drain tomatoes but save 1/3 cup of the liquid.
Mix corn, carrots, chickpeas, tomatoes, onion, and green pepper in a large bowl.
Mix together all other ingredients in a separate bowl.
Pour over vegetables.
Cover and set aside for at least 3 hours in the refrigerator.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Get creative with your fresh veggie snacks. This recipe calls for cucumber and tomatoes, but you can use your favorite veggies for this snack.

steps: Wash ingredients.
Put cucumber slices (see notes) on a small plate to form a snake.
Add 2 slices of tomatoes for eyes.
Enjoy your Vegetable Snake.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods Adapted from a recipe by Natalie Gibson, San Pasqual Reservation)
desc_en: This soup can be prepared quickly in one pot for lunch or dinner.

steps: In a large pot, heat the chicken and water over medium to high heat until hot.
Cut the kernels off the ears of corn.
Add the corn kernels and all other ingredients to the pot and boil for 10 seconds.
Lower the heat and simmer for about 30 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Heart Healthy Home Cooking: African American Style US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: The green chili pepper adds delicious spice and flavor to this potato, corn, and summer squash stew.

ingredients.en: Sweet corn, 15 ounces, rinsed and drained, low-sodium

steps: Put water and bouillon in large pot and bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and carrots and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients, except for tomatoes, and continue cooking for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Remove 4 chunks of squash and purée in blender.
Return puréed mixture to pot and let cook for 10 minutes more.
Add tomatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes to allow stew to thicken.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
desc_en: This stroganoff starts with onion, garlic, carrots, zucchini, red bell pepper, and basil combined with a creamy tomato paste and yogurt sauce. Mixed with shaped pasta, this twist on stroganoff is a simple meal and real crowd pleaser.

steps: To cook the pasta, fill a pot halfway with water. Bring it to a boil over high heat. When it has boiled, add the pasta and cook until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain the pasta and set aside.

While the pasta is cooking, cook the stroganoff: Put a skillet over medium heat and when it is hot, add the oil. Add the onion, garlic, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and dried basil and cook until soft and golden, about 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook until the sauce comes together, about 20 minutes.
Put the yogurt and tomato paste in the bowl, stirring until smooth.

Turn the heat off and move the vegetables in the skillet to one side. Gradually add the tomato paste mixture to the other side of the skillet, stirring all the while. Turn the heat to low and cook about 5 minutes, until heated through.
Add the cooked pasta and stir until mixed.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Veggin’ Out Recipe Book Johnson and Wales University and Rhode Island Department of Health WIC Program)
desc_en: This delicious chili packed full of veggies, beans, and spices is fast enough for a weeknight dinner. Top with cilantro for a boost of flavor.

steps: In a large pot sauté onions, bell pepper, garlic, and jalapeno in oil over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add chili powder, cumin, half of the chopped cilantro, salt, and pepper, and continue cooking for another 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomatoes, zucchini, and squash. Bring mixture to a simmer.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add beans, and continue to simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve the mixture hot. Put remaining cilantro on top.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University Extension)
desc_en: Want to add more leafy greens to your diet but aren’t sure how to start? Check out this recipe for collard greens. A healthy and tasty side dish to accompany your next meal.

steps: Wash all vegetables,* and remove seeds from the tomatoes.**
Collect, chop, and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Heat the oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, and cook for about 2 minutes until slightly soft.
Add the red pepper flakes and garlic, and cook for 1 minute. Add the chopped collard greens, and cook for another minute.
Add the broth, cover, and bring to a simmer. Cook for about 40 minutes until the greens are tender.
Add tomatoes.
Taste, and add a small amount of salt and black pepper if desired.
Serve hot.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Eat within 3 to 5 days.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Boston University Sargent Choice Nutrition Center)
name_fr: Soupe aux boulettes de matza végétarienne
desc_en: This savory, vegetable matzo ball soup is a delicious and quick meal on a cold evening.

steps: Stir together eggs, oil, and vegetable stock in a small bowl. Add matzo meal, dill, and salt. Stir until evenly combined. Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes to 8 hours.
Bring large pot of water to a boil; add a dash of salt. Using olive oiled hands, form dough into 12 1-inch balls.
Drop the balls one at a time into the boiling water. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
tips: Wash hands with soap and water. To Make Matzo Balls: To Make Broth: - While matzo balls are simmering, make soup by adding all ingredients and bringing to a boil. - Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. - To serve, spoon 2 cooked matzo balls into a bowl and ladle 1 cup of soup over them.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (DASH Eating Plan: Lower Your Blood Pressure US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
desc_en: Combine oregano and basil with fresh and canned veggies to make your own spaghetti sauce, perfect for any pasta dish.

steps: In a medium skillet, heat oil. Cook onions, garlic, and zucchini in oil for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Serve over pasta.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC))
desc_en: Exploding with tomatoes and basil, these delicious stuffed peppers are a great side dish to any entrée.

steps: Preheat oven to 425 °F. Lightly oil a large shallow baking pan.
Cut peppers in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Arrange peppers cut sides up in baking pan and lightly oil cut edges of stems.
Halve cherry tomatoes and chop onion and basil. Finely chop garlic.
In a bowl, toss tomatoes, onion, basil, garlic, and olive oil. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon equal portions of mixture into peppers and roast in upper third of oven until peppers are tender, about 20 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Healthy Latino Recipes Made with Love California Department of Health Services California Latino 5-A-Day Campaign)
desc_en: These delicious wraps are packed full of flavor and fiber. Mango, cilantro and avocado add a fresh topping to these wraps.

steps: In a nonstick pan, sauté bell peppers and onion for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add beans, stir well. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine mangoes, lime juice, cilantro, and avocado. Set aside 1/2 of this mango mixture for topping.
Fill warmed tortillas with 1/4 bean mixture and 1/4 mango mixture.
Fold ends of the tortillas over. Roll up to make wraps. Top veggie bean wraps with remaining mango mixture.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations)
desc_en: Vegetarian burgers can be made ahead of time and stored in the freezer. They can be served any time. To add some spice, top with salsa.

ingredients.en: Low-sodium whole kernel corn, finely chopped
Cayenne or jalapeño chilies, seeds removed and finely chopped

steps: In a large bowl, combine corn and cornmeal.
Add onions, green pepper, rice, chili powder, and pepper. If using cayenne and jalapeño chilies, add them too. Mix well.
Form the burger mixture into 6 equal patties about 1/2 inch thick, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Spray both sides of the patties with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large pan, brown both sides of the patties over medium to high heat for 5 to 8 minutes.
Bake the patties in the oven for 10 minutes.
Toast the flour tortillas in the oven for 8 minutes.
Place patty on half of tortilla and fold tortilla over to serve like a taco.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Illinois Extension Service)
desc_en: This noodle dish combines the crunch of fresh veggies with the flavors of onion, garlic, and soy sauce to create a delicious and easy stir fry. Make it a family favorite using your favorite veggies.

steps: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Cook onion and garlic with oil in frying pan for 1 minute over medium/high heat.
Add carrot, chicken bouillon, and pepper sauce. Stir.
Add broccoli, celery, and bell pepper and continue to stir.
Reduce heat to low and add noodles and soy sauce. Mix well over low heat for 3 to 5 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University)
desc_en: Cottage cheese is the key to this easy veggie dip. Try with different spices to suit your taste.

steps: Measure cottage cheese and put in bowl or blender.
Beat with a fork or mixer, or in a blender, until cottage cheese is smooth.
Add the other ingredients. Stir together.
Store the dip in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours to let the flavors blend.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Created by Potatoes USA, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program)
desc_en: With every forkful, you will experience the comforting creaminess of mashed potatoes mingling with the vibrant, zesty notes of a cucumber and tomato salad, the heartiness of spiced chickpeas, and the smoky allure of fire-roasted broccoli.

steps: Wash and scrub the potato with a vegetable brush. Cut into 2-inch pieces and place in a small pot. Cover the diced potatoes with cold water. Place the pot on the stove and turn the heat to high. Once the water comes to a boil, reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook the potato pieces until they are fork-tender but not falling apart, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and drain the potatoes. Return the potatoes to the stove for about 30 seconds to ensure all the water is removed from the pan and the potatoes are dry.

While the potatoes are boiling, roast the chickpeas and broccoli in the air fryer. Toss the chickpeas with 1 tablespoon olive oil and the curry powder, lay them out on a baking tray in an even layer, and place in a 400 °F air fryer for 10 minutes, until crispy. Toss the broccoli with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the paprika, and roast in an air fryer at 400 °F for 10 minutes. This can be done simultaneously if your air fryer has the space for both.

Remove the potatoes from the heat and add the Greek yogurt, olive oil, and granulated garlic. Mash the potatoes using a potato masher or a sturdy wire whisk. Do not over mix the potatoes, or they can become gluey. Adjust the seasoning with the salt and pepper.
While everything is roasting, prepare the cucumber-tomato salad. Dice 1/2 of a large cucumber and 1 large tomato. Combine in a bowl and toss.
To serve, add the mashed potatoes on the bottom, followed by the roasted chickpeas, broccoli, and cucumber-tomato salad. Top with optional garnishes and enjoy!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Power of Choice USDA Food and Nutrition Service and US Department of Health and Human Services Food and Drug Administration (FDA))
desc_en: Clean out your cupboards with this quick and easy veggie recipe. Use whatever fresh or canned vegetables you have on hand and mix with noodles, sauce, and cheese for dinner tonight.

steps: Boil water in a cooking pot. Add the pasta. Turn down the heat to medium-low; cook according to box directions. Pour pasta and water into colander to drain.
Add vegetables and spaghetti sauce to cooking pot. Cook over medium-low heat just until the vegetables are hot.
Return cooked, drained pasta back to cooking pot and mix together.
Sprinkle with cheese just before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Making a veggie omelet has never been so easy! Combine all of your ingredients in a mug, pop it in the microwave, and breakfast is ready!

steps: Lightly grease the inside of a 12-ounce microwave-safe mug.
Use a fork to combine the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in the mug and stir well. Mix in the vegetables and cheese.

Microwave on HIGH for 45 seconds. Stir. Return to the microwave and cook on HIGH until the mixture has puffed and set, 60 to 90 seconds. The omelet may look wet on the top but it will dry as it cools.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (CSAAC (Community Services for Autistic Adults and Children))
desc_en: Don't want to turn on your oven or stove today? This veggie pizza pita is a delicious option that is made in the microwave. Top pizza with your favorite veggies.

ingredients.en: Green and red bell peppers, sliced

steps: Place one pita round on a plate.
Spread 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce on pizza.
Sprinkle various chopped vegetable over sauce.
Layer two slices of cheese on top of sauce.
Cover with the other half of pita round.
Microwave 35 to 45 seconds, or until cheese melts.
Slice in half, let cool, and enjoy!

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: This dish, full of veggies and cheese, is made with whole wheat tortillas. Top with salsa and use whatever veggies you have on hand.

steps: Spray pan with cooking oil spray.
Cook vegetables on medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from pan.
Spray pan with cooking spray. Place tortilla in the pan. Sprinkle with half the vegetables and half of the cheese.
Place the other tortilla on top. Cook on medium heat for 4 to 6 minutes or until the cheese starts to melt and the bottom tortilla starts to brown.
Flip quesadilla. Cook for 4 minutes or until tortilla browns.
Repeat steps 3 through 5.
Cut each quesadilla in half. Serve with salsa.
دهني مقلة بشوية زيت.
قطعي ݣرعة خضرا، نص بروكلي، فلفلة خضرا، بصلة وخيزوة صغار. طيبيهم على نار متوسطة 4 حتى 5 دقايق وحركي. خرجيهم.
دهني المقلة مرة أخرى. حطي طورطيا كاملة فيها. رشي نص الخضرة ونص من 110 غ فرماج شيدر محكوك.
حطي طورطيا ثانية فوقها. طيبي على نار متوسطة 4 حتى 6 دقايق حتى يبدا الفرماج يذوب وتحمر الطورطيا من التحت.
قلبي الكيساديا وطيبيها 4 دقايق أخرى.
عاودي مع الطورطيات الأخرى.
قطعي كل كيساديا على جوج وقدميها مع 120 غ صالصا.
tips: ضغطي على الكيساديا بالمعلقة باش تلصق.
زيدي دجاج مقطع للبروتين.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Okra, corn, and onions mixed with squash give this veggie stir-fry crunch and flavor. Serve as a side dish with your favorite chicken or fish recipe.

steps: In a large frying pan over medium heat, cook ground turkey until no longer pink.
Add red peppers, onions, corn, squash, and okra for 5 minutes until tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Wellness Ways Resource Book University of Illinois Extension Service)
desc_en: Whole wheat pita are stuffed with veggies and topped with cheese. Use family favorite veggies to make this easy lunch or dinner.

steps: Wash vegetables.
Remove the broccoli flowers from stems, cut the flowers into small florets, and put into mixing bowl.
Peel carrots and cut off the ends. Grate carrots and put into mixing bowl.
Slice the zucchini into thin slices. Cut each slice into quarters and put into bowl.
Grate the cheese and put into a separate bowl.
Measure oregano, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder; mix together.

Heat oil in a skillet. Put the spices in the heated oil and then add the mixture of vegetables to the pan. Stir vegetables with a wooden spoon and sauté about 5 minutes. When the vegetables are slightly tender, remove from heat.
Spoon vegetable mixture into the pita. Top the hot vegetables with 1 ounce grated cheese.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Berry delicious! This is the perfect breakfast to prep the night before then grab and go on a busy morning.

steps: In medium bowl, mix oats, yogurt, and milk.
Cover and refrigerate for 6 to 12 hours.
Add dried and fresh fruit, and mix gently.
Serve scoops of muesli in small dishes. Sprinkle each serving with chopped nuts.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion)
desc_en: This refreshing pineapple, banana, and berry blend smoothie has 2 and 1/2 cups of fruit per serving.

steps: Peel and slice the banana.
Gather all ingredients and combine in a blender.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Serve right away or pour into ice cube trays and freeze. During the week, pop out the cubes for a quick on-the-go breakfast.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Vidalia Onion and Tomato Salad with Grilled Tuna
name_latin: Chladat besla o matecha bel ton mechwi
desc_en: Sweet Vidalia onions come into season in mid-April. Pair them with tomatoes for this light summer salad that's topped with grilled ahi tuna. Perfect for a backyard luncheon.

steps: Heat grill.
Whisk together dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
Cut tuna into 1-inch chunks and skewer and place on two or three 3-inch skewers; brush lightly with olive oil. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Grill skewered tuna until fish is opaque and flakes with a fork (145 °F); remove from grill.
In a large bowl, toss dressing with all vegetable ingredients. To serve, divide salad on four individual plates; top with tuna.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP))
desc_en: Making your own salad dressing is quick and easy. You can start out with this basic recipe and adapt as needed to fit the ingredients of your salad and your preferences. Mix the vinaigrette in a bowl with a fork or whisk, or shake it in a jar with a tight-fitting lid.

steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Food Hero Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: Extra apples from the market? Try this Waldorf Salad with walnuts and crunchy fall apples.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Place chopped walnuts on a baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Stir occasionally until they are evenly toasted.
Combine apples, celery, nuts, and raisins.
Stir together yogurt, sugar, and lemon juice. Pour over apple mixture and toss lightly.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipe adapted from Joe Van Alstine, Little Traverse Bay Bands of Odawa Indians)
desc_en: Add a cup of hominy or corn to bulk up this creamy chowder!

steps: Heat butter in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add celery and onions and sauté until softened.
Stir in flour to form a roux -- which is a mixture of fat and flour used to thicken sauces or soups. Slowly whisk in the milk.
Add the potatoes and turkey bacon and stir gently. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until potatoes are cooked through.
Add fish chunks and cook for an additional 6 to 8 minutes or until fish reaches the appropriate internal temperature.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley or green onions and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
desc_en: Watermelon can be combined with a savory ingredients for a surprising and refreshing twist in this simple and quick gazpacho recipe.

steps: In a small bowl, mix 1 cup of cubed watermelon and 1/2 of chopped cucumber; set aside.
Process remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender until puréed.
Transfer all ingredients to a large bowl and stir.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (MyPlate National Strategic Partners The Grain Chain)
desc_en: Wheat berries add a unique texture to this flavor-packed chili recipe. This hearty, colorful one pot meal is sure to be a crowd pleaser.

ingredients.en: Beef broth, 99% fat free, reduced sodium

steps: Cook wheat berries in 3 cups of water for 1 hour until tender; add more water if necessary; drain.
Rinse with cool water and drain thoroughly.
In the microwave on medium heat, cook onions and green and yellow peppers for 1 minute, or until desired softness.
In a 4-quart pot, combine remaining ingredients with wheat berries and microwaved vegetables.
On stovetop, bring to a boil and simmer uncovered 1 hour or until desired consistency is reached, stirring occasionally.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (MyPlate National Strategic Partners The Grain Chain)
desc_en: Try this tasty bruschetta with crispy bread topped with white beans, tomatoes, and spices. Served as a side dish or an appetizer, it is sure to be a crowd pleaser!

ingredients.en: Whole-wheat French baguette, cut into 12 thin slices along the bias
Canned navy beans, rinsed and drained

steps: Slice the baguette on the diagonal into thin slices (about 12 slices for a baguette).
In a large sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium heat.

Place the bread slices in the pan and cook on medium high heat until sizzling and golden. Before flipping the bread, add an additional tablespoon of olive oil to the pan and cook the second side until golden.
For the topping, cook the onions and the remaining tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat until the onions are soft, about 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, basil, and oregano and cook another minute or two, until fragrant.
Add beans and continue cooking for another five minutes on low heat. Add the tomatoes and turn off the heat, allowing tomatoes to warm without cooking.
Drizzle the balsamic vinegar into the pan and gently stir.
Scoop heaping spoonsful of the tomato-bean mixture onto the grilled bread and enjoy.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Nebraska at Lincoln Nebraska Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Get three food groups in one delicious and hearty soup.

steps: In a large saucepan, heat oil.
Add onion and cook until tender.
Add green chilies, beans (do not drain), chicken broth, garlic powder, pepper, ground cumin, and chicken. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until desired thickness.
Serve hot, topped with cheese. Add parsley if desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (The Bold and Beautiful Book of Bean Recipes Washington State WIC Program)
desc_en: Looking for a new twist on chili? Try this white chili with chicken and milk and you're in for a treat.

steps: Sauté peppers and onion in olive oil.
Add green chili, garlic, spices, and chicken broth. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add milk, cooked beans, and cooked chicken. Allow to thicken before adding cilantro. Heat through.
Top chili with crisp tortillas before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Lifeskills in Food Education, Food Skills Cookbook University of Hawaii at Manoa Cooperative Extension Food Stamps Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Add a creamy texture to your soups and stews with this easy sauce.

steps: In a small pot, melt butter over low heat.
Add flour, salt, and pepper to mixture.
Add milk gradually.
Heat to boiling, stir constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly. (The consistency should be like thin cream.)
Remove from heat.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (MyPlate National Strategic Partners The Grain Chain)
desc_en: Whole wheat flour adds a nutty flavor and texture to these great-tasting pancakes. Dish these up with berries and a glass of milk on the side for a wholesome start to your day!

steps: Heat griddle to 375 °F or heat 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Grease with canola oil if necessary (or spray with cooking spray before heating).
In large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; set aside.
In medium bowl, beat eggs, vanilla yogurt, water, and oil with egg beater or wire whisk until well blended.
Pour egg mixture all at once into flour mixture; stir until moistened.
For each pancake, pour slightly less than 1/4 cup batter from cup or pitcher onto hot griddle.
Cook pancakes 1 to 2 minutes or until bubbly on top, puffed and dry around edges. Turn; cook other sides 1 to 2 minutes or until golden brown.
Top each serving (2 pancakes) with 1/4 cup sliced strawberries and 1 to 2 tablespoons strawberry yogurt.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eat Smart New York! Cornell University Cooperative Extension)
name_fr: Bâtonnets de pain complet à l'ail
desc_en: These easy and delicious garlic bread sticks are a great side dish for our Chicken Spaghetti or as a snack.

steps: Spread each slice of bread with one teaspoon oil.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Cut each slice into 3 equal parts.
Bake at 300 °F for about 25 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Montana State University Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Start your day off with these whole wheat muffins topped with cinnamon and sugar. Make these ahead of time for a quick and easy breakfast.

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F. Lightly oil or coat with non-stick spray the cups of a 12 cup muffin pan, or use paper muffin cups.
Mix together white sugar and cinnamon for topping and set aside.

In a large bowl, stir together flour, salt, baking powder, and brown sugar. In a glass liquid measuring cup, measure milk, then add eggs, vanilla (if using), and melted shortening or oil. Mix with a fork until egg is well combined with other ingredients.
Pour milk mixture over flour mixture and stir with a spoon, about 20 strokes, until flour is just moistened. Batter will be lumpy and thick.
Fill prepared muffin cups about 2/3 full with batter. Sprinkle about 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon/ sugar topping over each muffin.
Bake in oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm. Leftovers may be frozen.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipe adapted from Chickasaw Nation Nutrition Services, Get Fresh Initiative)
desc_en: These flavorful and nutty wild rice muffins come together as part of a healthy breakfast or snack.

steps: Preheat the oven to 400 °F. Spray a 12-cup muffin pan with cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, mix bakery mix, sugar, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, mix bananas, milk, and applesauce.
Add banana mixture to dry mixture and stir.
Fold in wild rice and nuts.
Spoon 1/4 cup of the batter into each muffin cup. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Stay Young at Heart: Cooking the Heart-Healthy Way US Department of Health and Human Services National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute)
name_latin: Crisp chta bel tfah o tout
desc_en: What is that sweet cinnamon scent, wafting from your kitchen? It's this apple and cranberry winter crisp.

steps: Combine sugar, flour, and lemon peel in a medium bowl and mix well.
Stir in apples and cranberries.
Spoon into a 6-cup baking dish.
tips: Wash hands with soap and water. Filling: Topping: - Combine oats, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon in a small bowl. - Stir in melted margarine. - Sprinkle topping over filling. - Bake at 375 °F for 40 minutes or until filling is bubbly and top is brown. - Serve warm or at room temperature.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kids a Cookin’ Kansas Family Nutrition Program)
desc_en: This geletain and pudding combination are perfect for young children or the young at heart!

steps: In a medium bowl, dissolve agar-agar in boiling water. Cool at least 30 minutes.
Pour milk into large mixing bowl and add pudding mix. Using an electric mixer, beat 1 minute.
Gradually add and beat in agar-agar mixture. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking pan. Chill in fridge for several hours.
Cut fun shapes with cookie cutters or knife. Store in refrigerator.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (A Healthier You: Based on the Dietary Guidelines for Americans US Department of Health and Human Services Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion)
desc_en: Pair these delicious stuffed potatoes with grilled or baked meat, fish, or tofu.

steps: Prick potatoes with fork. Bake at 425 °F for 60 minutes or until fork is easily inserted.
Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out potato, leaving about 1/2 inch of pulp inside shell. Mash pulp in large bowl.
Mix in by hand remaining ingredients except Parmesan cheese. Spoon mixture into potato shells.
Sprinkle top with 1/4 teaspoon of Parmesan cheese.
Place on baking sheet and return to oven. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tops are golden brown.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Produce for Better Health Foundation)
name_en: Yellow Potato and Red Pepper Shrimp Sauté
name_fr: Sauté de crevettes, pommes de terre et poivron rouge
name_latin: Qemroun meqli bel btata o felfla hamra
desc_en: This dish is reminiscent of shrimp scampi but is veggie-centric with its mix of potatoes, bell peppers, onions, and zucchini. The potatoes are partially cooked in the microwave before sautéing, for a meal that's on the table in 30 minutes.

steps: Pierce the skin of each potato with a fork; microwave potatoes on high for 2 minutes. Turn potatoes over and microwave 2 more minutes. Remove from microwave and let cool slightly.
While potatoes are cooling, heat olive oil in large saucepan. Add garlic, onion, and bell pepper, and cook about 3 to 4 minutes.

Cube potatoes. Add juice, water, and vinegar to saucepan; bring to boil. Add shrimp, zucchini, potatoes, and seasoning. Return to boil, and simmer 5 to 8 minutes, until shrimp, potatoes, and zucchini are done. The flesh of the shrimp should be an opaque color.
Cut the lemon in half; squeeze juice from half the lemon into the saucepan.
Serve the Parmesan cheese and lemon wedges cut from the remaining lemon half.
نقبي 3 حبات بطاطا بالفرشيطة وطيبيهم فالميكرو 2 دقايق، قلبيهم و2 دقايق أخرى (ولا سلقيهم 10 دقايق). خليهم يبردو شوية.
سخني 2 معالق زيت العود فطنجرة كبيرة. زيدي 2 حبات تومة مدقوقة، بصلة مقطعة وفلفلة حمرا مقطعة، طيبيهم 3 حتى 4 دقايق.

قطعي البطاطا كوبات. زيدي للطنجرة 120 مل عصير العنب الأبيض، 120 مل ما ومعلقة صغيرة خل، وخليها تغلي. زيدي 340 غ قمرون، ݣرعة خضرا مقطعة، البطاطا، معلقة صغيرة أعشاب إيطالية وربع معلقة إبزار. خليها تغلي ثم تطيب 5 حتى 8 دقايق حتى يطيب القمرون ويولي أبيض.
عصري نص حامضة فالطنجرة.
قدمي مع 30 غ بارميزان وقطع الحامض.
tips: إلا ما لقيتيش عصير العنب، زيدي ما ولا مرقة.
القمرون كيطيب دغيا، ما تخليهش بزاف باش ما يقسحش.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (USDA Food and Nutrition Information Center)
desc_en: Enjoy this hearty snack or dessert, abounding with fresh fruit, granola, and any flavor of low-fat yogurt.

steps: Line up 4 parfait or other tall glasses.
Spoon 1/2 cup of yogurt into each glass.
Sprinkle with granola.
Top with about 1/4 cup of fruit.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Adapted from Splendid Fruit Salad, Iowa Department of Public Health Iowa Nutrition Network)
desc_en: Yogurt pulls all the flavors together in this splendid fruit salad! Use seasonal fruit if you have it on hand.

steps: Mix yogurt, cinnamon, and orange juice in a medium bowl.
Wash and chop the fruit and add to the yogurt mixture. Stir and serve.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: A quick, easy, and delicious frozen dessert made with your favorite fruit juice and yogurt.

steps: Put the yogurt and juice in a bowl.
Stir together well.
Pour the mix into paper cups.
Stick a popsicle stick in the center of the mix in the cup.
Place the yogurt pops in the freezer until they turn solid.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Smart, Being Active Colorado State University)
desc_en: This is a refreshing and flavorful frozen treat that would be perfect on a hot day -- or even on a cold day.

ingredients.en: Us fluid ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: Place paper cups close together on a baking sheet.
Pour yogurt/juice mixture into paper cups.
Cover the cups with a sheet of aluminum foil.
Freeze popsicles until firm.
Run warm water on the outside of each cup to loosen each popsicle from the cup.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Purdue University Extension)
desc_en: No time? No blender? No problem! Grab a bag and get your smoothie started.

steps: Place ingredients in a sandwich size zip-top plastic bag.
Squish the bag until all ingredients are mixed, then stick a straw in a bag to drink the smoothie.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Originally named "Yummy Bagels" Adapted from: Cooking For You or Two University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Did you know that you can make your own fresh, delicious, whole-grain rich bagels at home? This recipe makes enough to share with family and friends, or to freeze the extras.

steps: In a bowl mix sugar, yeast, water, and flours together to make dough.
Rub inside of another bowl with oil. Place dough in bowl and flip to coat with oil. Let rise 30 minutes.
Punch down dough and divide into 16 portions. Shape into a ball and poke a hole through the middle with your fingers.
Place on a well-greased baking sheet and cover with a clean dish towel to rise again for 15 to 20 minutes.
Put 2 inches of water in a pot and heat to boiling.
Using a slotted spoon, gently place each bagel into a rapidly boiling water for 1 minute on each side.
Remove and dry on a towel.
Place back on baking sheet. If desired, sprinkle bagels with cinnamon/sugar or salt.
Bake at 475 °F for 8 to 12 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Originally named: Yummy Bean Dip Adapted from: University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Beans make delicious dips for delectable snacks and side dishes.

steps: Place beans in a small, resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out extra air and seal. Mash beans with fingers.
Add yogurt and salsa. Seal bag and mix with fingers.
Open bag or cut off corner of bag and squeeze out dip.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (2009 Recipe Calendar University of Maryland Extension Food Supplement Nutrition Education Program)
name_latin: Chladat kromb bel hamed o letchin
desc_en: This coleslaw is big on flavor with nuts, Mandarin oranges, and soy sauce!

steps: Mix together the coleslaw mix, peanuts (if using), and Mandarin oranges in a large bowl.
Stir in the Italian salad dressing and soy sauce.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Vinegar, orange juice, and herbs combine to give this dressing a sweet and tangy flavor. Season to your taste.

steps: Put all the ingredients in a jar or bottle with a lid.
Put on the lid. Shake well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Cooking For You or Two University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Lemon pepper combined with lemon juice, onions, and parsley give this entrée loads of flavor and takes less than 30 minutes to cook. Pairs well with a salad and brown rice.

steps: Separate fish into two serving size pieces. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Top with onion slices.
Drizzle lemon juice and oil evenly over fish.
Sprinkle lemon pepper, parsley, and dust with paprika (optional).
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Bake at 350 °F for 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with fork.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Simple Healthy Recipes Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education ONIE Project)
desc_en: Colorful and flavorful, this carrot, honey, and cinnamon side dish will make your plate pop with color.

steps: Bring about 2 cups of water to a gentle boil in saucepan.
Add carrots and cinnamon. Cook for about 10 minutes, until just tender.
While carrots are cooking, wash an orange and cut in half.
Squeeze juice out of the orange (remove seeds).
Use a sharp paring knife to carefully remove the orange 'zest' from the peel. Try not to get any of the white part as it will taste bitter. Cut the zest into small slices.
When carrots are done, drain well.
Add the honey, margarine, and orange zest and toss into mix. Serve while hot.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Recipe adapted from Chickasaw Nation Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: Whole grain rotini and colorful vegetables elevate this pasta salad! Add canned chicken or tuna for a complete meal.

steps: Cook pasta according to the package directions.
Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk oil, lemon juice, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes.
Add cooked pasta, cucumber, tomato, carrots, red onion, and Parmesan cheese to the dressing.
Mix well and chill for 2 hours before serving.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Tomato juice brings all of the flavors of the onion, mushrooms, tomatoes, and zucchini together in this summer dish.

steps: Peel the onion. Chop it into small pieces.
Chop the tomato.
Drain the water from the can of mushrooms.
Cut each zucchini into slices.
Put the tomato juice and pepper in a skillet or pan. Cook on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the onion, tomato, and mushrooms.
Reduce the heat to medium-high. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the zucchini. Cover and cook for another 5 to 7 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (MyPlate National Strategic Partners The Grain Chain)
desc_en: This creamy pasta dish with a hint of lemon is sure to be a family favorite. Packed with chicken and topped with crunchy almonds, it can be baked and ready to serve any night of the week.

steps: Combine flour, salt, pepper, and cayenne in a saucepan; gradually add chicken broth and skim milk, stirring with a wire whisk until smooth.
Place over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add mustard and lemon juice. Allow to cool.
Heat margarine and oil in a skillet. Add chicken pieces, green onions, and garlic. Sauté until chicken is just firm and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Prepare pasta according to package directions and drain. Combine sauce, chicken, and pasta mixture.
Put into a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle top with almonds, chopped chives, and paprika (if using).
Bake at 375 °F for 10 minutes or until heated through.
فطنجرة خلطي 30 غ فرينة، ربع معلقة ملحة، ربع معلقة إبزار وربع معلقة فلفلة حارة. زيدي بشوية 190 مل مرقة الدجاج و160 مل حليب وحركي بالمخفقة حتى يولي ناعم.
حطيها على نار متوسطة وحركي بلا وقفة حتى تخثر. زيدي 2 معالق صغار موطارد و60 مل عصير الحامض وخليها تبرد.
سخني معلقة زبدة ومعلقة زيت فمقلة. زيدي 560 غ صدر الدجاج مقطع، 5 بصلات خضر مقطعين وحبة تومة مدقوقة. قلبي 10 دقايق حتى يطيب الدجاج.
طيبي 220 غ سباݣيتي كامل فما مغلي وصفيه.
خلطي الصلصة، الدجاج والسباݣيتي وحطيهم فطبق الفرن.
رشي فوقهم 30 غ لوز مقطع، معلقتين بصلة خضرا ورشة فلفلة حلوة.
دخليه للفرن على 190 درجة 10 دقايق حتى يسخن.
tips: الصلصة بالحامض كتعطي طعم منعش، ما تزيديش الحامض بزاف.
اللوز المحمر كيعطي قرمشة زوينة.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wyoming Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Spend less time cooking and more time enjoying your summer with this fast and delicious summer veggie side dish. Pairs well with grilled meat, fish, or tofu.

steps: Melt butter or oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, and seasonings.
Cover pan, reduce heat, and cook until vegetables are tender.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Eating Right Is Basic Michigan State University Cooperative Extension Service Nutrition Education Program)
desc_en: A fast and delicious way to prepare the zucchini or yellow squash flooding your garden or market this summer.

steps: Wash and slice vegetables. Place zucchini, onion, water, margarine, and pepper in a frying pan. Cover and cook over medium heat for one minute.
Remove cover and cook until crisp-tender, about 10 minutes.
Turn with large spoon to cook evenly.
Sprinkle with cheese; toss lightly.
Serve at once.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Favorite Recipes for Family Meals Washington State University Extension)
desc_en: This tasty zucchini bread can be eaten as a dessert or snack. Serve warm or cooled.

steps: Preheat oven to 325 °F
Lightly grease and flour a 9x5 loaf pan.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs lightly. Add sugar, oil, zucchini, and vanilla and beat.
In a separate bowl, measure dry ingredients and stir to combine. Add raisins.
Add dry ingredients to the egg mixture. Stir just until all ingredients are moistened.
Spoon into loaf pan.
Bake at 325 °F for 50 minutes. Test for doneness by inserting a toothpick in the center. It should come out dry.
Allow loaf to cool 5 to 10 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack.
Serve warm or allow to cool before slicing.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Ross County Recipes Ohio State University Cooperative Extension)
desc_en: Full of delicious summer vegetables combined with beef sausage and potatoes, this is a hearty main dish or an easy meal. Try using fresh tomatoes and Italian herbs if you have them on hand.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F.
Brown beef sausage and onion together in a skillet; drain.
Mix all ingredients together and place in a casserole dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 45 minutes.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Kentucky Families on the Move: Food and Nutrition Calendar, 2005 University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension Service)
desc_en: This colorful dish is a delicious alternative to the sweet coleslaw and a great way to eat your veggies.

steps: Drain zucchini by pressing between layers of paper towels.
Put zucchini in large bowl; add cabbage, carrots, onions, and radishes.
In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over vegetables and toss well.
Cover and chill at least one hour.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (University of Wyoming Extension Cent$ible Nutrition Program)
desc_en: Try this veggie side dish with different variations by adding combinations of your favorite veggies. Grated carrots, spinach, cauliflower, or broccoli all work. You can serve this dish with applesauce or sour cream.

steps: Grate zucchini and mix with the other ingredients, except the oil. Blend well.
Form the mixture into patties 3 to 4 inches in diameter.
Heat the oil. Cook pancakes for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove and drain on paper towels.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
desc_en: This zucchini recipe brings you a flavorful dish loaded with vegetables and low-fat dairy.

steps: Wash and chop zucchini, measure out about 2 cups.
Dice the onion and pepper, set aside along with the zucchini.
Stir the egg and milk together and set aside.
Sauté the vegetables in oil on medium heat. Remove from the pan.
Scramble the egg mixture until cooked thoroughly. Stir in the vegetable mixture and fold together.
Cook together until temperature reaches 145 °F.
Sprinkle the seasoning and cheese on top. When the cheese is melted, serve warm.
Add fresh or other dried herbs as desired.

source_text: USDA MyPlate Kitchen (Pennsylvania Nutrition Education Network)
desc_en: Enjoy your zucchini bumper crop or farmers market bounty with this quick and easy vegetable side dish.

steps: Peel and chop the onion.
Cut the yellow squash and zucchini into small pieces.
Chop the red pepper into small pieces.
Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the onion.
Cook over medium heat, stirring quickly for 1 minute.
Add the spices and stir a few times.
Add remaining vegetables and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until vegetables are just tender.
